f077b239.title: Sr. Cloud Service Manager
f077b239.description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact:**  
We’re looking for an enthusiastic, customer centric team player that thrives on providing the best possible experience for our clients. You’ll need excellent communication and organisational skills along with the ability to manage complex internal relationships while maintaining a calm, positive and supportive attitude.You are the Customer Success manager and overall relationship owner to assigned OpenText Cloud Managed Services accounts and act as a trusted advisor and partner that understands the customer's business and strategy as it relates to their OT product portfolio.You ensures operational health& customer satisfaction.
  
  
**What the role offers:**  

* Providing overall business management of the customer which includes weekly status calls, monthly SLA reporting, business reviews, issue tracking reporting and cross functional communication with other OT teams (i.e., support, sales, product management, etc.)
* Managing customer expectations such that escalations can be avoided; if escalations do arise, the Cloud Service Manager leads the escalation management until the issues are resolved and the account de-escalated
* Managing relationships and interfacing at various levels within the customer's organization (i.e., business, technical, executive leadership)
* Identifying short and long-term strategies to assist in the growth and business objectives of the customer by working with account executive
* Identifying new business opportunities, recommending products or services to improve customer satisfaction and ROI by working with account executive
* Regular discussions and addressing any customer concerns regarding overall service and satisfaction, making necessary adjustments, and ensuring that issues have been addressed and customer perception has positively
* Facilitate communications between different teams where needed for special circumstances, customer problems, and high-visibility service items
* On-board net-new hybrid cloud based customers
* Enable customer sponsors in a consultative and best-practice share approach
* Deliver updates and communications to internal& executives sponsors
* Build rapport and relationships with customers; ultimately achieving a trusted advisor relationship to be their voice within the OpenText walls
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and iteration of best-practices, process and templates of the Customer Success Manager role

**What you need to succeed:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent
* At least 3+ years of IT experience in Service Delivery Roles
* Conversant in cloud technology and data center deployment,. ITIL certification preferred.
* A level of comfort with creating and balancingfact-based analytics with real world application.
* Able to work independently with positive problem-solving attitude
* Demonstrable experience in developing and rolling out customer satisfaction improvement programs
* Solid work ethic with a willingness to work overtime when required and willingness to work in shifts (preferably during NA hours)

OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

e11d5f6d.title: Solutions Engineer (Security, GSSO) - Mumbai
e11d5f6d.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be part of an outstanding technical pre-sales team in our Global Security Sales Organization (GSSO), responsible for driving the success of Cisco’s Security Portfolio and focusing on protecting Customer Application Environments across on-prem and cloud platforms. Our mission is to democratize security by making it easy and effective for everyone.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
As a key player in the team, you will have the opportunity to influence the security landscape by crafting tailored solutions that address specific customer needs. This role offers the excitement of working with cutting-edge technology and the fulfillment of building long-lasting relationships with customers. You will:
  
  

* Provide guidance and assist account teams in building solutions to address specific customer security needs.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Create, present, and document technical solutions to customers, partners, and prospects.
* Lead technical consulting and upper-level management presentations.
* Drive major account opportunities while enabling local account teams to maintain long-term ownership.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 7 years of technical sales or pre-sales experience with 4+ years in Security specialization in Network Security and technologies including NGFW/NGIPS, Secure Network Analytics/NDR/NBAD, Email Security, Web & Cloud Security, CASB, SSE/SASE, Micro segmentation, Identity Security, Workload Protection, and Container Networking & Security.
* Experience with AI Security, including AI runtime security, workload protection, and security guardrails.
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Proven track record of successful quota achievement.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, technologies, and best practices.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP are preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Commercial awareness and strong communication skills.
* Highly motivated self-starter who excels without day-to-day management.
* Experience with Cisco security technologies and programming languages such as UNIX shell, Perl, or C.
* Willingness to travel and work from a home office.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

0fca716c.title: SAP Cloud ALM Consultant
0fca716c.description:
**Company Profile:**

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.

**Job Title: SAP Basis Consultant**

**Position: Senior Software Engineer**

**Experience: 5 -10 Years**

**Category: Software Development/ Engineering**

**Shift: General**

**Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai**

**Position ID:**

**Employment Type: Full Time**

**Education Qualification**: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.

**Position Description:**

We are seeking an experienced **SAP Senior Consultant – SAP Basis & SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)** with expertise in **SAP Cloud ALM** to design, implement, administer, and optimize SAP landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP Basis administration, SAP BTP services, cloud integration, system monitoring, and lifecycle management. You will work closely with functional, technical, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing SAP environments.

**Responsibilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support SAP Basis landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments.
* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain SAP systems including S/4HANA, ECC, and NetWeaver.
* Implement and manage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services and subaccounts.
* Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, implementation, operations, and integration scenarios.
* Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Manage transport management, client administration, and system refresh activities.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams for SAP deployments, upgrades, and migrations.
* Ensure system availability, security, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance with SAP best practices.
* Support SAP integration with cloud and third-party applications.
* Prepare technical documentation and participate in production support and on-call activities as required.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in SAP Basis Administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP).
* Experience implementing and administering SAP Cloud ALM.
* Expertise in SAP system installation, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, and migrations.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, NetWeaver, and HANA Database administration.
* Strong knowledge of transport management, client administration, and system monitoring.
* Experience with SAP security concepts, user administration, and authorizations.
* Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and database administration.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting SAP workloads.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with SAP Solution Manager.
* Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud Connector.
* Experience with automation and scripting using Shell, Python, or PowerShell.
* SAP Basis, SAP BTP, or SAP Cloud ALM certifications.
* Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

**Life at CGI**:

It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons

Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that provides consulting services for Acrobat Sign, which is an Adobe Document Cloud product. We are looking for experienced and dedicated Consultants to join the Adobe Consulting Delivery team! The ideal candidate demonstrates experience in delivering Acrobat Sign solutions helping to lead large and complex multi-technology agile projects and will possess the skills to interact, collaborate, and work with a broad range of personas and functions, including the client, business owners, engineers, project operations, quality assurance, project managers and product management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with and knowledge share with client business owners & partners
* Participate in the use case discovery sessions with the Client
* Configure the Adobe Sign application in conjunction with Client’s requirements
* Partner with technical project leadership to provide day-to-day tactical objectives
* Work with the client to gather user feedback on implemented functionality.
* Advise the client group on Adobe Sign internal alignment and customer change management.
* Ensure client enablement on their Adobe Sign implementation

* Excellent communication skills (oral and written), with the ability to present technical solutions to and build consensus with client developers and senior stakeholders (Managers, Directors, VPs, CXOs)
* Ability to validate proposed technical architecture and work directly with client developers to align on the solution
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including drawing conclusions from customer interviews/requirements discussions
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple concurrent projects

**Good to Have**

* React and/or Python development experience
* Salesforce (Lightning/Classic, Apex, Visualforce, REST API, Triggers) or Workday integration experience
* Familiarity with e-signature/document generation platforms (DocuSign, Conga, etc.)
* Experience with Agile Scrum and Atlassian tools (Jira/Confluence)
* Experience developing requirements for interfaces and data migrations
* s both oral and written
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple projects at the same time
* Experience reviewing, elaborating business, technical requirements, and coach client resources around requirements management
* Experience with Agile Scrum process and project management systems such as Atlassian tools (Confluence/Jira) (preferable)
* Experience with developing requirements for interfaces and production data migrations

**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

401ba4c7.title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)
401ba4c7.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

**Work Timings:**
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday.
* Ensure that your Professional Profile is updated (fields such as Education, Prior experience, Other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal LPP)
* L10+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L10+ Employees can apply

**Grade/Level: 12**
**Job Family Group**
Risk Management

1e51c7e7.description:
**Cloud Migration Engineer**

**Company:**
F9 Infotech

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Work Mode:**
On-site (Work from Office)

**Experience:**
3+ Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About F9 Infotech**

F9 Infotech is a leading cloud consulting and managed services provider, helping enterprises accelerate their cloud transformation journeys. We specialize in cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure solutions, and managed services across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Nutanix environments.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a
**Cloud Migration Engineer**
with hands-on experience in migrating enterprise workloads to AWS, Azure, or Nutanix NC2.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems, cloud migration methodologies, and infrastructure fundamentals.

You will work closely with our Cloud Delivery and Project teams to plan, execute, troubleshoot, and successfully complete enterprise workload migrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute enterprise workload migrations from on-premises or cloud environments to AWS, Azure, or Nutanix NC2.
* Participate in workload discovery, assessment, and migration planning.
* Support the development and execution of migration strategies.
* Perform server migrations using cloud-native or third-party migration tools.
* Coordinate with project teams during migration, testing, validation, and cutover activities.
* Troubleshoot migration-related issues and minimize downtime during workload transitions.
* Perform post-migration validation and support workload stabilization.
* Maintain migration documentation, execution checklists, and technical reports.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud operations, or cloud migration.
* Hands-on experience migrating enterprise workloads to at least one of the following: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Nutanix NC2.

b7189d5a.description:
**Role Title: VP, eGRC Solution Architect (L12)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/ Purpose**
The
**eGRC Solution Architect**
is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk & Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
**automate, standardize, and integrate**
governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end-to-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end-to-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5+ years of hands-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5+ years designing and delivering end-to-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target-state architecture, standards, and non-functional requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's Degree and 10 +years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience

**Work Timings:**
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying.
* Inform your Manager or HRM before applying for any role on Workday.

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

**Function:**
Technology / Customer Success
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly accomplished
**Technical Account Manager (TAM)**
to serve as a strategic technology advisor and executive-facing leader for enterprise customers.
  
  
The TAM will act as a
**trusted technology and business partner to CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and senior business stakeholders**
, driving technology strategy, operational excellence, service governance, financial performance and long-term customer value across
**AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud**
environments.
  
  
The role will have significant responsibility for
**customer retention, revenue growth, P&L management, billing governance and commercial performance**
, in addition to technical and operational leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of
**OEM technology and service offerings**
, including cloud platforms, infrastructure, security, networking, observability, databases, backup, disaster recovery and enterprise software ecosystems, and should be able to translate these offerings into appropriate customer solutions and commercial opportunities.
  
  
This role requires strong technical credibility, executive presence, commercial acumen and the ability to translate complex technology initiatives into
**measurable business and financial outcomes**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Executive Customer Leadership & CXO Engagement


+ Serve as the senior technical and strategic point of contact for assigned enterprise and strategic accounts.
+ Build trusted relationships with CIO, CTO, CISO and other senior technology and business stakeholders.
+ Understand customer business priorities and translate them into technology and business strategies.
+ Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Executive Steering Committees and strategic account reviews.
+ Present service performance, technology risks, transformation initiatives, financial metrics and improvement opportunities to executive audiences.
+ Act as the voice of the customer internally and ensure strong alignment between customer expectations and delivery teams.
+ Own the overall customer relationship and proactively address risks that could impact customer satisfaction, retention or revenue.
+ Build executive-level relationships that support long-term account growth and strategic partnership.

* Strategic Cloud Advisory & Architecture Governance


+ Provide strategic architectural oversight across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
+ Advise customers on cloud adoption, modernization, migration and cloud-native transformation.
+ Drive adoption of Well-Architected, reliability engineering, security-by-design and automation-first principles.
+ Lead cloud maturity assessments and develop multi-year technology transformation roadmaps.
+ Identify opportunities for application modernization, platform engineering, automation and operational simplification.
+ Provide guidance on high availability, resilience, disaster recovery, scalability and capacity planning.
+ Partner with enterprise architects and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions align with business objectives.

* OEM & Technology Ecosystem Management


+ Maintain a strong understanding of OEM technology portfolios, product capabilities, licensing models, support models and professional/managed service offerings.
+ Understand the positioning and value proposition of major OEMs across cloud, compute, storage, networking, security, databases, backup, DR, observability and enterprise applications.
+ Evaluate OEM solutions against customer requirements and recommend appropriate technology and service options.
+ Engage with OEMs and technology partners to leverage their technical expertise, support capabilities, professional services and commercial programs.
+ Identify opportunities to combine OEM solutions with managed services to create differentiated customer propositions.
+ Stay current with changes in OEM product roadmaps, licensing models, cloud marketplace offerings and technology trends.
+ Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams in developing technology solutions, proposals and account expansion strategies.

* Service Governance & Operational Excellence


+ Govern SLA, KPI and OLA performance across CloudOps, SRE, DevOps, Security and Platform Engineering teams.
+ Establish and drive continuous service improvement initiatives.
+ Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Management.
+ Lead major incident and escalation management, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and root-cause resolution.
+ Review operational trends and proactively identify service risks before they impact the customer.
+ Govern disaster recovery readiness, business continuity, capacity management and operational resilience.
+ Drive automation and proactive monitoring to reduce recurring incidents and manual operational effort.
+ Establish service improvement plans with measurable outcomes and executive visibility.

* FinOps, P&L, Revenue & Commercial Management


+ Demonstrate strong understanding of FinOps principles, practices and operating models across cloud environments.
+ Drive cloud financial management covering cost visibility, allocation, optimization, forecasting, budgeting and governance.
+ Identify opportunities to optimize cloud consumption and improve customer technology economics without compromising performance, security or resilience.
+ Own or contribute significantly to the P&L performance of assigned customer accounts or service portfolios.
+ Manage account-level revenue, gross margin, cost base and profitability in partnership with business and finance teams.
+ Own revenue management and forecasting, including actuals, run-rate revenue, pipeline, renewals and growth opportunities.
+ Monitor account financial performance and proactively address revenue leakage, margin erosion and cost overruns.
+ Identify opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, expansion and transformation-led revenue growth.
+ Partner with Sales, Finance and Delivery teams to develop account growth and profitability plans.
+ Ensure services are delivered within agreed commercial and financial parameters.

* Billing, Collections & Revenue Assurance


+ Own governance of the customer billing lifecycle, ensuring accurate, timely and complete invoicing.
+ Ensure billing is aligned with contracts, statements of work, consumption, SLAs, milestones and agreed pricing models.
+ Proactively identify and resolve billing disputes, revenue leakage and invoicing discrepancies.
+ Partner with Finance, Accounts Receivable and Delivery teams to improve billing accuracy and collection performance.
+ Monitor outstanding receivables, disputed invoices and payment risks for strategic accounts.
+ Establish governance mechanisms to minimize billing delays and improve DSO / cash realization.
+ Ensure changes in scope, consumption, resources and service levels are appropriately reflected in commercial and billing processes.

* Customer Retention & Account Growth


+ Take accountability for customer retention and account health across assigned strategic accounts.
+ Establish early-warning mechanisms to identify customer dissatisfaction, service risks and competitive threats.
+ Develop and execute customer recovery and retention plans where required.
+ Track customer satisfaction, executive engagement, service performance and commercial health.
+ Build multi-year customer relationships and position the organization as a strategic technology partner.
+ Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through cloud transformation, modernization, security, automation and managed services.
+ Partner with Sales and Account Management to develop and execute account growth strategies.

* Leadership & Cross-Functional Orchestration


+ Lead and coordinate cross-functional technology teams to deliver seamless customer outcomes.
+ Orchestrate activities across Cloud Operations, Architecture, Security, DevOps, SRE, Service Management, Finance and Engineering.
+ Mentor and coach junior TAMs, service delivery managers and technical leaders.
+ Collaborate closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Enterprise Architecture, Product, Finance and Delivery leadership.
+ Establish an automation-first, reliability-first and customer-outcome-focused culture.
+ Influence without direct authority across geographically distributed teams and customer organizations.

**Required Qualifications & Certifications**
**Mandatory**




+ 12+ years of experience across IT Infrastructure, Cloud, Managed Services, Technology Operations or related areas.
+ Minimum 5+ years in Technical Account Management, Service Delivery Leadership, Cloud Program Management or equivalent customer-facing technology leadership roles.
+ Proven experience managing strategic enterprise customers and complex technology environments.
+ Demonstrated ability to engage effectively with CIO, CTO, CISO and other CXO-level stakeholders.
+ Strong understanding of enterprise cloud architecture, operations, security, reliability and governance.
+ Experience managing large-scale or multi-million-dollar managed services engagements.
+ Demonstrated experience with P&L, revenue management, commercial governance or account financial management.
+ Strong understanding of billing, revenue assurance, collections and customer retention.
+ Strong understanding of OEM technology products, services, licensing and support models.
+ Strong understanding of FinOps principles and cloud financial management.

**Mandatory Professional-Level Cloud Certification**
**At Least One Of The Following**




+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
+ Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect

**Preferred Certifications**




+ FinOps Practitioner
+ ITIL Foundation / ITIL Intermediate or higher
+ PMP / PRINCE2
+ CISSP or equivalent cloud/security certification
+ AWS, Azure or GCP specialty certifications

**Core Technical & Business Competencies**
**The Successful Candidate Should Demonstrate Strong Knowledge Across**




+ AWS / Azure / GCP cloud platforms
+ FinOps and Cloud Financial Management
+ Cloud architecture and modernization
+ Cloud migration and transformation
+ OEM product and service portfolios
+ OEM licensing, subscription and support models
+ Cloud marketplace and partner ecosystems
+ SRE, DevOps and platform engineering
+ Infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code
+ Cloud security and IAM
+ Business continuity and disaster recovery
+ Observability, monitoring and operational resilience
+ ITIL-based service management
+ P&L and profitability management
+ Revenue forecasting and management
+ Billing and revenue assurance
+ Collections and receivables management
+ Customer retention and account growth
+ SLA/KPI governance and service improvement
+ Enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps
+ Vendor and stakeholder management
+ Executive communication and presentation

**Leadership Profile**
**We Are Looking For An Individual Who**




+ Can operate comfortably between deep technical discussions and CXO-level business conversations.
+ Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for customer, operational and financial outcomes.
+ Has demonstrated experience managing P&L, revenue and commercial performance.
+ Has strong understanding of FinOps and cloud economics.
+ Has broad knowledge of OEM technology offerings and partner ecosystems.
+ Is commercially aware and able to identify opportunities for value creation, retention and account growth.
+ Can challenge customers constructively while maintaining trusted relationships.
+ Has strong crisis-management and executive-escalation capabilities.
+ Can influence multiple technical teams without relying solely on formal authority.
+ Thinks strategically while maintaining sufficient technical depth to challenge architectural and operational decisions.
+ Is passionate about improving customer experience, reliability, automation and operational maturity.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

+ Customer retention and renewal rate
+ Customer satisfaction and executive stakeholder engagement
+ Revenue growth and account expansion
+ P&L performance and gross margin
+ Revenue forecast accuracy
+ Billing accuracy and timeliness
+ Reduction in billing disputes and revenue leakage
+ DSO / collections performance
+ Cloud cost optimization and FinOps outcomes
+ Effective utilization of OEM and technology partner capabilities
+ Consistent achievement of SLA/KPI and service performance objectives
+ Reduction in recurring incidents and operational risk
+ Improved cloud reliability, security and resilience
+ Successful delivery of modernization and transformation roadmaps
+ Improved automation and operational efficiency
+ Strong collaboration and performance across cross-functional delivery teams

4a8afd59.title: AS400 Architect
4a8afd59.description:
We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400) reverse-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business-rule extraction, data-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source-code handling requirements, data-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400) technologies, with 5+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS-to-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business-rule extraction, and data-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher

d6c5b7aa.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
d6c5b7aa.description:
We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for a multi-tier B2B commerce environment, spanning the WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS versus move to Next.js and services, while safeguarding routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and setting cut-over and rollback procedures
* Produce and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), catching reusability, performance, security, and operability concerns prior to build
* Work closely with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements gathering, data conversion, integration testing, and cut-over execution
* Define coding and design standards across Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and the Next.js storefront so squads stay consistent
* Steer integration with back-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), preserving a clear boundary between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer-facing) Commerce environments
* Evaluate designs and pull requests spanning Commerce, services, and storefront layers, and trace complex cross-layer defects back to their root cause
* Offer guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure handling for a high-traffic B2B storefront
* Mentor senior engineers and leads, capturing architecture decisions along with their context, options considered, and consequences to maintain continuity
* Pinpoint major obstacles and use structured problem-solving techniques to tackle complex, multi-system issues

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Between 12 and 20 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 5 years serving as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large-scale commerce or comparably complex multi-tier systems
* At least 8 years of hands-on expertise with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8.x, including store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization workflows, and back-end integration
* At least 8 years of expertise in Java / J2EE and object-oriented design for large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server experience
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with practical Spring Boot architecture experience covering service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years of experience building web services (REST and SOAP), including the ability to define contracts that other teams can implement against
* Hands-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance optimization; TypeScript experience is preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with Git experience required
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organization/user models, and complex contract/pricing logic
* Experience delivering work through Agile methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and iPaaS platforms such as MuleSoft
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching systems (Redis or similar), and CMS-powered storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) supporting storefront and Spring Boot deployments, plus WAS/IHS for Commerce
* Solid grasp of security practices, PCI-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual-run initiatives or large-scale commerce migration efforts

ec2381ae.title: Director, HR Domain Architect
ec2381ae.description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Director, HR Domain Architect defines and governs the architectural framework for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, ensuring that technology decisions support business goals and enable the successful delivery of domain Products, such as Workday, Payroll & Time, etc. The role partners with senior stakeholders to guide solution direction, establish domain standards and principles, and provide architectural leadership across solutions delivered within the domain. The HR Digital & Tech Domain Architect ensures that products are designed in a way that is scalable, interoperable, and aligned to agreed business and technology objectives.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Define and maintain the architectural framework, standards, and schematics for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, including domain-specific principles, patterns, data flows, and interface models.
* Introduce and govern a Domain Standards Catalogue (e.g., principles, reference patterns, SLAs, reusable assets), ensuring lifecycle ownership, version control, and adoption across delivery teams.
* Partner with senior Business and IT stakeholders to guide domain technology decisions, ensuring alignment to business goals, risk appetite, and product delivery priorities.
* Partner with VP Global HR D&T, Data and Digital Enablement Director and HR Tech Tower Leads to define long term architecture simplification and consolidation strategy
* Partner with HR Tech Delivery Director on key architecture decisions and delivery of top priority projects
* Lead business case development for new technology investments, ensuring alignment with key stakeholders and funding submission.
* Provide architectural guidance to Solution Architects and delivery teams, enabling consistent design approaches; define reusable domain contracts and interface specifications with versioning, observability, and interoperability requirements.
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts for the domain (e.g., reference architectures, models, integration schematics, contract definitions, security patterns) required to support delivery and operational readiness.
* Support compliance and governance processes (e.g. Architecture Review Board, Change Advisory Board), including architecture review checkpoints, exemption criteria, design sign-off, and updates to the domain technical debt register.
* Assess architectural compliance and technical debt trends within the domain, contributing actionable recommendations to improve scalability, reliability, maintainability, and product lifecycle sustainability.
* Maintain a regular cadence with Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise AI, Cyber Security, and Product Teams to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design challenges, and support enterprise-level use cases and digital ecosystem interoperability.
* Track and report key architecture KPIs for the domain (e.g., pattern adoption, application rationalisation, exemptions closed, technical debt reduction, readiness score, contract/interface reuse index).
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* 19 to 25 years in architecture or technical design roles, including experience applying architecture principles within a product or domain context.
* Demonstrated ability to define architectural patterns, standards, or frameworks.
* Experience reviewing and guiding solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural requirements.
* Practical experience documenting domain models, interface specifications, and other architectural artefacts.
* Exposure to evaluating technology decisions and advising stakeholders with clear architectural rationale.
* Experience collaborating with business and product teams to anchor architecture to value and delivery needs.
* HR Domain experience
* Experience on workday, skills platform, learning platforms, SAP SuccessFactors, Microsoft azure.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., TOGAF, cloud certifications).
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong analytical and conceptual modelling skills.
* Ability to communicate architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to challenge and influence design decisions constructively.
* Strong documentation and design-modelling skills.
* Awareness of emerging technologies and ability to apply them within the context.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change
* Very detailed oriented
  

**Skills**

Architecture Governance, HR Systems Implementation, Human Resources (HR) Technology Solution Integrations, Human Resources Integration, Reference Architectures, Solution Architecture, Stakeholder Management, The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), Workday HCM  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com , so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

54f55fe6.title: Presales Solutions Architect
54f55fe6.description:
**About SmartWinnr**

 

SmartWinnr is an enterprise-grade sales enablement platform that helps organizations build sales readiness through AI sales roleplay, coaching, and certification at scale. The platform serves Fortune 500 clients including Boston Scientific, Johnson & Johnson, and AstraZeneca, along with other major companies such as Abbott, Medtronic, HDFC Life, SBI Life, ICICI Prudential, and Aditya Birla to boost sales productivity. SmartWinnr has earned recognition from G2 as one of the top 50 sales products for two consecutive years, based on authentic customer reviews and feedback.

**Job Role:**

Pre-Sales Solutions Architect

**Job Location:**

Hyderabad (On-site)

**About the role**

SmartWinnr is looking for a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect who can bridge the gap between customer business requirements and our product capabilities. This role requires excellent communication and presentation skills, along with strong expertise in sales documentation and proposal development.

You will work closely with the sales team to demonstrate SmartWinnr's platform to prospective customers, including senior leadership, understand their requirements, and prepare compelling proposals, commercial documents, and responses to RFPs/RFQs.

The role also involves coordinating the review of customer agreements, setting up demo accounts, and creating customized presentations and other sales materials based on business discussions. We are looking for someone who can communicate confidently with enterprise customers, manage documentation accurately, and support the sales team throughout the sales cycle.

**What you will own**

* **Product demonstrations and presentations.**

  Deliver engaging product demos to prospective customers, including senior leadership. Understand customer requirements and tailor demonstrations to relevant business use cases and expected outcomes.

* **Demo account setup.**

  Set up, configure, and maintain demo accounts and environments before customer meetings. Ensure the product is ready for demonstrations and aligned with the prospect's requirements

* **Proposal documentation.**

  Prepare professional proposals, solution documents, presentations, commercial proposals, and other sales-related documentation based on customer discussions and business requirements.

* **RFP/RFQ responses.**

  Review Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and customer questionnaires. Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information and ensure complete, high-quality submissions within deadlines.

* **MSA/NDA vetting and coordination.**

  Review customer Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for completeness, identify non-standard clauses or deviations, and coordinate with the Legal team and relevant stakeholders for review and approval.

* **Commercial documentation.**

  Prepare quotations, pricing summaries, commercial proposals, and supporting documents in coordination with the sales and finance teams. Ensure accuracy and alignment with approved commercial terms.

* **Sales decks and supporting materials.**

  Create and customize presentation decks, solution overviews, and other sales collateral based on business discussions, prospect requirements, and sales opportunities.

﻿

* **Cross-functional collaboration.**

  Work closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to gather information, validate product capabilities, address customer queries, and support deal progression.

**What we are looking for**

* 2+ years of relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, sales support, or a similar role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to enterprise customers and senior leadership.
* Strong presentation skills and the ability to explain product features, use cases, and business value clearly.
* Experience preparing proposals, presentations, commercial documents, and other customer-facing sales materials.
* Ability to understand business discussions and translate customer requirements into structured documentation and compelling presentations.
* Strong attention to detail when preparing and reviewing documents.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and other tools used for sales documentation.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate documentation within tight deadlines.
* A proactive, organized, and ownership-driven approach to work.

**Useful but not required**

* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, sales enablement, or enterprise SaaS sales.
* Experience conducting software product demonstrations for enterprise customers.
* Familiarity with RFP/RFQ processes, commercial proposals, and enterprise procurement requirements.
* Exposure to MSA/NDA review and contract coordination.
* Experience with CRM platforms, proposal management tools, and document collaboration systems.
* Understanding of SaaS business models and enterprise sales cycles.

**What this role is not**

This is not purely a product demonstration or presentation role. It requires equal attention to sales documentation, commercial proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, and coordination of customer agreements.

The person will be expected to contribute hands-on to preparing documents, setting up demo accounts, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting the sales team in moving opportunities forward.

**Things worth knowing before you apply**

You will work closely with the sales team and engage with prospective enterprise customers. Strong communication, presentation skills, documentation accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple sales-related activities are essential to succeeding in this role.

The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working on-site.

We're looking for a **Platform Architecture & E**​**ngineering Lead** to architect, build, and scale RushCiti from the ground up.
