a9fa097f.description:
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Experience: 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, LLM application development, Generative AI, platform architecture, solution architecture, or technical product development.**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Agentic AI Platform Architect & Product Lead**
to drive the development and evolution of the Fluid AIQ Platform and lead AI-powered application development for upcoming client projects.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building production-ready applications using LLMs, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool/function calling, workflow orchestration, and modern AI frameworks.

This role goes beyond traditional chatbot development, focusing on building intelligent agentic applications capable of reasoning, planning, interacting with enterprise systems, using tools, and operating within defined guardrails.

The position combines AI architecture, hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and product commercialization. You will help transform platform capabilities into modular commercial offerings that can be deployed independently and expanded based on client requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Agentic AI Architecture & Platform Development

* Design scalable architectures for agentic AI applications, including single-agent and multi-agent systems.
* Define agent orchestration, tool usage, memory, state management, and workflow patterns.
* Establish reusable reference architectures, implementation guides, client onboarding playbooks, and engineering standards.
* Evaluate AI technologies, models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to the evolution and architecture of the Fluid AIQ Platform.

2. AI Application Development

* Build production-ready applications using AI agents, LLMs, RAG, and workflow automation.
* Implement tool/function calling, planning and reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop processes.
* Develop integrations with enterprise APIs, business applications, and external systems.
* Implement MCP Server/Client integrations and autonomous or semi-autonomous workflows.
* Build AI-powered decision-support solutions and reusable platform components.

3. LLM & Generative AI Engineering

* Work with LLM providers and models, including OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, and open-source or local models.
* Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, function calling, and model fallback strategies.
* Evaluate and benchmark models based on cost, performance, latency, privacy, and business use cases.
* Ensure flexibility in model and framework selection without unnecessary platform dependency on a single provider.

4. Product Leadership & Commercialization

* Take technical and product ownership of Fluid platform components and client AI programs.
* Help package platform capabilities into independent, commercially viable modules.
* Support the commercialization of reusable platform capabilities and technical IP.
* Develop sales-enablement materials and implementation guidance.
* Track and report platform health, adoption, and delivery metrics to leadership.

5. AI Safety, Reliability & Governance

* Implement guardrails and validation mechanisms to reduce hallucinations, incorrect tool usage, unauthorized actions, and unsafe outputs.
* Design human-approval workflows where required.
* Build reliable agent workflows with error handling, retries, fallback mechanisms, and observability.
* Support release management, environment management, service-level objectives, and production support models.
* Address security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements.

6. Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead and mentor architects and engineers working on agentic AI solutions.
* Collaborate with architecture, development, and cross-functional teams.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and build proof of concepts (POCs).
* Ensure solutions meet business requirements, quality standards, and delivery timelines.

Mandatory Technical Skills

**Agentic AI & Generative AI**

* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, context management, and AI evaluation.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, multi-agent systems, agent memory and state, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Understanding of agent guardrails, reliability, and observability.

**Programming & Application Development**

* Strong programming skills in at least one of the following: Python or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization, asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, and database integration.

**AI Frameworks & SDKs**

* Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI SDK, Anthropic SDK, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agent SDKs.
* Ability to evaluate and select frameworks based on solution requirements rather than relying on a single technology.

**LLM Integration**

* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers, preferably OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama/open-source LLMs.

**Data Engineering & RAG**

* Experience with PostgreSQL, vector databases, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar technologies.
* Knowledge of embedding models, document processing, semantic search, and hybrid search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and ontology design, including Neo4j, RDF/OWL, or GraphRAG.
* Understanding of multi-tenant data architecture.

**Cloud Platforms**

* Strong experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
* Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.
* Ollama and open-source LLMs.
* Multimodal AI, Voice AI, and AI workflow automation.
* AI observability, evaluation platforms, and model evaluation.
* Fine-tuning, AI security, prompt-injection protection, and PII/data protection.
* Enterprise SaaS, CRM, and ERP integrations.
* AI FinOps and FinOps Foundation practices.
* Cloud marketplace listings, including Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace.
* Product management experience and experience commercializing consulting IP as licensed software.
* Experience replacing or complementing traditional RPA solutions with AI-agent-based approaches.

What We're Looking For

* A hands-on technical leader who can translate business requirements into scalable agentic AI solutions.
* Someone who can combine architecture, engineering, platform development, and product thinking.
* A professional capable of taking AI capabilities from proof of concept to production-ready and commercially deployable solutions.
* Strong communication, technical decision-making, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.

**Interested in building production-grade Agentic AI platforms and bringing AI-powered products to market? Apply now!**

a72241fb.description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.
  
  
For this position, we are specifically looking for a candidate with strong Cloud, Linux, and automation experience who can complement the networking and firewall expertise already existing within the team and support AlgoSec's continued evolution toward SaaS, cloud-based capabilities, and AI integrations.

* Guide customers, partners, and Sales Engineers through technical issues and product-related questions.

c6e77ebc.title: Program Manager - Technology
c6e77ebc.description:
**Company Description**

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.

This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.

You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.

Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**

**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

c544ce7b.title: Backend - Associate Technical Architect /Lead
c544ce7b.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with strong expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, AWS, and Kubernetes to design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance microservices supporting consumer-facing applications.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building GraphQL APIs using Apollo Server/Federation, modernizing legacy applications, integrating third-party services, and managing production workloads on AWS EKS.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

Responsibilities

* **GraphQL subgraphs:** Design, build and own Apollo Federation subgraphs for realtor.com consumer experiences such as home search, listing and property details, saved homes and leads. They plug into a company-wide supergraph used by web and mobile apps.
* **Modernization:** Move legacy services onto TypeScript microservices and federated GraphQL without changing behaviour. Use data-compare testing and feature-flagged rollouts.
* **Integrations:** Connect with listing and property-data providers, geo and location services, identity (Auth0), messaging platforms and lead partners. Build in strong validation, retries and idempotency.
* **Data and caching:** Model and tune relational data access, including read/write splits. Use Redis/Valkey for caching and rate limiting so high-traffic consumer experiences and marketing campaigns stay fast and resilient.
* **Async workflows:** Build event-driven and background processing with Kafka and job schedulers.
* **Production ownership:** Run services on Kubernetes (K8s) on AWS EKS using the platform team's paved paths: Docker images, CircleCI builds, Helm charts and ArgoCD GitOps deployments. Own K8s Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps/Secrets, Ingress, liveness/readiness probes, resource requests/limits, PodDisruptionBudgets and HPA/KEDA autoscaling. Monitor with New Relic and Splunk, join the on-call and incident rotation, and keep quality gates green.

Must have

* 5+ years of backend engineering, including 3+ years of TypeScript/Node.js in production.
* Strong GraphQL experience (Apollo Server; Federation preferred), schema design, DataLoader and avoiding N+1 queries.
* Hands-on Kubernetes (K8s) experience running production services on AWS EKS: Docker, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps/Secrets, probes, resource limits and autoscaling (HPA).
* Comfortable debugging in K8s with kubectl: pod logs, restarts, OOMKills, rollouts and rollbacks.
* Experience with Helm charts and GitOps deployment (ArgoCD or similar) through CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI or similar).
* Strong SQL: MySQL or similar relational databases, query tuning, transactions, primary/replica patterns.
* Hands-on caching experience with Redis or Valkey: key design, TTLs, cache stampede and failure handling.
* REST and third-party API integration; JWT/OAuth; secure handling of PII.
* Testing discipline (Jest or similar) and CI/CD experience.
* Able to debug distributed systems under production load.

Good to have

* Experience modernizing legacy services (e.g. Java) into microservices.
* Kafka or other event streaming; event-driven autoscaling with KEDA.
* Real-estate, marketplace or lead-generation domain experience.
* Exposure to AI/LLM integrations or ML-powered features (search, recommendations).
* Data platforms and pipelines (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow).
* AWS Lambda/serverless; infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* New Relic or other APM, distributed tracing, SonarCloud.
* API gateways (Tyk or similar), Traefik ingress, ExternalDNS.
* Experience working on an internal developer platform / paved-path model (shared Helm library charts, service templates, self-service deployments).
* Splunk log analysis; dependency automation with Renovate; Artifactory.
* Experimentation and analytics tooling (Amplitude, Optimizely).

The solution architect plays a lead role during the implementation, identifying and documenting client business requirements, mapping and configuring the Zuora solution to meet the client’s requirements and providing guidance to the client to achieve a successful implementation. They must identify potential issues and risks early in an implementation to develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans. A solid candidate will have an innate ability to simplify complex technology concepts and to plan, prioritize and seamlessly integrate all moving parts to deploy successful solutions.
  
  
This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely while occasionally getting together with your team for office visits, events, or offsites. Of course, you’re welcome to come into the office more often if you’re nearby.
  
  
**What You’ll Achieve**

* Solution design using the full Zuora product portfolio
* Design and validate that the proposed solution architecture supports the stated and implied business requirements
* Review technical team deliverables for compliance with architecture standards, guidelines and leverages best practices
* Articulate and present different point of views on various technologies
* Present Architecture deliverables such as Ecosystem and Integration diagrams, ERD, Business Process Flows, Swim lanes, Visio and Mock-ups

850bde59.title: AI Solution Architect
850bde59.description:
Hitachi Energy is seeking a highly motivated and experienced **AI Architect** to define and lead the architecture of enterprise-grade AI solutions. This role requires deep expertise in AI/ML, cloud platforms, data architecture, and solution governance to design scalable, secure, and business-aligned AI platforms and products. You will work closely with product teams, engineering leaders, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into robust architecture blueprints and implementation roadmaps.

  

**How you will make an impact**

* **AI Architecture Strategy**
  + Define end-to-end architecture for AI solutions across domains such as generative AI, predictive analytics, NLP, and computer vision.
  + Develop architecture blueprints, reference patterns, and standards for scalable, secure, and reusable AI platforms.
  + Ensure alignment between AI solution architecture, enterprise architecture principles, and business objectives.
* **Solution Design & Governance**
  + Lead architecture decisions covering data pipelines, model integration, API design, orchestration, deployment patterns, and observability.
  + Establish design governance, conduct architecture reviews, and ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI requirements.
* **Collaboration & Stakeholder Advisory**
  + Partner with product, engineering, data, and business teams to translate business needs into architecture designs and implementation roadmaps.
  + Provide architectural guidance to solution architects, engineers, and project teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* **Technical Leadership**
  + Guide best practices for AI/ML engineering, MLOps, model lifecycle management, and platform scalability.
  + Drive the adoption of reusable architectural components, design patterns, and engineering standards across AI programs.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in technology roles, with significant experience in AI/ML solution architecture and enterprise platform design.
* Strong expertise in Python, AI/ML frameworks, data architecture, APIs, and system integration patterns.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP), MLOps, containerization, and scalable deployment architectures.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions.

  

The minimum salary for this position in the location specified below is as follows:

**For Italy Milan**: starting from **52 700** Euros gross per year as minimum salary

The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures.

This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage.

Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:

* Competitive salary and incentives
* Well-being and care
* Paid and unpaid leave
* Flexible work options
* Benefits that support your financial security

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

8efc1474.title: Senior Solution Architect AI Solutions PreSales
8efc1474.description:
This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Advisory and Thought Partnership**

* Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
* Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
* Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
* Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
* Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.

**Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response**

* Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
* Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
* Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
* Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.

**Proposal and RFP Development**

* Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
* Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
* Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
* Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
* Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
* Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.

**Solution Design and Architecture**

* Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
* Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
* Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
* Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
* Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
* Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
* Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
* Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
* Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
* Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
* Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.

**Prototyping and Demonstrations**

* Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
* Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
* Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.

**Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
* Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
* Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
* Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience** in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
* Proven expertise architecting **large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms**, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
* Hands-on experience delivering **production-grade AI solutions**, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
* Strong understanding of **Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
* Proven ability to lead **technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids**, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
* Experience with **enterprise learning technology** including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
* Excellent **technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum**, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
* **Bachelors degree** in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and **TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture** certification or equivalent experience preferred.

  

Disclaimer: You *must take the necessary steps to safeguard the integrity, security, and confidentiality of shared confidential information*

  

**Please share your resumes at sonal.ambavkar@hurix.com to know more.**

027d484e.description:

===========================

As Senior Staff Data & Information Architect for GE's Oracle ERP platforms, you will own the architecture, reliability, performance, security, and lifecycle management of enterprise E-Business Suite database platforms. In this role, you will lead and mentor the Oracle EBS DBA vendor team while partnering with Application Operations, Product Development, and Infrastructure teams to deliver highly available, secure, and cost-effective EBS DBA services — continuously advancing best practices across the organization.

**Job Description**
===================

**Site Overview**

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.

**Role Overview:**

* The ideal candidate should be process oriented and have a collaborative working-style to help accelerate the implementation of the digital platforms supporting one of the world's largest, digital software businesses.
* Lead the EBS DBA support for critical ERP environments hosted in Oracle Cloud, supporting 24x7 global sites.
* Establish data governance and issue management processes.
* Partner with application operations, product development, and infrastructure teams to deliver highly available, secure, cost-effective EBS DBA services, advancing best practices and formulate strategy as related to data, analytics, and business metrics.
* Actively work with the Digital IT leadership group to implement enterprise data strategies.
* Actively work with cross functional teams, management and key stake holders to program manage, review progress and functional delivery on a regular committed basis.
* Responsible for deploying digital technology products as required to achieve business functionalities.
* Reduce operational cycle time and drive simplification through implementation to automation solutions
* Manage architecture and operations activates to ensure ERP compute infrastructure is used efficiently and produces a long – term business benefit.
* Maintain and apply current knowledge of information technology; keep abreast of new and emerging technologies and help determine if/how they can be used to add value to the business.
* Participate in budget management responsibilities and inputs info financial planning and other business activities.

Ideal Candidate:

  

* Ideal candidate should have minimum 15Years of experience in technical area and ands on experience as Oracle Application DBA

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master's Degree in Computer Science or in “STEM” Majors (Science, technology, Engineering and Math). A minimum of 15 years of professional experience in a technical area (Architecture, Software, or Information technology).
* 7 + years of “Hands-On” experience as Oracle Application DBA supporting infrastructure, database, and technology stack components for e-Business Suite platforms in a large global organization, including 5 years in leading DBA support/projects for large Oracle ERP.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Knowledge of Oracle EBS 12.2.3 or above including installations, configuration, Apps DBA, Sysadmin, PSU/CPU, patching, Backup/Restore/Cloning, Autonomous Database and EBS NextGen Technology stack.
* Experience of Oracle EBS Maximum Availability Architecture, Data archiving/re-org, Oracle IDCS, setting up Fusion Middle Ware for ECC/Demantra, DNS setups, Java certificates, encryption keys, SFTP setups.
* Experience with setting up EBS integrations like AppWorx, PPM, PVCS, Oracle Application Express.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure knowledge.
* Web Server expertise – Fusion Middleware 12 and 14 (EBS/Apex/IDCS Asserter/ECC/Demantra) – Server installation and Maintenance and Web Admin responsibilities.
* Custom Application Maintenance and management including installations, problem analysis, problem resolution, configuration, and performance tuning
* Experience with Unix shell and PL/SQL scripting for managing databases, applications, backups/restore/Clones

**Business Acumen:**

* Ability to establish credibility and influence Executives, technical and non-technical team members
* Demonstrate business acumen and the ability to apply technology solutions to solve business problems.
* Understanding of Change Management processes in a large IT environment
* Familiarity with iterative development methodologies

**Personal Attributes:**

* Energetic, technical innovator who will bring their expertise along with a keen drive to learn new technologies.
* Possess an operational mindset to build out processes to digitize operations
* Ability to hit tight deadlines and work under pressure
* Strong interpersonal skills: verbal, written and listening
* Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and drive
* Demonstrated customer focus - evaluate decisions through the eyes of the customer.
* Build strong customer relationships and create processes with customer viewpoints.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. 43e7b3ad.title: Sr. Delivery Lead
43e7b3ad.description:
**Job Title: Data Product Lead/ Manager**

**What you will do**

The future is being built today, and Johnson Controls is making that future more productive, secure, and sustainable. We are harnessing the power of cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and user design thinking to deliver on the promise of intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better & safer.

Data Team is a diverse team of technology enthusiast enabling our global business. Data Product Manager is an integral part of the Data team. This role will be based out of India, reporting into Senior Data Product Manager. He/she will be responsible for defining the delivery and support for applications utilizing Snowflake, Azure and related data tools. As a Data Product Manager, you are responsible for managing Data Product Delivery and Support team. This role requires strong relationships with business stakeholders and key staff members to clearly understand the overall business objectives and functional process requirements. This role is responsible for translating the business requirements into an functional data product. This position must be able to work across organizational boundaries to manage the successful execution of projects and initiatives, ensuring on schedule, on-quality, and on-budget project performance. This role will provide oversight and direction to the data product delivery staff aligned to each project. You will be liaising with other IT departments, gather cost/ time estimates and propose these to the business customers giving them a full overview on cost, process, and timings.

* Ensure functional and technical governance is in place.
* Coordinate with Business Partners/ Business Analysts, Project Managers, Technical Architects and CoE teams for the successful delivery
* Maintain ‘state of the art’ technical and functional expertise in the assigned areas of responsibility.

* Support the analysis of designs, developing, testing and implementing changes to the Data product.
* Lead the results of the testing cycle of system design changes prior to migrating to Production environment.
* Cooperate with Release Manager to resolve readiness and deployment schedule of the data product modifications or enhancements.
* Supports the solution migration strategy for moving changes between environments.
* Work with the external application vendors on issue resolution, enhancements, and improvements.
* Act as liaison between Corp IT and the business teams.
* Partner with ePMO, Delivery organization & IT business partners to ensure tight governance, high velocity & cost-efficient delivery of Data Solutions.
* Demonstrate an understanding of concepts, best practices & functions to implement Data Solutions.
* Connect with management to limit any uncontrolled expansion of work.
* Drive values & behaviors to ensure compliance, integrity & financial commitment.
* Work with remote-working teams based globally.

**What we look for**

* BE/ B.Tech in Software Engineering/Computer Science or similar
* Overall, 10+ years of professional experience.
* 15+ yrs. of hands-on experience using various development methodologies to deliver Data Solutions on the data platform. Snowflake experience is preferred.
* Validated expertise of the following:
  + Big Data Analytics, Cloud Data platforms
* Proven record in multiple successful deliveries of data solution projects in all sizes.
* Success in leading & mentoring diverse teams.
* Experience working on projects with Integrations or data warehouse.
* Highly organized with strong prioritization and documentation skills
* Outstanding communication, written and interpersonal skills.
* Strong leadership, influencing & collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching & mentoring individuals and teams.

**Essential Skills**

* Manage resolution of interpersonal conflicts and issues beyond the team’s authority to keep team passionate about goals and objectives, within a highly global matrix setup.
* Foster a culture of technical discipline, craftsmanship, and innovation.
* Drive continuous improvement by facilitating team retrospectives, teaching problem-solving techniques, and driving greater accountability among team members.
* Hold accountability for team’s commitments, and in cases of failure, communicate failure points, repercussions, and mitigating plans.

* Understanding trends, new concepts, industry standards and new technologies in Data and Analytics space
* Ability to work with global distributed teams.
* Ability to effectively function in a global cross-team environment.

34b528c3.title: Senior Solution Lead, SAP IBP Cloud Solution
34b528c3.description:
The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for developing solution design and build for integrated systems within the enterprise SAP IBP Cloud solution area and corresponding set of applications. In this role the Sr. Solution lead will partner with Business Analysts and Technical Analysts to understand the overall business need, define overarching requirements and create high-level design specifications, ensuring feasibility, functionality, and integration with existing systems/platforms and develop an overarching architectural design and model that will support Stryker’s business needs. The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for verifying the detailed technical documents, validating the configuration within the assigned applications, and ensuring solutions are delivered based on the architected design.
  
  
The individual should be an expert with SAP IBP Cloud solution and it’s roadmap, that includes IBP Demand, Supply Planning, Response (Allocation) and other IBP Modules. And he/she must have 2-3 full cycle implementation experience with IBP Response solutions, including Configure-To-Order and Make-To-Stock production strategies and thorough understanding/expertise in latest SAP Release with end-to-Order to Shipment and Business Logics (i.e. ATP rules) to support order allocation.
  
  
Individual should be experienced with IBP Business Processes that connect IBP system with other systems and have good knowledge on various workstreams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP IBP solutions, delivering integrated end-to-end planning capabilities across the enterprise.
* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert for SAP IBP, supporting solution design, build, testing, implementation, training, and global template development.
* Drive SAP IBP initiatives across key planning areas, including S&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, IBP Time Series, MRP, and Spare Parts Planning.
* Ensure all solution delivery activities align with established Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) standards, processes, and best practices.
* Review and govern business process documentation, functional and technical specifications, test strategies, and go-live readiness plans.
* Collaborate with global ERP teams, business stakeholders, IT partners, infrastructure teams, and deployment teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Partner with solution providers, process owners, architects, and key users to execute project deliverables and support deployment methodologies.
* Continuously optimize planning processes and system performance by identifying improvement opportunities and delivering scalable, business-aligned solutions, including support for quarterly SAP IBP releases and enhancements.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree (MBA, MIS, or equivalent) preferred.
* 10-13 years of experience delivering SAP full lifecycle implementations, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with SAP IBP and/or SAP APO, including integration across end-to-end planning and supply chain processes.
* Strong expertise in SAP IBP Cloud solutions, including configuration, business process design, and integration with procurement, inventory, sales, and related functions.
* Experience integrating SAP with SAP and non-SAP enterprise applications such as Ariba, ECC, Oracle, PRMS, MFG Pro, and other third-party systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions.
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile methodologies, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, with the ability to work across data, integration, security, and reporting domains.
* Demonstrated success collaborating within global, cross-functional, and matrixed organizations, ideally within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

**Microsoft Cloud Native Solution Architect**

Next Gen Application Engineering Practice |

General Overview / Role Expectations

The role is responsible for shaping, architecting and governing enterprise application solutions across the Microsoft technology ecosystem, with strong emphasis on cloud-native engineering, application modernization, DevSecOps and AI-enabled transformation.

The ideal candidate combines deep architecture expertise with strong customer-facing, presales and delivery leadership capabilities. The architect should be able to translate business requirements into secure, scalable and commercially viable solution architectures, lead RFP and proposal responses, support solution estimation and confidently present recommendations to customer stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities

* Drive architecture decisions covering application, integration, API, data, security, identity, observability, deployment and operational considerations.
* Lead technical discovery workshops, requirement analysis, architecture assessments and solution option evaluations with customers and delivery teams.
* Create architecture artefacts including context, logical, deployment, integration, security and data-flow views, along with architecture decision records.
* Guide engineering teams on cloud-native patterns, API-first design, containerization, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing and production readiness.
* Identify technical risks, assumptions, dependencies and constraints, and define practical mitigation plans.
* Contribute to reusable frameworks, accelerators, reference architectures and intellectual property for the Next Gen Application Engineering Practice.

Presales, RFP and Customer Engagement Responsibilities

* Design Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions covering data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, grounding, prompt orchestration and response validation.

* Address responsible AI, privacy, security, data residency, access control, content safety, observability, evaluation and human-in-the-loop requirements.
* Guide teams in responsible use of GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI coding assistants, including validation of AI-generated code for quality, security and maintainability.

Required Skills and Experience

* 15+ years of experience in enterprise application engineering, including 3+ years in solution architecture or technical architecture roles.
* Strong expertise in C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, microservices and modern application architecture patterns.
* Good understanding of React or Angular and full-stack application architecture.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server and/or Oracle, data modelling and application data integration patterns.
* Hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure services such as App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure SQL, Key Vault, Entra ID, Monitor and Application Insights.
* Experience with containers, Docker, Kubernetes / AKS and cloud-native deployment approaches.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing and DevSecOps practices.
* Demonstrated experience in customer-facing solutioning, presales, RFP responses, estimation and technical presentations.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking and architecture documentation skills.

* Working knowledge of Python and AI application development frameworks.
* Hands-on exposure to Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, RAG, vector databases, semantic search and Agentic AI patterns.
* Knowledge of domain-driven design, event-driven architecture, API management, and platform engineering.
* Experience with architecture assessment frameworks, SRE practices, SLIs / SLOs and operational readiness.
* Exposure to multi-cloud architectures across Azure and AWS.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Developer Associate or Azure AI Engineer Associate.

Success Profile

* A credible technology leader who can connect customer priorities with practical architecture and delivery decisions.
* A hands-on architect who can guide engineering teams and independently resolve complex solution challenges.
* A commercially aware presales contributor who can create differentiated, realistic and defensible solutions.
* An AI-aware architect who balances innovation with enterprise security, governance, responsible AI and operational readiness.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust across customers, presales, consulting, delivery and partner ecosystems.

About & Next Gen Application Engineering Practice

The Next Gen Application Engineering Practice within the Digital Business Unit focuses on modern application development, cloud-native engineering, application modernization, platform engineering, DevSecOps, intelligent automation and AI-powered software delivery.

f39fa86c.title: Global Service Delivery Manager
f39fa86c.description:
**Role Overview**

The Global Field Services Manager is responsible for leading two core functions: Local EUC and EUC Services. Local EUC provides onsite and regional technology support across corporate offices, retail locations, airport sites, vaults, data centre locations and other operational environments. EUC Services acts as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability, responsible for workstation endpoint, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, mobile device management, device lifecycle management, endpoint compliance and other centrally controlled EUC services.

The successful candidate will provide strong operational leadership across both functions, ensuring that onsite support and centrally managed EUC services are responsive, secure, consistent and aligned to global IT design standards. The role will work closely with Global Service Delivery, Network Operations, Infrastructure, Security, Retail Operations, Facilities, Change Management, vendors and country leadership teams to ensure local and central EUC services remain stable, supportable and fit for business use.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of this role is to provide global leadership for the Local EUC and EUC Services functions, ensuring Travelex colleagues and operational sites receive consistent, high-quality onsite technology support while also benefiting from a robust, centrally managed third-line EUC service. The role will drive standardisation, accountability, lifecycle discipline, endpoint compliance and continual service improvement across both regional field support and centrally managed EUC capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Field Services Leadership**

* Lead the Global Field Services function across two core capabilities: Local EUC and EUC Services.
* Define and maintain the global operating model for both functions, including roles, responsibilities, escalation paths, service standards, technical ownership boundaries and governance routines.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services operate as an integrated support model, with clear hand-offs between onsite support, second-line support, third-line engineering and central service ownership.
* Ensure services are delivered consistently across regions, while allowing controlled local adaptation where business, regulatory or operational requirements justify it.
* Act as the senior escalation point for field services and EUC service issues impacting business operations, colleague productivity, retail trading, endpoint compliance or site readiness.
* Develop a high-performing, customer-focused and accountable global field services culture across both local and central EUC teams.

**Local EUC and Workplace Technology Support**
----------------------------------------------

* Own the delivery of onsite support for end-user devices, workplace technology and local infrastructure across global sites.
* Ensure effective support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, printers, scanners, peripherals, meeting-room technology and approved business applications.
* Oversee executive and VIP support standards, ensuring responsive and professional service for senior stakeholders while maintaining consistent service principles for all users.
* Drive improvements in first-time fix, ageing ticket reduction, service quality, knowledge management and user experience.
* Work closely with EUC Services to ensure endpoint standards, deployment models and support playbooks are understood and adopted consistently by Local EUC and field teams.

**EUC Services and Third-Line Endpoint Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------

* Lead EUC Services as the third-line, centrally managed EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, standards, control and service reliability.
* Own central EUC responsibilities including OS hardening, patching, endpoint configuration, software packaging, software deployments, mobile device management, endpoint compliance and centrally managed EUC tooling.
* Ensure EUC Services defines and maintains global endpoint build standards, baseline configurations, deployment models, support playbooks and technical acceptance criteria.
* Provide technical escalation and engineering support for complex endpoint, operating-system, application deployment, MDM and device compliance issues that cannot be resolved through local or second-line support.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, IT Asset Management and Change Management to ensure endpoint services meet cyber, operational, lifecycle and compliance requirements.
* Drive automation, standardisation and proactive remediation across endpoint services, reducing manual effort and improving resilience, compliance and employee experience.

**Retail, Vault and Site Technology Operations**
------------------------------------------------

* Lead field services support for retail and operational site technology, including tills, workstations, rate boards, local connectivity, peripherals, branch technology, vault support equipment and other approved site devices.
* Ensure technology incidents affecting retail trading, customer-facing services, site openings or operational continuity receive appropriate priority and ownership.
* Partner with Retail Operations, Facilities, Network Operations, Infrastructure and Application Support teams to support site openings, relocations, refurbishments, closures and technology remediation activity.
* Maintain strong operational controls for hardware inventory, site records, local support documentation and technology acceptance evidence.
* Support the adoption of a global Retail Technology Blueprint, ensuring sites are assessed against agreed hardware, configuration, security, resilience and supportability standards.

**Endpoint Lifecycle, Asset, Configuration and Compliance Management**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Own the combined Local EUC and EUC Services execution model for endpoint build, deployment, replacement, recovery, decommissioning and disposal activities in line with global standards.
* Ensure accurate asset, stock, warranty, ownership, location, configuration and lifecycle information is maintained for equipment managed by field and EUC teams.
* Drive remediation of ageing, unsupported, duplicate, missing, non-compliant or under-utilised devices in partnership with IT Asset Management, Security and EUC Services.
* Oversee centrally managed EUC activities including operating-system upgrades, workstation changes, MDM adoption, software deployments, OS hardening, endpoint patching and endpoint compliance initiatives.
* Ensure Local EUC and EUC Services teams follow controlled processes for secure disposal, data protection, evidence capture, CMDB updates and compliance reporting.

**Service Management and Operational Governance**
-------------------------------------------------

* Ensure all field services work is managed through the ITSM platform with clear ownership, accurate categorisation, timely updates and complete resolution notes.
* Establish and monitor field services KPIs, including SLA performance, ticket age, backlog, repeat incidents, customer satisfaction, site readiness, asset accuracy and remediation progress.
* Contribute to incident, major incident, problem and change management processes where onsite support, local infrastructure or site technology is required.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring local technology issues.
* Create consistent governance routines, reporting packs and operational reviews for regional teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.

**Security, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------

* Ensure local technology services comply with Travelex security standards, endpoint configuration requirements, access control expectations and operational policies.
* Support vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, encryption, secure configuration, software compliance and device hygiene activities across the global site estate.
* Ensure suspected security incidents are escalated promptly and relevant evidence is preserved in line with incident response procedures.
* Support audit, risk, regulatory and compliance evidence requests relating to local technology, end-user devices, site equipment and field services processes.
* Promote a security-first culture within field teams, ensuring convenience and speed are balanced with appropriate control and risk management.

**Transformation, Automation and Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Lead field services participation in technology transformation programmes, including ITSM platform uplift, endpoint modernisation, site technology refreshes, security improvements and operational standardisation.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable support activities, improve self-service, enable shift-left support and reduce unnecessary onsite demand.
* Use service data, operational insight and regional feedback to drive measurable improvement in service quality, cost efficiency and operational resilience.
* Support global standardisation of workstation builds, site technology design, support documentation, deployment processes and operating procedures.
* Champion pragmatic innovation, including AI-enabled knowledge management, predictive support insights and improved field service scheduling where appropriate.

**Stakeholder, Supplier and Regional Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Build trusted relationships with country leadership, Retail Operations, Facilities, Technology teams, Service Delivery and third-party suppliers.
* Translate local operational needs into clear global requirements, ensuring local teams have a voice in central technology decisions.
* Manage regional escalations, service risks, resourcing pressures, supplier issues and delivery dependencies.
* Ensure vendor activity is governed effectively, including site access, quality assurance, documentation, service acceptance and escalation management.
* Provide clear and concise reporting to senior leadership on field services performance, risks, issues, priorities and improvement plans.

**Experience and Skills Required**
----------------------------------

**Essential Experience**
------------------------

* Significant experience leading field services, Local EUC, deskside support, EUC engineering, workplace technology or regional IT support functions in a complex multi-site organisation.
* Proven experience managing geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions or time zones.
* Strong understanding of retail technology support, corporate workplace technology, endpoint lifecycle management, local infrastructure support and centrally managed EUC services.
* Experience leading or working closely with a third-line EUC capability responsible for endpoint engineering, OS hardening, patching, software deployments, MDM, endpoint compliance and technical escalation.
* Experience operating within ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change and service transition processes.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows/MacOS endpoint environments, mobile device management, endpoint deployment, collaboration tools and workplace technologies.
* Experience managing operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, service reviews, governance forums and continuous improvement plans.
* Demonstrable experience supporting business-critical sites, including retail, airport, branch, vault, warehouse, operational or customer-facing environments.
* Experience working in a global, matrixed, multi-vendor technology environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior business, technology and regional leaders.

**Desirable Experience**
------------------------

aee92d5f.title: Head of Solutions
aee92d5f.description:
**Job Summary**

Title: Head of Solutions

Experience: 8+ years

Role Type: Full-time

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Works with: Sales and business development (US, UK, Canada), Delivery, Technology and Architecture, UX, Marketing

You will lead solutions at Net Solutions. You are the bridge between prospective clients and our delivery, technology and design teams: you run discovery, shape the solution, lead the proposal, and own the win. This is a senior role with a team behind it. You will have people supporting you on proposals, estimates and demos, so you can spend your time where it matters most: on calls with clients. Much of our pipeline comes from outbound and events in the US and UK, so a good part of the job is telling real opportunities from early conversations, and then leading the pitch yourself when it is real. Over time you will build the solution narrative, estimation discipline and sales enablement assets that make the next pitch better than the last.

Location: Chandigarh

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery with prospects: run discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews and solution workshops; map client pain points, business goals and current-state architecture; qualify opportunities with Sales.
* Design the solution: translate business requirements into solution architecture, scope, phasing and delivery approach, working with Technology, Delivery and UX.
* Own proposals end to end: write and present high-quality proposals, pitch decks, RFP, RFI and RFQ responses, Statements of Work (SoW), estimates and commercial models, with clear win themes and value propositions.
* Build the business case: quantify value, ROI and total cost of ownership for the client; frame trade-offs between build, buy and modernise.
* Lead executive conversations: present to C-level and VP-level buyers (CEO, CDO, CIO, CTO, VP Digital, VP eCommerce, Head of Procurement) and turn their priorities into executable programmes.
* Own the solution narrative: develop and maintain positioning, reference solutions and case studies across enterprise AI, product development, and eCommerce and retail.
* Run proof of concepts and demos: scope pilots, POCs and demos with the engineering team and use them to de-risk the sale.
* Build sales enablement: create battle cards, capability decks, pricing and estimation templates, proposal libraries and competitive positioning for the sales team.
* Bring the market in: track AI agents, agentic commerce, generative AI, headless and composable commerce, MACH architecture and platform roadmaps, and turn them into offers clients will buy.
* Feed the go-to-market engine: contribute offer design, ideal customer profile and messaging inputs to Marketing; keep opportunity data in HubSpot accurate.
* Raise the bar: define the solutions process, templates and quality standard; coach the sales and delivery teams on consultative selling and solution storytelling.

**What you bring**

* 8+ years of experience in presales, solutions consulting, solution architecture, bid management, management consulting or client engagement at an IT services, digital agency, product engineering or technology consulting firm, including at least 3 years leading presales or solutions for enterprise deals.
* A track record of winning complex, multi-stakeholder deals (US and above) with US or UK enterprise clients.
* Fluency across commerce and product engineering: eCommerce platforms, headless and composable architecture, cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP), integrations (ERP, PIM, OMS, CRM), legacy and application modernisation, and applied AI.
* Proven ability to run discovery, scope solutions and estimate effort with delivery teams; you can challenge an architect and a project manager on their numbers.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication: you write proposals and decks that executives read to the end, and you present with authority.
* Comfort leading conversations with C-level and VP-level stakeholders and translating business needs into technology solutions.
* Experience selling into or delivering for global markets, particularly the US and UK, and working across time zones with distributed teams.
* An entrepreneurial, owner mindset: you balance structure with speed, and you treat every pitch as your own business.
* MBA from a reputed institution, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on exposure to AI and ML products, LLM-based applications, AI agents, RAG, or data-driven transformation programmes.
* You use AI in your own work, for research, drafting and estimation, and you are curious about what it can do for a solutions team.
* Experience with CRM and proposal automation tools.
* Domain knowledge in SaaS, retail or eCommerce.
* Prior experience as a founder, consultant or engagement manager.

45631e6d.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.
* Experience in network infrastructure.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in technical program management, product lifecycle management, agile project management, enterprise networking, network infrastructure, network infrastructure devices.
* Experience in planning, designing and implementation change/transformational programs.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage and drive the delivery of network infrastructure programs/projects while leveraging automation and software programs by coordinating with global delivery teams across the company to facilitate efficient network services to customers.
* Manage third-party vendors responsible for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services, including facilitating any escalations requiring engineering assistance and develop comprehensive reports to track scope, schedule, budget, risks, and overall project status.
* Partner with network engineers, software engineers, and project managers to deliver large technical networking projects and Manage third-party vendors contracted for the monitoring and troubleshooting of network services. Facilitate the escalation of issues requiring engineering assistance with the vendors.
* Design and implement new delivery processes, enact process improvement measures, and ensure the efficient and reliable achievement of process objectives and optimize operational processes essential for maintaining business operations.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. a258d166.description:

Join us at Orange Business!
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. * You will drive the implementation and adoption of new presales tools and methodologies to enhance efficiency and customer engagement.
* You will represent the company at industry events and conferences, sharing insights and building relationships with key stakeholders.

Skills you will have the opportunity to develop through this position:
  
  
In this role, you will deepen your expertise in advanced network security and cybersecurity solutions while mastering the art of crafting tailored presales strategies. You will enhance your leadership and stakeholder management skills by leading cross-functional teams and engaging with high-profile clients. Additionally, you will gain valuable experience in market analysis and competitive positioning, sharpening your strategic thinking. This position also offers the opportunity to stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and industry trends, fostering continuous professional growth.
  
  
Desired profile/skills
  
  
You hold a Bachelor of Engineering or a graduate degree and bring 15+ years of experience in presales, network security, cybersecurity, and managed services.
  
  

* Deep knowledge of network security technologies and architectures
* Expertise in cybersecurity solutions and threat management
* Experience with managed services delivery and operations
* Proficiency in preparing technical proposals and presentations
* Strong adherence to processes and compliance standards

You are a confident communicator and a collaborative team player who thrives in dynamic environments. Your problem-solving mindset allows you to navigate complex challenges with agility and creativity. You demonstrate strong leadership and influence, inspiring trust and alignment among diverse stakeholders. Your customer-centric approach ensures that client needs are always at the forefront of your decisions. Finally, your adaptability and continuous learning mindset keep you ahead in a fast-evolving technology landscape.
  
  

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge cybersecurity technologies in a leading company.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment with a focus on professional development.
* Competitive salary package with benefits and opportunities for career advancement.

This position offers clear career progression opportunities, including advancement to senior leadership roles within the presales or sales organization. You will have the chance to broaden your expertise across different security domains and expand your influence by leading larger, more strategic client engagements. The company supports continuous learning and internal mobility, enabling you to shape your career path according to your ambitions.
  
  
You will be part of a dedicated and highly skilled India-centric team that values collaboration and local market expertise. The team fosters a supportive environment where knowledge sharing and mutual growth are encouraged, enabling you to thrive and make a significant impact in the West India region.
  
  
You bring open mindedness, ability to handle pressure, leading with courage and empathy, assertiveness and communicate effectively.

* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.

1458219a.description:
**About Darwinbox:**
Darwinbox is a cloud-based HR Technology platform which caters to an organization’s HR needs across the employee lifecycle including Recruitment, Onboarding, Core transactions (Leaves, Attendance, Directory), Payroll, Travel and Expenses, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Rewards & Recognition and People Analytics. The modern and innovative platform combines highly configurable workflows, intelligent insights and smart interfaces to help enterprises unleash the true potential of their workforce. Darwinbox is trusted by 650+ global enterprises with more than 1.5 million employees spread across 90+ countries including Asia’s largest conglomerates and fast-growing unicorns like Adani, Mahindra, Kotak, TVS, Arvind, JSW, NSE, Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Bharti AXA, Nivea, T-Systems, Swiggy, BigBasket, Delhivery and more. It is backed by leading investors like TCV, Salesforce Ventures, Sequoia, Lightspeed, Endiya Partners, 3One4Capital, SCB 10X and JGDEV.
  
  
More at www.darwinbox.com
  
  
**About the team:**
As a member of our diverse and skilled global solutioning team you will have the opportunity to don multiple hats and be challenged daily. This team is focused on enabling end-to-end HR digital transformation for our customers and is dedicated to working with customers to align their digital vision with their business strategy and supporting the plan to get there. On a typical day, you will be working as part of an agile team responsible for conducting discovery calls and product solutioning to help prospective clients transform and streamline their business to their fullest potential, using market data and strategic judgment to stay in front of our competitors. The HCM Solution Manager are responsible for partnering with the sales teams and deliver the Darwinbox value proposition to business users including the offices of the CHRO, CIO, and CFO. They play a critical role in the success of every sales pursuit we make. By leveraging deep HR functional expertise and comprehensive product knowledge the Solutions Consultant provides expert solutions through presentations, workshops, and product demonstrations to the customer throughout the sales cycle.
  
  
**What’s Expected of You:**

* Participate in discovery workshops with users to formulate and document business requirements, including business processes, procedures, and work practices.
* Assist in the development of winning and differentiating value propositions and themes/messaging to customers, in collaboration with the sales team.
* Develop and champion Darwinbox value-based solutions to client problems, communicate them with the customer, implementation partners and internal stakeholders. This may involve various formats/viewpoints, such as process flows, context diagrams, functional/technical descriptions and recordings and functional demonstrations.
* Lead RFP (Request for Proposal) responses and develop solution overviews that map customer’s business initiatives to the Darwinbox HCM solution.
* Prepare for and conduct winning demonstrations of the Darwinbox HCM solution to create impact in customer evaluation processes, while demonstrating the value proposition and customer expectations.
* Build expertise in specific industries and presenting the value of Darwinbox HCM solution to customers in those industries.
* Build trusted-advisor relationship with key customer stakeholders who are influencers and decision-makers in an evaluation process.
* Research and highlight the advantages of Darwinbox HCM and capability over legacy ERP and other SaaS systems.
* Continuously upgrade your skillsets and knowledge through the learning opportunities provided by Darwinbox.

**Who Should Apply?**

* 8yrs of experience in HCM Consulting / HRBP role.
* MBA/PGDM in HR or relevant work experience
* Value-based selling in an HCM Consulting environment
* Proven ability to work and effectively communicate with C-level executives and line of business representatives.
* Proven ability to understand client pain points and proposing solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
