8fa253cd.title: Solutions Architect (Genie)
8fa253cd.description:
FEQ327R421
  
  
**Mission**
The
**Solutions Architect (Genie)**
team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position
*in-depth*
the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.
  
  
The Solutions Architect (Genie) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.
  
  
**The impact you will have**

* Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.
* As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.
* Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.
* Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams
* Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

**Competencies & Responsibilities**

* 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.
* Credibility in influencing analytics, BI, and natural-language / agentic AI products, with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.
* Deep understanding of AI governance across different tools and models and ability to guide customers through security blockers and concerns
* Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.
* Experience architecting governed analytics solutions that integrate semantic models, data warehouses, and metric layers within broader Lakehouse and AI ecosystems.
* Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.
* Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.
* Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, AI, ML, governance, semantic modeling, natural-language analytics, and streaming.
* Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

3dfaec81.description:
**About The Position**
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data. Our unique architecture powers in-stream analytics without reliance on expensive indexing or hot storage. We specialize in comprehensive monitoring of logs, metrics, trace and security events with features such as APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring and more, all enhancing operational efficiency and reducing observability spend by up to 70%.
  
  
Solution Engineers in Coralogix are key in meeting our customers’ expectations and helping them utilize their observability and security data. We are looking for hard-working, sharp, and humble professionals with proven technical customer-facing experience. Our architects are trusted advisors and consult our customers upon their monitoring, security & observability journey.
  
  
Solution Engineer is expected to professionally and accurately present technical presentations across different personas, from software engineers and DevOps all the way to the C-suite.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with account executives to strategize, prepare, and execute on complex, technical sales cycles.
* Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations that highlight our unique value proposition and the solutions we provide.
* Oversee the technical aspects of the sales process, including sizing, discovering and Proof of Concepts.
* ⁠Develop custom solutions to bridge any gaps and enhance the core offerings of our product.
* ⁠Possess a thorough understanding of the Observability market, advising customers on best practices and the most appropriate solutions for their needs.

**Requirements**

* ⁠Minimum 5 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical architecture.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Proven ability in technical integrations and conducting POCs.
* Proficiency in coding with high-level programming languages (Java, Go, Python).
* Solid understanding of Monitoring, Observability, Log Management, SIEM.
* Background in Engineering/DevOps will be considered an advantage.
* ⁠Previous experience in Technical Sales of Log Analytics, Monitoring, APM, RUM, SIEM is desirable.

**Technical Expertise**

* ⁠In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry.
* ⁠ ⁠Candidates should have hands-on experience and the ability to integrate these technologies into customer environments, providing tailored solutions that meet diverse operational requirements.

* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

* BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
* Strong knowledge of Security Systems (Access, Video, Intrusion , Complete ELV system etc)
* Expertise in Security Guidelines.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) , Blue Beam

* Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

**Preferred**
8+ years of relevant experience in Security System.

8693cb7e.description:
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications

  

Position Title

Subject Matter Expert (SME) / Technical Lead – Windows Infrastructure, AD & AWS Cloud

Experience: 8–15 Years

Location :Pune

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SME / Technical Lead with strong expertise in Windows Infrastructure, Active Directory, VMware Virtualization, Patch Management, and AWS Cloud Operations. The role will be responsible for managing enterprise infrastructure environments, driving operational excellence, ensuring platform availability, and leading infrastructure modernization initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments.

The ideal candidate should possess deep technical expertise, strong troubleshooting skills, leadership capabilities, and experience managing complex enterprise infrastructure in a 24x7 operations environment.

Key Responsibilities

Windows & Active Directory Administration

* Manage and support enterprise Windows Server environments (2008, 2012, 2016, 2019, and 2022).
* Administer Active Directory, Group Policies (GPO), DNS, DHCP, and Domain Controllers.
* Perform AD replication troubleshooting, health checks, security hardening, and disaster recovery activities.
* Manage user lifecycle, security groups, service accounts, and privileged access controls.
* Support enterprise authentication and identity management initiatives.

Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure

* Manage AWS cloud infrastructure and hybrid environments.
* Administer AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Security Groups, EBS, CloudWatch, and Load Balancers.
* Drive cloud resource optimization and cost management initiatives.
* Support cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure transformation projects.
* Ensure cloud security, compliance, and governance standards are maintained.

VMware Virtualization

* Administer VMware vSphere environments including ESXi and vCenter.

b6a35fb5.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
b6a35fb5.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Pretraining, Finetuning LLMs & Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly open source LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See:**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd** :

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

914df538.title: Interoperability Solutions Engineer
914df538.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.
  
  
**Together, we can beat cancer.**
At Varian, we bring together the worlds’ best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions. If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.
  
  
This role location is Denmark, but we will accept applications from any NRB listed country, please ensure you have the right to work and meet the criteria.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Consulting & Pre-Sales - Support sales teams and customers in identifying customer specific interoperability solutions. Draft a detailed solution proposal. Ensure feasibility.
* Project Management - Scope, plan and monitor implementation in an international environment. Follow deadlines agreed.
* Developing - Technically develop, implement, test and accept interface solutions following communication standards in health care (e.g. HL7, FHIR, Dicom, API, etc). Where required, develop customer specific software features.
* Support: Maintain and support customers and their interface solutions in production
* Mentoring: Share experience and support other team members

**Skills & Experience Required**

* Solid knowledge and professional experience in information technology.
* Solid scripting skills (e.g. TSQL, Java Script, VB, etc)
* Solid understanding of interoperability in health care including common standard (e.g. HL7, Dicom, FHIR)
* Solid project management skills
* Able to handle difficult internal and external customer situations including troubleshooting
* Associate degree or Bachelor degree in Computer Science or equivalent skills.
* Solid knowledge of technical writing / communication.
* Solid English skills (EU B2)

**Fighting cancer calls for big ideas.**
We envision a world without fear of cancer. Achieving this vision takes dedication and commitment from all of us, every single day. That's why we celebrate and value the distinctly beautiful and intersectional identities of each of our employees. We are a mirror of our patient-base, which allows us to innovate. Big ideas come from everywhere, and the best ideas are fostered by our unique individual experiences. At Varian, we encourage you to bring your whole self to work and believe your bold and authentic perspective will help to power more victories over cancer.
  
  
**Who we are**
: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.
  
  
**How we work**
: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.
  
  
To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.
  
  
**Data Privacy**
: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.
  
  
**Beware of Job Scams:**
Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees.  These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information.  If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.
  
  
**To all recruitment agencies**
: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

9a358219.title: Pre-Sales Consultant - SAP Testing
9a358219.description:
**Job Title**

Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing

  

**Employer Description**

A fast-growing AI-led enterprise test automation platform company serving global digital transformation clients.

  

**Role Purpose**

We are seeking a high-impact Pre-Sales Consultant SAP Testing with strong SAP techno-functional expertise, customer-facing solutioning capability, and a deep understanding of SAP business processes, automation strategy, and AI-led testing innovation.

This role is positioned at the intersection of SAP transformation advisory, test strategy design, solution engineering, demo storytelling, and enterprise deal progression. The selected professional will work closely with sales, product, engineering, customer success, and enterprise client stakeholders to shape technically credible, commercially compelling SAP testing solutions.

The role requires a professional who can understand complex SAP landscapes, identify testing gaps, design structured testing strategies, present solution demonstrations, support RFP/RFI responses, run proof-of-concept engagements, and influence customer confidence across S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, API, integration, and regression testing environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Customer Discovery and SAP Landscape Assessment**

• Assess current SAP landscapes, including ECC, S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, Fiori/UI5, and integrated enterprise systems.

• Understand SAP business processes across modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, and related functional areas.

• Identify current testing challenges across manual testing, automation coverage, regression cycles, integration validation, and release readiness.

• Evaluate pain points related to test maintenance, test data, execution planning, business process coverage, and cross-module dependencies.

• Translate discovery outcomes into structured solution opportunities and customer-facing recommendations.

  

**2. SAP Test Strategy and Solution Architecture**

• Design end-to-end test strategies for S/4HANA migration programs, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition scenarios.

• Build testing approaches for RISE with SAP programs, Fiori modernization, SAP steady-state operations, and ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Create structured test blueprints covering business process mapping, regression suite design, impact-based testing, and risk-based prioritization.

• Define testing scope across functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, API testing, data migration validation, and interface validation.

• Consider cross-module dependencies, release cycles, upgrade readiness, and industry-specific SAP process complexity.

  

**3. Demo Engineering and Technical Presentation**

• Prepare and deliver customer-specific demos for SAP UI5/Fiori workflow testing.

• Demonstrate testing approaches for SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, APIs, IDocs, CPI, and PI/PO integrations.

• Explain how modern SAP testing reduces release risk, improves reliability, shortens testing cycles, and supports quarterly upgrade readiness.

• Present automation concepts clearly for SAP functional teams, QA leaders, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and business stakeholders.

• Use storytelling, structured narratives, and proof points to communicate solution value during pre-sales engagements.

  

**4. Proposal, RFP, and Solution Documentation**

• Prepare technical proposals, RFP responses, RFI responses, and customer-facing solution documents.

• Support security and compliance questionnaires with technically accurate, role-relevant input.

• Create high-level architecture diagrams, solution outlines, testing strategy documents, and estimation models.

• Develop test effort and complexity estimates based on SAP scope, modules, interfaces, transformation stage, and regression requirements.

• Tailor SAP testing strategies for industry contexts such as manufacturing, BFSI, retail, and other enterprise environments.

  

**5. Customer Engagement and Deal Progression**

• Work with Sales Directors to build compelling SAP testing narratives and customer-specific value propositions.

• Lead validation workshops with SAP functional consultants, QA teams, Basis teams, enterprise architects, and transformation stakeholders.

• Address customer objections around methodology, automation strategy, integration reliability, migration readiness, and testing governance.

• Define success criteria for proof-of-concept engagements and validation workshops.

• Run PoCs aligned to real customer business processes, SAP modules, integration flows, and technical environments.

• Support deal progression through technical credibility, structured solutioning, and stakeholder confidence-building.

  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• 810 years of experience in SAP functional consulting, ABAP development leadership, SAP project delivery, SAP solutioning, or SAP techno-functional consulting.

• Strong exposure to SAP projects in consulting, project management, technical delivery, implementation, migration, or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Hands-on understanding of SAP S/4HANA migration approaches, including greenfield, brownfield, and selective transition.

• Working knowledge of RISE with SAP architecture and enterprise SAP transformation models.

• Experience with SAP modules such as SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or similar business process areas.

• Participation in at least one S/4HANA or RISE transformation project in a primary functional, technical, or consulting role.

• Strong communication skills, executive presence, demo capability, and solution storytelling ability.

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Experience**

• Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, SAP advisory, SAP QA consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.

• Lead contributor experience in SAP implementation programs, especially in FI, SD, or MM domains.

• Exposure to SAP test automation, SAP QA, regression testing, impact-based testing, or structured testing frameworks.

• Background modernizing SAP testing from manual or recorder-driven approaches to structured automation frameworks.

• Experience supporting proposals, RFPs, technical presentations, solution workshops, PoCs, or enterprise deal cycles.

  

**Required Technical and Functional Expertise**

• SAP S/4HANA transformation and migration testing.

• RISE with SAP architecture and testing implications.

• SAP functional process knowledge across SD, MM, FI, PP, EWM, HR, or related modules.

• SAP UI5 and Fiori testing.

• SAP OData services, RFCs, BAPIs, IDocs, and interface flows.

• CPI and PI/PO integration environments.

• Functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, and data migration validation.

• Test case design, test data services, execution lists, regression suite planning, and risk-based testing practices.

• Business process coverage mapping and cross-module dependency analysis.

• Customer-facing solution architecture and technical storytelling.

  

**Required Professional Competencies**

• Ability to lead structured customer discovery discussions.

• Strong analytical ability to assess SAP testing gaps and transformation risks.

• Capability to design practical, enterprise-ready SAP testing strategies.

• Clear communication across technical and business stakeholders.

• Strong presentation, demo, objection-handling, and workshop facilitation skills.

• Ability to partner effectively with sales, product, engineering, and client-facing teams.

• Strong documentation discipline for proposals, RFPs, architecture diagrams, and solution notes.

• High ownership orientation and ability to drive technical deal progression.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an SAP techno-functional professional with strong consulting maturity, enterprise communication skills, and the ability to translate SAP transformation challenges into structured testing solutions. The person should be comfortable discussing SAP business processes with functional teams, integration complexity with technical stakeholders, testing strategy with QA leaders, and business outcomes with senior decision-makers.

A strong fit would be someone who has contributed meaningfully to SAP implementation, migration, or transformation programs and now seeks a customer-facing pre-sales role combining SAP expertise, testing strategy, automation advisory, AI-led innovation, and enterprise solution consulting.

e999c6b0.title: Solution Architect (Fluent)
e999c6b0.description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
Role Overview

implementation, and technical direction of enterprise-scale Order Management System (OMS) solutions using Fluent
  
Commerce.
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Fluent Commerce, distributed OMS architecture, retail and
  
eCommerce workflows, system integrations, and cloud-native architectures, along with strong experience
  
translating complex business requirements into scalable and resilient technical solutions.
  
This role will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, developers, integration teams, and other
  
technical leaders to define architecture and deliver high-performance OMS solutions supporting complex omnichannel
  
business models.

l Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Fluent Commerce OMS implementations.
  
l Design scalable, API-driven, event-based, and distributed OMS architectures.
  
l Define solution architecture, technical blueprints, and integration patterns aligned with retail and eCommerce best
  
practices.
  
l Translate complex business and functional requirements into robust technical architecture and detailed solution
  
designs.

l Ensure solutions meet required standards for performance, security, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  
l Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, and dependencies and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
  
OMS & Fluent Commerce Architecture

orchestration, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and inventory management.
  
l Design and architect Distributed Order Management (DOM) solutions for complex omnichannel business models.
  
l Define inventory orchestration and fulfillment strategies across multiple locations and channels.
  
l Architect Fluent Commerce extensions and configurations based on business and technical requirements.
  
l Ensure the OMS architecture supports scalability, flexibility, maintainability, and high availability.
  
  
Integration Architecture
  
l Define and oversee integration architecture between Fluent Commerce OMS and enterprise systems, including:

**l ERP platforms:** SAP and Oracle
  
l Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  
**l eCommerce platforms:** Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, and Magento
  
l CRM and loyalty platforms
  
l Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, asynchronous communication, and
  
event-driven architectures.
  
l Define reliable data flow and integration patterns between upstream and downstream systems.
  
l Review API contracts, integration specifications, data mappings, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  
l Ensure integrations are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Technical Governance & Quality

l Conduct architecture reviews and design walkthroughs.
  
l Review technical deliverables and provide architectural guidance to development and integration teams.
  
l Define non-functional requirements and ensure they are incorporated into the solution design.
  
l Drive best practices around coding standards, integration design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production
  
readiness.
  
l Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement

l Collaborate with business, functional, technical, and integration teams to understand requirements and define
  
appropriate solutions.
  
l Present architecture decisions, technical approaches, and solution recommendations to technical and non-technical
  
stakeholders.
  
l Act as the primary technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions.
  
l Provide technical guidance during implementation, production support, incident triage, and root cause analysis.
  
l Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, technical estimations, architecture proposals, and RFP
  
responses.
  
  
Required Skills & Experience

l 4+ years of hands-on experience with Fluent Commerce OMS.
  
l Strong expertise in Order Management Systems and Distributed Order Management (DOM).
  
l Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, including order orchestration, fulfillment, returns and
  
exchanges, cancellations and refunds, and inventory orchestration.
  
l Strong experience designing REST APIs, JSON-based integrations, webhooks, and
  
asynchronous/event-driven architectures.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Magento, CRM, and payment platforms.

3343d487.title: Technical Architect — Higher Ed Platforms

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.

### **Senior Technical Architect – Higher Education Platforms**

**Location:** Pune, India | Hybrid  
**Employment:** Full-time, engaged through SIG's Employer of Record in India  
**Base salary:** ₹25–37 lakh per annum (LPA)  
**Experience:** 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in consulting or professional services delivery for external clients  
**Reports to:** Lead – India Centre of Excellence  
**Working hours:** Flexible, with 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern morning. Typically, your day will finish around 9:00–10:00 pm IST, with a correspondingly later start.

Build the solution. Set the technical standard.

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US-based leader in higher education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernise their student information, HR and finance systems through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM and cybersecurity work.

We are building our first engineering Centre of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding-team role: you will help establish how the team designs and builds. You will own technical architecture across application integrations, Ellucian Experience Cards, workflow automation and data migration—and write a meaningful part of the production code yourself. This role carries delivery accountability, not just design accountability.

**Ellucian experience is not required.** Deep integration expertise, direct US client delivery experience and the ability to learn a new platform quickly are essential.

What you will do

* **Own architecture and delivery:** Design secure integrations, web applications, identity solutions and workflow automation on Ellucian platforms. Document practical designs that work within platform, infrastructure and timeline constraints, and stay hands-on with production code.

* **Build platform expertise:** Learn Ellucian Ethos, Experience, Workflow, Banner/Colleague data structures and the API catalogue, then turn that knowledge into reusable patterns and documentation.

* **Lead and mentor:** Run architecture and code reviews, resolve complex technical problems and help new engineers become productive through hands-on guidance.

* **Work directly with US clients:** Lead technical discovery, explain designs and trade-offs, and support project scoping, estimation and technical proposals.

* **Lead data migration:** Own source analysis, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation and cutover into Ellucian platforms.

* **Deliver and improve:** Meet your assigned annual billable utilisation target alongside mentoring and design reviews. Use AI coding assistants responsibly and contribute to SIG's internal AI development tools.

What you will bring

* **Engineering and consulting experience:** 10+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 5 years delivering for external clients in consulting or professional services. Direct experience leading technical discussions, presenting designs and managing expectations with US-based clients is required.

* **Deep integration and API expertise:** Experience designing, securing, versioning and operating integrations at scale—not simply consuming REST endpoints. Strong command of synchronous REST, event-driven, message-based, batch, file-based and ETL integrations; point-to-point and hub models; JSON, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, retries, versioning and webhooks.

* **Identity and security:** Hands-on SAML 2.0 and single sign-on (SSO), including troubleshooting failed assertions; working knowledge of OIDC, identity providers, federation, attribute and role mapping, and provisioning. Strong OAuth 2.0, JWT, API key, token and scope design, least-privilege service-account access, secrets handling and secure data exchange skills.

* **Hands-on web engineering:** Expert-level TypeScript and React.js, including component architecture, state management and performance; deep server-side Node.js, including API design, asynchronous patterns, error handling, dependency management and production debugging. Ability to design end-to-end web applications across the client, APIs, services, data, caching, sessions and deployment.

* **Workflow and data delivery:** Business process automation expertise and hands-on experience with a workflow or business process management (BPM) tool. Experience planning and executing enterprise data migrations, plus SQL, relational data modelling, Git and modern continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices.

* **Technical leadership and learning:** Demonstrated architecture leadership and mentoring, sound judgement within delivery constraints, clear written and spoken English, and a specific example of learning an unfamiliar platform quickly. Fluency with AI-assisted development, including verifying and explaining AI-generated output before release.

Preferred experience—not essential

* Ellucian Banner, Colleague, Ethos, Experience or Workflow; higher education technology; or enterprise resource planning (ERP), student information systems (SIS), human resource management systems (HRMS) or finance platforms.

* Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL or API gateways; AWS S3, SFTP and secure file exchange.

* AI/ML tools, large language model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, internal developer tools or AI-assisted automated testing.

* Low-code/no-code platforms, distributed teams across time zones, or pre-sales solution design and estimation.

Your first months at SIG

We will provide access to Ellucian training and certification, with platform badges targeted within your first 60 days; direct knowledge transfer from SIG's experienced US consultants; and a defined onboarding deliverable so you start building real solutions early. We expect you to start contributing within two months and to be teaching others within six.

Outside the required US overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in. If you want to keep building, help engineers develop and shape a new team's technical standards, this role is for you.

*Strata Information Group is an equal opportunity employer.*

*The listed salary range for this position is indicative and subject to adjustment based on the candidate's unique skills and location. Final compensation will be determined through mutual agreement between the successful candidate and SIG.*

SIG is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

**About The Role**
We're looking for a hands-on D365 Technical Architect to shape and deliver solutions across our Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Project Operations implementation, along with the Power Pages sites that extend it to our customers and partners.
  
  
You'll own the technical design for one or more major feature areas, working day to day with Product Owners, Functional Architects, and agile delivery teams. **Solution architecture**

**DevOps and application lifecycle management**

* Own and evolve our ALM strategy: environment design, solution layering, managed solutions, and branching.

* Plan and lead adoption of Microsoft's release waves to maximize platform value and minimize regression risk.

**Partnership and communication**

* Work alongside delivery teams in an agile environment to see designs through to adoption, not just hand-off.
* Summarize options, risks, and recommendations clearly for executive audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years in software development or solution architecture, including 4+ years designing and building on Dynamics 365 or Power Platform.
* Deep hands-on development experience: C#/.NET plugins and custom APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, PCF controls, Power Automate, and the Dataverse Web API.
* Hands-on technical delivery experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service and/or Field Service.
* Proven experience building and supporting Power Pages (or Power Apps portals) sites.
* Practical DevOps experience: source control, CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solutions, and environment and release management.
* Experience working in a heavily customized, integrated D365 environment.
* Ability to analyze business processes and turn requirements into sound technical designs.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to developers, business stakeholders, and executives.
* Comfort balancing multiple priorities and adapting as they change.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Dynamics 365 Sales and Project Operations.
* Field Service mobile configuration and offline design, or Resource Scheduling Optimization.
* Omnichannel for Customer Service, Copilot Studio, or other AI capabilities in Dynamics 365.
* Azure integration services: Function Apps, Service Bus, Logic Apps, API Management, and Key Vault.
* Data migration and integration using SSIS with KingswaySoft or Azure Data Factory.
* SQL Server, T-SQL, and stored procedures.
* Microsoft certifications such as Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600), Power Platform Developer (PL-400), Dynamics 365 Customer Service or Field Service Functional Consultant, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400).

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* You take ownership and act before being asked.
* You solve problems creatively and stay pragmatic when trade-offs get hard.
* You collaborate easily across teams and levels, from developers to senior leaders.
* You stay organized and deliver in a fast-moving environment.

cd7ad0d8.description:
### **Job Title**

Senior Program Manager

### **Job Description**

**Senior Program Manager – Intelligent Systems & AI**

At Philips, our purpose is to improve people's health and well-being through meaningful innovation. Across enterprise imaging, radiology, cardiology and digital pathology, our healthcare informatics solutions help clinicians and health systems turn complex data into better-informed decisions. Doing that at scale takes more than great products: it takes exceptional technology, operations and execution behind them.

That is where Intelligent Systems & AI (IS&AI), within Philips Healthcare Informatics, comes in. We connect business priorities with platforms, data, automation and AI to improve how our business sells, delivers and supports customers. From commercial and service workflows to enterprise technology transformation, we work across teams and systems to remove friction, improve outcomes and create lasting value. We are looking for someone who wants to help build that future, not simply manage a plan.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

You will lead high-impact, cross-functional technology programs from an ambiguous business problem to an implemented solution and measurable result. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, engineers, architects and technology partners. Expect to move between strategic choices and operational detail, influence technical trade-offs, unblock teams and help reshape how programs run in an AI-enabled organization. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a reporting-only PMO position.

  

**Your Role**
-------------

* Translate customer and business problems into clear goals, success measures, practical scope and decisions. Work backwards from customer experience, adoption, productivity, cost or revenue impact rather than treating delivery milestones as the finish line.

* Drive complex programs from discovery and prioritization through design, build, integration, launch, adoption and value realization. Make sequencing and capacity trade-offs, resolve blockers and take accountability when plans change.

* Work closely with engineering and architecture on systems, APIs, data flows, integrations and technical dependencies across CRM, CPQ, ERP, service platforms and other enterprise applications. Understand enough to ask the hard questions and challenge choices constructively.

* Align commercial and service business leaders, product teams, engineering, operations, vendors and system integrators around one coherent roadmap. Build accountability and make decisions without relying on formal authority.

* Establish fit-for-purpose operating mechanisms that show the real risks, dependencies, owners and decisions. Communicate trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and distinguish meaningful progress from status reporting.

* Use AI, automation and modern digital tools to reduce coordination overhead, detect issues earlier and improve decision quality. Experiment, learn and scale what works, with appropriate security, privacy and human accountability.

  

**You may be a great fit if you**
---------------------------------

* Have 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise software, digital transformation or technical programs spanning multiple teams, systems and business stakeholders.

* Bring experience from product-led technology, cloud/SaaS or enterprise-platform businesses, or from technology and digital transformation consulting where you owned delivery through implementation and adoption - not just strategy, governance or reporting.

* Hold a master's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business or a related discipline, or an MBA. Comparable exceptional experience in technical program leadership may also be considered.

* Think from first principles: you can break down an unclear problem, test assumptions, identify the real constraint and make sensible decisions with incomplete information.

* Have a track record of personally moving difficult programs forward and can explain the decisions you made, the trade-offs you navigated and the business or customer outcomes that resulted.

* Combine strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You are as comfortable framing a direction with executives as getting into the details with engineers or removing a delivery blocker.

* Bring practical technical fluency in enterprise systems, cloud or SaaS platforms, integrations and data; you can collaborate credibly with product and engineering without needing to be the person writing production code.

* Are an effective, concise communicator who earns trust across functions and cultures, surfaces uncomfortable facts early and makes complex decisions understandable.

* Are curious and comfortable using AI tools in your own work today, with a strong appetite to experiment and continuously improve how you and your team operate.

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

2cb0fd72.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
2cb0fd72.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own execution for large, cross-functional technical programs at Quince to help us scale and grow in existing geographies or launch new countries. You will work across product, engineering, business, and legal to align on scope, priorities, and dependencies. You will typically work with several engineering teams, product and business counterparts across the globe, and a commercial deadline.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will run several large, cross-functional programs at a time and be accountable for their delivery, on both timeline and impact.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end delivery, from scoping through launch and post-launch measurement.
* Work directly with engineering & product leads and architects on technical/business trade-offs.
* Drive alignment across US and India teams, including product and business leadership in Pacific time.
* Surface risks early and push for decisions when teams are stuck.
* Communicate status, risk, and asks to senior leadership in clear writing.
* Build the execution mechanisms this team needs as it scales.

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 10-14 years of experience, with the last several as a TPM on product programs that shipped to customers.
* A bias for ownership. You take charge of ambiguous problems without waiting to be assigned, and you hold your ground with senior stakeholders when you believe the call is wrong.
* A record of owning launches end to end.
* Technical depth. An engineering background, or experience shaping architecture and design decisions.
* Experience running programs across time zones with US or headquarters stakeholders.
* Strong written communication with senior stakeholders.

****Good to have**
:**

* E-commerce, D2C, or marketplace experience
* Exposure to global expansion, localization, or regulatory programs

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

10cc5e95.title: Senior Technical Program Manager- Data Center Infrastructure Delivery
10cc5e95.description:
**Job Description**
This high-impact role puts you at the center of multi-million dollar construction initiatives, managing cutting-edge infrastructure delivery from concept to completion. You'll work with executive-level stakeholders, lead top-tier vendor relationships, and drive strategic projects that directly fuel Oracle's explosive growth-all with exceptional autonomy and visibility. If you're ready to shape the backbone of tomorrow's cloud technology while accelerating your career at one of tech's most influential companies, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact the development and implementation process of a specific company product.
  
  
**Team Overview**
The Data Center Infrastructure Delivery team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is a dynamic group of professionals dedicated to delivering state-of-the-art data center facilities at scale and at pace. This team comprises experienced project managers who work collaboratively with vendors and internal teams to ensure the successful execution of complex data center construction and network projects. They bring a wealth of expertise in project management, technical design, and on-site construction, ensuring that our data centers meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and sustainability. This team plays a crucial role in supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's data needs and driving our growth and success.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Strategically, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive plans that optimize efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence in delivery. You will engage with key stakeholders, manage high-stakes vendor relationships, and navigate the complexities of regulatory compliance. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. This is a high- impact role that will lead, drive, and ensure the successful management and delivery of critical initiatives on our strategic roadmap.
  
  
The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end-to-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds.
  
  
This role will oversee data center focused projects and initiatives. Managing these construction projects well is key to the overall success of customer deliveries. You will engage directly with our Colo and LV partners' leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements to meet our customers' needs. You will also engage with internal teams to make sure we deliver the proper design and process documentation to the Colo, execute on our ISP circuit contracts, and update all internal tracking tools for handover to our operations teams at the end of the project.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities Include:**

* Being the end-to-end TPM leader in charge of the program across multiple sites up to 1GW of capacity, coordinating with multiple principal TPM from shaping the approach, prioritizing the resources and achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
* Project Planning: Develop and implement long-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.
* Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.
* Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seem less handoff
* Project Management: Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
* Vendor Management: Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
* Budget Oversight: Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost-effective use of resources and adherence to financial constraints.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns.
* Quality Assurance: Implement and oversee quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of construction and operational efficiency.
* Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality will be required throughout the life of the project on an as needed basis.

**Required Skills**

* Project management experience in delivery mission critical Data Centre Construction, Cabling, Compute, Networking, AI infrastructure project.
* At least 5 years of Program/Portfolio management experience.
* PMP/ITIL v3 or equivalent certification
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex challenges in a fast-paced construction environment.
* Strategic Planning: Expertise in developing and implementing long-term strategies and establishing program-level requirements for construction projects.
* Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of data center design, construction, and operational requirements, with a focus on cutting-edge technologies and sustainability.
* Project Management: Proven expertise in managing large-scale data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery including advanced project scheduling and tracking.
* Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of project managers, engineers, and construction professionals.
* Budget Management: Proficiency in creating, managing, and optimizing project budgets to ensure cost-effective use of resources.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify potential risks and develop effective mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
* Vendor Management: Extensive experience in selecting, negotiating, and managing contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers.

**Qualifications**
Career Level - IC3
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

**Overall Summary**

  

The Senior Public Transportation Architect serves as a senior technical delivery professional responsible for the planning, design, and multidisciplinary coordination of complex transit infrastructure and public transportation facility projects. The role is intended for an experienced engineer-architect who can lead technical workstreams, coordinate across disciplines, support client and stakeholder discussions, and deliver practical, sustainable, and operationally effective transit facilities.

  

The role supports projects such as transit stations, bus rapid transit facilities, multimodal transportation hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, park-and-ride facilities, passenger transfer facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure. The position is focused on technical excellence, project delivery, design integration, quality, and mentoring within multidisciplinary transit infrastructure teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead planning, programming, architectural design, and construction support for transit stations, multimodal hubs, maintenance facilities, BRT facilities, operations centers, and other transportation infrastructure projects.
* Serve as Lead Architect, Design Lead, or Discipline Lead for complex transit infrastructure assignments, ensuring that architectural deliverables are coordinated, technically sound, and aligned with project requirements.
* Coordinate and integrate architectural solutions with civil, structural, geotechnical, MEP, rail systems, communications, traction power, transportation planning, operations, safety, security, sustainability, and digital delivery disciplines.
* Develop facility concepts that balance passenger experience, operational efficiency, accessibility, safety, maintainability, resiliency, sustainability, lifecycle performance, and future expansion needs.
* Prepare, review, and coordinate design criteria, reports, technical memoranda, drawings, specifications, BIM models, and contract documents across project phases.
* Support project managers with scope management, schedule coordination, budget awareness, resource planning, risk reviews, and quality assurance for architectural and facility-related tasks.
* Participate in interdisciplinary design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering sessions, and technical quality reviews to improve project outcomes.
* Interface with client teams to present design concepts, resolve technical issues, and support approvals.
* Support construction-phase services including responding to RFIs, reviewing submittals, and coordinating design clarifications.
* Promote BIM coordination, digital delivery workflows, and innovative approaches to improve quality, coordination, and delivery efficiency.
* Mentor architects, engineers, designers, and BIM/modeling staff.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Bachelors degree in Architecture or related engineering field from an accredited institution.
* 12+ years of relevant experience in architecture, transportation facilities, transit infrastructure, or complex public infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 8 years of experience delivering rail, metro, BRT, bus, or multimodal transportation facility projects.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and coordinating with civil, structural, MEP, systems, operations, safety, and sustainability disciplines.
* Experience supporting project delivery through multiple phases, including planning, feasibility, conceptual design, detailed design, procurement support, and construction support.
* Strong working knowledge of accessibility requirements, sustainable design principles, and public infrastructure design requirements.
* Strong communication, coordination, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Masters degree in Architecture, Urban Design, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Experience with transit stations, rail/metro facilities, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and storage facilities, operations centers, passenger facilities, and fleet electrification infrastructure.
* Experience integrating architecture with rail systems, transit operations, maintenance requirements, transportation engineering, and public realm design.
* Experience with Design-Build, Progressive Design-Build, CM/GC, or other alternative delivery methods.
* Proficiency with BIM, Navisworks, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and digital delivery workflows.
* Experience delivering large-scale transit infrastructure projects for North American, Middle East, or other international clients.

  

**Primary Focus**

  

Transit stations, BRT facilities, multimodal hubs, maintenance and operations facilities, mobility hubs, and fleet electrification infrastructure.

  
  

**Delivery Role**

  

Leads and coordinates with civil, structural, MEP, rail systems, operations, safety, sustainability, and digital delivery teams

7e954618.description:
**Introduction**
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Fluent Commerce OMS Technical Architect to lead the architecture, design,
  
  
implementation, and technical direction of enterprise-scale Order Management System (OMS) solutions using Fluent
  
  
Commerce.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Fluent Commerce, distributed OMS architecture, retail and
  
  
eCommerce workflows, system integrations, and cloud-native architectures, along with strong experience
  
  
translating complex business requirements into scalable and resilient technical solutions.
  
  
This role will work closely with client stakeholders, solution architects, developers, integration teams, and other
  
  
technical leaders to define architecture and deliver high-performance OMS solutions supporting complex omnichannel
  
  
business models.
  
  
**Solution Architecture & Technical Design**
l Own the end-to-end technical architecture for Fluent Commerce OMS implementations.
  
  
l Design scalable, API-driven, event-based, and distributed OMS architectures.
  
  
l Define solution architecture, technical blueprints, and integration patterns aligned with retail and eCommerce best
  
  
practices.
  
  
l Translate complex business and functional requirements into robust technical architecture and detailed solution
  
  
designs.
  
  
l Define architecture principles, technology standards, design patterns, and technical best practices.
  
  
l Review and validate solution designs, configurations, custom extensions, APIs, and integration approaches.
  
  
l Ensure solutions meet required standards for performance, security, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  
  
l Identify technical risks, architectural gaps, and dependencies and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  
  
**OMS & Fluent Commerce Architecture**
l Provide technical leadership across the complete order lifecycle, including order capture, fulfillment, allocation,
  
  
orchestration, cancellations, returns, exchanges, refunds, and inventory management.
  
  
l Design and architect Distributed Order Management (DOM) solutions for complex omnichannel business models.
  
  
l Define inventory orchestration and fulfillment strategies across multiple locations and channels.
  
  
l Architect Fluent Commerce extensions and configurations based on business and technical requirements.
  
  
l Ensure the OMS architecture supports scalability, flexibility, maintainability, and high availability.
  
  
**Integration Architecture**
l Define and oversee integration architecture between Fluent Commerce OMS and enterprise systems, including:
  
  
l Payment gateways: PayPal, Adyen, and Stripe
  
  
l ERP platforms: SAP and Oracle
  
  
l Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  
  
l eCommerce platforms: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, and Magento
  
  
l CRM and loyalty platforms
  
  
l Design and govern integrations using REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, asynchronous communication, and
  
  
event-driven architectures.
  
  
l Define reliable data flow and integration patterns between upstream and downstream systems.
  
  
l Review API contracts, integration specifications, data mappings, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  
  
l Ensure integrations are scalable, resilient, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
**Technical Governance & Quality**
l Establish technical governance across OMS implementations.
  
  
l Conduct architecture reviews and design walkthroughs.
  
  
l Review technical deliverables and provide architectural guidance to development and integration teams.
  
  
l Define non-functional requirements and ensure they are incorporated into the solution design.
  
  
l Drive best practices around coding standards, integration design, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production
  
  
readiness.
  
  
l Identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
l Lead technical and solution architecture workshops with client stakeholders.
  
  
l Collaborate with business, functional, technical, and integration teams to understand requirements and define
  
  
appropriate solutions.
  
  
l Present architecture decisions, technical approaches, and solution recommendations to technical and non-technical
  
  
stakeholders.
  
  
l Act as the primary technical point of contact for architecture-related discussions.
  
  
l Provide technical guidance during implementation, production support, incident triage, and root cause analysis.
  
  
l Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, technical estimations, architecture proposals, and RFP
  
  
responses.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
l 10+ years of overall IT experience with enterprise systems and large-scale digital platforms.
  
  
l 4+ years of hands-on experience with Fluent Commerce OMS.
  
  
l Strong expertise in Order Management Systems and Distributed Order Management (DOM).
  
  
l Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, including order orchestration, fulfillment, returns and
  
  
exchanges, cancellations and refunds, and inventory orchestration.
  
  
l Strong experience designing REST APIs, JSON-based integrations, webhooks, and
  
  
asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
  
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and distributed systems.
  
  
l Experience designing scalable, resilient, and high-availability solutions.
  
  
l Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
  
  
l Strong understanding of Agile / Scrum delivery models.
  
  
l Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
l Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice To Have**
l Experience working in omnichannel retail and large-scale eCommerce environments.
  
  
l Experience with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures.
  
  
l Experience integrating Fluent Commerce with SAP, Oracle, WMS, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify,
  
  
Magento, CRM, and payment platforms.
  
  
l Prior experience in client-facing consulting or solution architecture roles.
  
  
l Experience designing and supporting high-availability production systems.
  
  
l Experience participating in pre-sales, RFPs, solution proposals, and technical estimations.
  
  
l Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and integration best practices.

f8055b50.title: .NET Solution Architect
f8055b50.description:
**About The Role**
You will make the decisions that are expensive to reverse: service boundaries, data model, tenancy, how the thing degrades when a dependency is down. We build on .NET and Azure for clients who need the system to still make sense in year three, so the reasoning behind a decision matters as much as the decision.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own the architecture of .NET platforms on Azure, from discovery through to production
* Write the decision records — what was chosen, what was rejected, and what would change the answer
* Design for multi-tenancy, auditability and data residency where the client’s regulator requires it
* Set the standard for testing, observability and release safety, then hold the team to it
* Work directly with client architects and CTOs as the technical counterpart in the room
* Mentor engineers: the goal is a team that no longer needs you on every call

What we’re looking for
  
  

* Eight or more years in .NET, several of them designing systems rather than only building them
* Deep Azure — App Service, AKS, Functions, Azure SQL, Service Bus and the cost model behind them
* Fluent in distributed-systems failure: retries, idempotency, eventual consistency and their costs
* Able to say no to an architecture that is more interesting than the problem requires

Nice to have
  
  
Not required. Apply if the section above fits.
  
  

* Regulated-domain experience — lending, payments or healthcare
* Event-driven or CQRS systems in production
* Azure certification

How to apply
  
  
Send your CV to hr@itlabz.in with “.NET Solution Architect” in the subject line, or WhatsApp it to +91 95605 15123. Either reaches the same team, and we reply to every application.
  
  
Email your CV Send on WhatsApp
