As an Innovative Data Platform Solution Engineer (SE), you will play a pivotal role in helping enterprises unlock the full potential of Microsoft’s cloud database and analytics stack across every stage of deployment. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leaders and platform teams to accelerate the Fabric Data Platform, including Azure Databases and Analytics, through hands-on engagements like Proof of Concepts, hackathons, and architecture workshops. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform, all while enjoying flexible work opportunities.
  
  
As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll guide customers through secure, scalable solution design, influence technical decisions, and accelerate database and analytics migration into their deployment workflows. In summary, you’ll help customers modernize their data platform and realize the full value of Microsoft’s platform.
  
  

* Drive technical sales with decision makers using demos and PoCs to influence solution design and enable production deployments.
* Lead hands-on engagements—hackathons and architecture workshops—to accelerate adoption of Microsoft’s cloud platforms.
* Build trusted relationships with platform leads, co-designing secure, scalable architectures and solutions
* Resolve technical blockers and objections, collaborating with engineering to share insights and improve products.
* Maintain deep expertise in Analytics Portfolio: Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, DW, real-time intelligence, BI, Copilot), Azure Databricks, Purview Data Governance and Azure Databases: SQL DB, Cosmos DB, PostgreSQL.
* Maintain and grow expertise in on-prem EDW (Teradata, Netezza, Exadata), Hadoop & BI solutions.
* Represent Microsoft through thought leadership in cloud Database & Analytics communities and customer forums

* 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience

+ OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience

c6d8f148.title: ServiceNow Presales Solution Architect
c6d8f148.description:
Job Location: Bangalore, Pune
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12801
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead the end-to-end solutioning of ServiceNow opportunities—from client discovery and solution design through estimation, proposal, bid defence, and transition to delivery. The role converts business and service-management needs into a practical platform roadmap, implementation approach, managed-services model, and measurable value case.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead qualification, discovery workshops, solution design, estimation, proposal development, demonstrations, bid defence, and delivery handover.
* Assess client processes, platform maturity, pain points, governance, data readiness, user experience, and transformation priorities.
* Design fit-for-purpose solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management.
* Translate requirements into process designs, user journeys, platform capabilities, integrations, scope, roadmap, and operating model.
* Define assumptions, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, effort, team structure, commercials, and delivery approach.
* Create RFP responses, statements of work, solution narratives, estimates, benefit cases, and executive presentations.
* Work with technical, delivery, commercial, partner, and client teams to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, commercially sound, and delivery-ready.
* Develop reusable propositions, estimation models, workshop assets, and industry-specific ServiceNow solutions.

Presales & Solution Expertise
  
  

* Strong IT service management process design experience and practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned operating models.
* Deep functional knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, and Strategic Portfolio Management / ITBM, with broader awareness of adjacent ServiceNow workflows.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow implementation, development, upgrades, maintenance, platform administration, and technical architecture.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, client and server-side components, security rules, flows, notifications, import sets, and custom applications.
* Deep integration knowledge covering REST, SOAP/WSDL, JSON, MID Server, Integration Hub, authentication patterns, error handling, monitoring, and integration support.
* Experience defining service catalogs, request models, CMDB governance, service mapping outcomes, asset processes, metrics, SLAs, dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics requirements.
* Understanding platform implementation lifecycle, upgrades, release governance, testing, training, organizational change, adoption, and managed-service operations.
* Proven experience estimating functional scope and identifying cost drivers, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and conditions required for a credible commercial model.

**Qualifications / Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of IT experience with significant ServiceNow consulting, process transformation, solutioning, or presales responsibility.
* 5+ years of IT service management process design experience and strong exposure to ServiceNow implementations or transformations.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator preferred; one or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials strongly preferred.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred; process, architecture, agile, project, change-management, or business-analysis certification is advantageous.
* Experience in at least 2-3 end-to-end ServiceNow implementation or major transformation and multiple complex presales pursuits is preferred.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.
* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

**Experience**
10+ years in IT, including strong ServiceNow consulting, process design, solutioning, and presales experience
  
  
Primary focus
  
  
Platform architecture, integration, security, data, automation, technical estimation, and end-to-end presales, service design, and value realization
  
  
Key domains
  
  
ITSM, ITOM, SPM/ITBM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management as relevant
  
  
**Location:**
Flexible, with travel as required
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

9a6e9bbe.title: AI Solutions Security Engineer
9a6e9bbe.description:
* Job ID: 11308BR
* Location: India-Bangalore (Remote)
* Work Setup: Remote
* Job Category: Engineering
* Posting Date: October 20, 2026

  

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Security Engineer to join Deltek’s growing AI Center of Excellence team to design, build, and operate the security, compliance, guardrail, and policy controls that keep our internal Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions safe, trustworthy, and production-ready. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AI security, application and cloud security, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), SLMs, and software engineering with a practical understanding of MLOps/LLMOps to secure AI applications without slowing the teams that build them. This role reports to the Senior AI Solutions Architect.

Key Responsibilities

AI Security & Threat Defense

* Design and implement security architecture and controls for LLM, Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI applications.

* Perform threat modeling and AI-specific risk assessments aligned to frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF.

* Defend against prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, model and data poisoning, insecure output handling, and excessive agent autonomy.

* Conduct AI red teaming, adversarial testing, and penetration testing of models, prompts, agents, and integrations; track findings through remediation.

* Secure MCP servers, agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, tool calling, and plugin integrations with least-privilege access, authentication, and authorization.

* Protect models, embeddings, vector stores, prompts, and training data with encryption, access controls, secrets management, and network isolation.

AI Guardrails & Runtime Protection

* Design, implement, and tune guardrails for input and output filtering, content safety, topic restrictions, grounding checks, and hallucination mitigation.

* Build and operate PII, sensitive data, and secrets detection and redaction across prompts, retrieved context, and model responses.

* Evaluate and integrate guardrail tooling such as AWS Bedrock Guardrails, Azure AI Content Safety, NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, and LLM Guard.

* Build automated safety, security, and bias evaluation suites and run them as quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.

AI Compliance, Policy & Governance

* Translate AI policies, Responsible AI principles, and regulatory requirements into enforceable technical controls and policy-as-code.

* Support compliance with frameworks and regulations such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA.

* Establish and run AI risk review, and exception processes with security, privacy, legal, and business stakeholders.

Monitoring, Detection & Incident Response

* Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for AI-specific security events such as policy violations, anomalous usage, data leakage, and model abuse.

* Integrate AI telemetry with SIEM, SOAR, and observability platforms to support detection and response.

* Develop AI incident response playbooks and participate in triage, investigation, and post-incident reviews.

AI Solutions Engineering

* Collaborate with AI data scientists and solutions teams to design, build, and deploy secure Generative AI, RAG, and agentic solutions using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral.

* Develop production-grade Python services, APIs, and reusable secure components, such as guardrail libraries, SDKs, and templates.

* Integrate AI services with enterprise systems, identity providers, and data platforms using secure design patterns.

Cloud & DevSecOps

* Secure AI workloads on AWS (preferred) and Azure, including IAM, VPC and private networking, KMS, and secrets management.

* Embed security scanning in CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, dependency and SBOM checks, container and image scanning, and infrastructure-as-code scanning.

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience

* 5+ years of software engineering, application security, cloud security, or machine learning engineering experience.

* 2+ years of hands-on experience securing, developing, or deploying Agentic AI, Generative AI, or AI/ML solutions in production environments.

* Demonstrated experience implementing security, privacy, or compliance controls in a regulated or enterprise environment.

Technical Skills

AI Security, Guardrails & Governance

* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF.

* Prompt injection defense, jailbreak testing, AI red teaming, and adversarial testing techniques.

* Guardrail and content safety tools such as AWS Bedrock Guardrails, Azure AI Content Safety, NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, or LLM Guard.

* PII and sensitive data detection and redaction, such as Microsoft Presidio, Amazon Macie, or similar tools.

* Policy-as-code and access control tooling such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Kyverno, or Cedar.

* Responsible AI practices: explainability, bias mitigation, model cards, and risk management.

Security Engineering & DevSecOps

* Identity and access management, OAuth/OIDC, SSO, secrets management, and encryption.

* Threat modeling, secure design review, and vulnerability management.

* SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and container and IaC scanning tools.

* SIEM, logging, and monitoring integration for security detection and response.

* Docker and Kubernetes; Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins; CI/CD automation.

Programming & Engineering

* Strong expertise in Python.

* Experience with Java, ReactJS, JavaScript, or similar programming languages.

* Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, APIs, and software design principles.

Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI

* Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts and frameworks, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn.

* Large Language Models (LLMs) and SLMs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

* AI agents and agentic workflows using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP, and A2A.

* Fine-tuning and model customization; vector embeddings and semantic search.

* FastAPI or Flask for building AI services.

MLOps & Data

* MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, or SageMaker; model monitoring and lifecycle management.

* SQL and NoSQL databases; data pipelines, ETL, and data modeling.

Cloud Platforms

* AWS (preferred), Azure, and Google Cloud.

* AWS Bedrock or Azure OpenAI Service.

* AWS SageMaker or Google Vertex AI.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience designing enterprise-scale AI platforms and shared AI security services.

* Knowledge of multi-agent architectures and autonomous AI systems, including agent identity and permission models.

* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Snowflake Cortex, Pgvector, Weaviate, Chroma, or Azure AI Search, including access control and data isolation.

* Hands-on experience with AI governance, compliance, and Responsible AI frameworks, including ISO/IEC 42001 or EU AI Act readiness.

20%

a9e0fb16.title: Engineer 2 - Architecture
a9e0fb16.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Wi-Fi Solutions Architect, you will develop solutions using Comcast's full suite of Wi-Fi, WAN/LAN, Managed Security, and Managed Network Services, focusing on Fortune 3000 clients. You will serve as a Technical Wi-Fi Solutions Architect, working closely with account teams to understand customer technical and business requirements and lead the collection of technical details to support the provisioning and activation of Wi-Fi services. Additionally, you will collaborate with various teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences, develop high-value Wi-Fi solutions and designs, and mentor and guide team members.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Develop solutions using Comcast's full suite of Wi-Fi, WAN/LAN, Managed Security, and Managed Network Services, focusing on Fortune 3000 clients.
* Serve as a Technical Solutions Architect SME, working closely with account teams to understand customer technical and business requirements.
* Lead the collection of technical details to support the provisioning and activation of Wi-Fi services.
* Focus on creating high-value Wi-Fi solutions, developing deal strategies, and driving revenue growth for Comcast Business.
* Collaborate with account teams, product teams, and operations to deliver exceptional customer experiences and enable strategic solution sales.
* Meet with customers to understand their business models and the role of Wi-Fi technology in their networks.
* Develop advanced Wi-Fi solutions to address customer business and technology needs, working with the larger team to gain customer confidence and trust.
* Work closely with Sales leaders to upskill sales and sales engineering teams with new Wi-Fi technologies, increasing overall participation and win rates.
* Develop proposal preparation support and technical presentations for customers.
* Build relationships with customers to ensure the Comcast Sales and internal teams understand their current Wi-Fi networks and provide solutions that meet or exceed expectations.
* Act as a technical expert in Wi-Fi within the organization, providing mentoring and guidance to junior team members.
* May lead a team on complex Wi-Fi projects but does not directly manage people.

**Responsibilities And Requirements**

* Develop solutions leveraging Comcast's Managed Network Services portfolio, with a focus on Managed Wi-Fi, Managed Broadband, Managed Router, Network/Security Architecture, and wireless or wired LAN.
* Serve as the Lead Solution Architect (SA) for non-standard product solutions, including product, engineering, support, and financial approvals.
* Lead non-standard Individual Case Basis (ICB), DRB, and EDRB discussions.
* Provide technical overlay support in functional areas such as legal and contracts.
* Support the sales process for large and complex Wi-Fi opportunities.
* Drive customer Wi-Fi solutions within Comcast's presales process by defining customer requirements, survey preferences, billing options, timelines, and proposal responses.
* Document and present solutions to customers, highlighting the benefits and building relationships as a trusted advisor.
* Support solution development growth initiatives, such as complex Wi-Fi designs and Public Sector solutions.
* Shepherd complex design and non-standard architecture efforts for RFPs, designing cost-effective solutions and solving configuration challenges through the standard or ICB process.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering, Solution Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing teams to support the presales effectiveness of the Sales Engineering teams.
* Participate in strategic and tactical account planning.
* Maintain business acumen to anticipate future trends, understand the competitive landscape, and translate market knowledge into business opportunities.
* Review all technical aspects for quality before an opportunity is accepted as sold.
* Lead the introduction of new products, processes, or technologies within the Comcast Business Solution Architecture community.
* Exercise independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintain regular, consistent, and punctual attendance, with the ability to work nights, weekends, and variable schedules as necessary.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
* Knowledge of Wi-fi technology from Cisco, Meraki, Aruba, Juniper, Ruckus and Arista is preferred.
* Ekauha ECSE certificate is required
* Demonstrable proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Visio.

**Employees At All Levels Are Expected To**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System - a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion & diversity.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer**

* This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

**Comcast is an EOE/Veterans/Disabled/LGBT employer.**

afa5115b.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
afa5115b.description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You’ll own and expand our largest, most complex portfolio of accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You will partner with the leaders and team to set the technical standard for the practice and be a go-to resource when other consultants hit edge cases. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants
* Set best practices for agent configuration and prompt design across the team, not just your own accounts
* Act as a technical escalation point for peer consultants and partner directly with Product on gaps surfaced by strategic customers

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 6-8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Track record of owning the most strategic or highest-complexity accounts in a book of business
* Experience mentoring or informally leading peers in a customer-facing technical role
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company
* Experience shaping team-wide playbooks, frameworks or enablement content

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

8a23f725.title: Iot solutions Engineer - Energy Solutions
8a23f725.description:
**Company Description**
AlphaCore Technologies Pvt Ltd is an Industrial IoT company with over a decade of experience delivering predictive maintenance solutions to leading global manufacturing organizations. With strong expertise in both advanced technology and manufacturing operations, the company focuses on driving “Efficiency Through Innovation.” Its state-of-the-art condition monitoring systems support clients across geographies in achieving strategic objectives, improving sustainability, and optimizing performance. AlphaCore emphasizes cost-effective, high-quality solutions and a strong commitment to customer service and value. Recognized by the Indian Express group in 2019, its solutions have helped prevent incidents and save lives.
  
**Role Description**
The IoT Solutions Engineer – Energy Solutions is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role involves designing, developing, and implementing IoT-based energy monitoring and predictive maintenance solutions for industrial clients. The IoT Solutions Engineer collaborates with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, architect solutions, integrate hardware and software components, and ensure reliable deployment in manufacturing environments. Day-to-day responsibilities include configuring and testing IoT platforms, analyzing data for energy efficiency and asset performance, preparing technical documentation, and supporting presales activities through solution demonstrations and technical consultations. The role also includes working closely with sales and consulting teams to tailor solutions, provide post-deployment support, and contribute to continuous improvement of products and processes.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Software Development skills, including experience with IoT platforms, APIs, and relevant programming languages.
* Consulting capabilities to understand client requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and provide expert guidance on energy and predictive maintenance use cases.
* Sales and Presales experience in supporting opportunity qualification, preparing solution proposals, delivering technical presentations, and participating in client meetings.
* Integration skills for connecting sensors, gateways, industrial systems (e.g., PLCs, SCADA), and cloud platforms into cohesive IoT solutions.
* Experience - 4-8 years
* Relevant experience in industrial IoT, energy management, or manufacturing operations, with familiarity in condition monitoring and predictive analytics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; advanced certifications in IoT, industrial automation, or energy systems are an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in data interpretation and troubleshooting complex systems.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work on-site with clients and cross-functional teams.

a2099d77.title: Solution Engineer
a2099d77.description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family.
* Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

**About Corpay**
**About Corpay**
Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments.
  
  
At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally.
  
  
As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law.
  
  
**Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms:**
Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions.
  
  
Learn more about Corpay: https://www.corpay.com
  
  
**Transparency & Compliance**
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Corpay is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Corpay is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where individuals are respected and valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. If you require reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please notify a representative of the Human Resources Department.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring**
Corpay may use artificial intelligence (AI) and other technology-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as application screening, candidate assessment, or interview scheduling. These tools are designed to enhance efficiency, consistency, and fairness throughout the hiring process. AI tools do not make final hiring decisions. All employment decisions involve human review. Corpay is committed to the responsible use of AI, including appropriate oversight and safeguards designed to support fair and unbiased outcomes.
  
  
**Candidate Privacy Notice**
For information about how Corpay processes personal information during the recruitment process, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice: https://www.corpay.com/privacy-policy.
  
  
**Pay Philosophy**
Corpay is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices. Compensation decisions are based on objective, job-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Where required by applicable law, salary or compensation ranges will be included in the job posting or provided prior to the interview process, where required by applicable law. Additional compensation elements such as bonuses, incentives, benefits, or variable pay may apply where applicable.

d608ff30.title: Senior Business Solutions Engineer, BizTech(LegalTech)
d608ff30.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
L9 - Senior Business Solutions Engineer, Legal Tech
  
  
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI-powered tools, implementation of legal systems & integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
We're looking for a world-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end-to-end, from design through support.
  
  
You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.
  
  
This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.
  
  
If you're energized by fast-paced problem-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Embedded Deployment & Enablement
  
  

* Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in-house counsel to identify high-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.
* Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.
* Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.

Governance & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.
* Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.

AI Enablement
  
  

* Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.
* Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).
* Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 8+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.
* Proven track record of architecting and building AI-powered applications including multi-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations
* Proven track record in forward-deployed, embedded, or client-centric technical positions.
* Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation
* Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.
* Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration in large global organizations.
* Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.
* Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy-in from stakeholders and leadership..

**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

cf1d3208.title: AI Factory Architecture Lead
cf1d3208.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Operational Excellence Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**

  

* Energy Industries is establishing an AI Factory as the AI Transformation Engine for the division. The AI Factory enables, accelerates and scales AI transformation across functions by providing governance, expertise, delivery capabilities, reusable assets and capability development.
* As AI Factory Architecture Lead, you will serve as the divisional AI Technical Authority within the AI Factory, leading and orchestrating architecture activities across the AI Factory ecosystem.
* You will be accountable for ensuring that the right architecture is developed, reviewed and approved to deliver scalable, sustainable, secure and future-ready AI capabilities. You will set technical direction, prioritize and coordinate architecture activities across delivery teams, and ensure that the appropriate competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs.
* This is a technical leadership and design authority role. You will lead the architecture capability and enable architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to create coherent, reusable and future-ready solutions.

**Global Opportunity – Open to Candidates Worldwide***\**

While this job posting may display only a limited number of locations, we welcome applications from qualified candidates globally. If you believe your skills and experience are matching this role, we encourage you to apply regardless of your current location.

This position does **not require relocation**. The successful candidate will be employed and hosted through their current ABB location or the nearest suitable ABB office

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
---------------------------------------

* Lead and orchestrate AI architecture across the AI Factory portfolio, setting technical direction, priorities and sequencing of architecture work.
* Provide technical and design authority, reviewing and approving AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* Ensure the right architecture competence and capacity are available to meet portfolio needs, working with delivery teams and AI Factory Operations to address gaps.
* Drive common architecture, standards and reuse, ensuring that reference architectures, reusable patterns and technical guardrails are developed, maintained and adopted.
* Lead the AI architecture community, connecting architects and technical experts across delivery organizations to share knowledge, challenge approaches and shape technical direction.
* Anticipate the rapid evolution of AI, leading assessment of emerging technologies and ensuring the technology roadmap remains relevant and avoids unnecessary technical debt or early obsolescence.
* Lead technical alignment with Functions, IS, Data organizations, delivery teams and external technology partners, including technical evaluation of delivery approaches and vendors.
* Resolve and govern key architecture decisions, balancing innovation, speed, security, sustainability and long-term maintainability, and escalating significant cross-domain decisions through AI Factory governance where required.

*Our team dynamics*

* You will lead and orchestrate the AI architecture capability across Energy Industries, coordinating architects and technical experts embedded across multiple delivery teams and organizations.
* You will be accountable for technical direction, prioritization of architecture work, appropriate architecture competence and capacity, and approval of AI solution architectures within the defined governance framework.
* The role leads primarily through technical authority, functional leadership and influence rather than direct line management. The approved role already positions this function as the principal AI technical authority influencing architects, engineers, delivery teams and external partners.

**Qualifications for the role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* At least 8 years of experience in architecture, engineering, solution design or technology leadership.
* Strong technical background with the credibility to lead senior architects and technical specialists.
* Experience leading architecture or technical work across multiple teams and complex initiatives.
* Experience delivering AI, analytics, machine learning or digital platforms in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of the AI technology ecosystem and emerging trends.
* Ability to translate business priorities into technical direction and make sound decisions balancing speed, quality, reuse and sustainability.
* Strong stakeholder leadership and communication skills.

**Preferred background**

* + Experience in industrial digitalization or engineering-led environments.
  + Experience in technical authority, lead engineering, architecture leadership or comparable functional leadership roles.
  + Experience in consulting, scale-up or high-growth technology environments.
  + Experience leading technical communities and working across internal and external delivery organizations.

**Your application will get our interest if you**

* + Are a technical leader and orchestrator with the depth and credibility to challenge experienced architects and make sound technical decisions.
  + Enjoy enabling talented specialists and creating clarity when priorities compete for limited capacity.
  + Bring a builder mentality, technical curiosity and a practical approach to execution.
  + Are comfortable making decisions in a rapidly changing technology landscape.
  + Influence effectively across organizational boundaries and challenge established thinking constructively.
  + Balance innovation with reuse, maintainability and minimizing technical debt.

* *This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.*

b97fd48a.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you excited to work with the team that enables India’s conglomerates to build innovative services with AWS, scaling to serve billion+ Indians? The Conglomerates team in AWS India is looking for a Solutions Architect who can work with our customers who are augmenting their existing business empires with new business models on the foundations of payment infrastructure like UPI, quick commerce, widespread 5G internet access, affordable smartphones, exploding digital content, identity infrastructure like Aadhaar and world class AI & cloud infrastructure. These new businesses are rapidly and profoundly changing everyday life of billion+ Indians through their platforms & services for E-commerce, Smart Factories, Connected Vehicles, Travel & Hospitality, FinTech and many more.
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Your broad responsibilities will include, owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in the AWS technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform. An ideal candidate should have worked on solution design & architecture of as part of a CoE, Cloud Practice team etc. Candidate must have have in-depth experience one or more of following technologies - Full stack application development/ DevOps / Databases / Networking / Security / Observability / Data Analytics & AIML. Good understanding of patterns and frameworks and ability to identify trade-offs is required. Candidate should have a flair for hands-on coding to do Proof of Concepts and demonstrate technologies. Candidate should be good at identifying repeatable pattern and best practices, and able to learn new technologies and customer business domain.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS India well within a customer’s or partner's environment and drive discussions with mid to senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (DEI) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The selected candidate will work with subsidiairies / JV of large Indian conglomerates to map business requirements to technology. This will include but not limited to, understanding various design patterns & discern between various data & compute technologies. The candidate will also ensure right TCO while meeting the functional & non-functional requirements. The candidate will also guide on building DevSecOps, Observability & Monitoring of Infrastructure & Applications; conduct Well Architected Reviews; partner with AWS Domain & Technology Specialists to implement innovative solutions; collaborate with the Service Teams to identify feature gaps & engage with Technical communities and Customer C-Suite on Technology strategy & Best practices.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Conglomerates team is one of the most diverse teams you would ever get in your career. Our team members have deep technology experience spanning areas of Analytics, IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, Observability, Resiliency & Security. Top it up with years of domain expertise across Automotive, Manufacturing, e-Commerce, Telco, Travel & Hospitality - this is the team where Tech meets Business for the largest movers & shakers of India's push to $5T economy.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
* Experience leading or developing high quality, enterprise scale software products using a structured system development lifecycle
* 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. c08b66d1.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI . As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing agentic and RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs, Agentic and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI technologies.
* Engage directly with customers to understand their language-related requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.
* Collaborating and working with Government, Research and Public sector departments

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Job Description**
**Position**
: SAP Senior Business Solution Architect – Finance
  
  
**Company Overview:**
PVH is a global lifestyle collection of brands, including iconic names such as Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger. We are committed to driving innovation and delivering exceptional value across the retail and supply chain landscape.
  
  
The Digital Hub aims to drive full digitization along PVH Europe’s value chain, from product design all the way to the end-consumer. It consists of technology, transformation and innovation teams that are all crucial to achieving these digital ambitions.
  
  
**SAP Senior Functional analyst – Finance**
**Position Overview**
The SAP Senior Functional analyst – Finance is responsible for defining and governing end-to-end SAP Finance solutions across PVH’s global business landscape. The role will lead the architecture and transformation of core finance, consolidation, group reporting, and financial integration capabilities, with a strong focus on SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting.
  
  
Serving as the solution design authority for SAP Finance, this position translates complex business and financial requirements into scalable, integrated, and supportable SAP solutions while leading cross-functional delivery from strategy and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production stabilization.
  
  
A key focus of the role is the architecture and integration of SAP Finance and Group Reporting with the broader enterprise landscape, including the integration of SAP financial data and processes with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC). The candidate should have strong experience designing and governing the integration architecture, data flows, interfaces, and dependencies between SAP S/4HANA, Group Reporting, SAC, and related platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end SAP Finance solution architecture, spanning Record-to-Report, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, intercompany accounting, financial close, consolidation, group reporting, and financial integration.
* Lead solution architecture and design for SAP S/4HANA Finance, ensuring alignment between operational finance, statutory reporting, group reporting, and management reporting requirements.
* Serve as the architecture lead for SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting, including consolidation models, consolidation units, group structures, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, validation, consolidation of investments, and consolidated financial statements.
* Define the architecture and integration between SAP S/4HANA Finance, Group Reporting, SAC, and other financial reporting and planning platforms.
* Design and govern integrations between SAP Finance and upstream/downstream platforms, including sales, procurement, supply chain, treasury, tax, HR, banking, planning, analytics, and external reporting solutions.
* Lead fit-to-standard, process-design, fit-gap, architecture-review, and solution-design workshops with Finance and Technology stakeholders.
* Partner with senior Finance, Technology, SI, and business stakeholders to resolve cross-functional architecture decisions, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Manage architecture and design activities across multiple Finance projects and change initiatives concurrently.
* Support the strategic transition from the existing SAP landscape to SAP S/4HANA, defining a scalable target-state architecture for global Finance.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of SAP experience, including 8+ years in SAP FI/CO and Finance solution design.
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Universal Journal, and financial close.
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting, consolidation, eliminations, currency translation, and group financial reporting.
* Strong experience with integrations between SAP Finance, Group Reporting, SAC, and financial planning/reporting platforms.
* Strong understanding of SAP Finance integration with logistics and supply chain modules, including SD, MM, Procurement, Inventory Management, and related end-to-end processes.
* Experience leading multiple full-cycle SAP Finance implementations or large-scale S/4HANA Finance transformations.
* Strong understanding of Record-to-Report, intercompany accounting, financial controls, reconciliation, and statutory and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of SAP integration technologies, including APIs, IDocs, OData, BAPIs, CDS Views, and SAP Integration Suite/CPI.
* Proven ability to design scalable Finance solutions for global, multi-entity and multi-currency SAP environments, with strong architecture and stakeholder management skills.
