Summary:
  
We are seeking a Senior Enterprise AI Architect to lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise AI solutions using Gemini Enterprise, Google Cloud, Vertex AI, and agent platforms.  
The architect will translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and measurable AI-enabled experiences, including enterprise search, knowledge assistants, copilots, and AI agents. The role will be responsible for solution architecture, technical governance, production readiness, adoption, and business value realization across complex enterprise environments.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Business and Solution Strategy  
Lead discovery and architecture workshops to identify, assess enterprise AI use cases.  
Translate business objectives into a solution roadmap, delivery scope, architecture, estimates, dependencies, risks, and measurable success criteria.  
Advise stakeholders on when to use enterprise search, knowledge assistants, copilots, deterministic automation, AI agents, or a combination of these patterns.  
  
Architecture and Platform Design  
Design end-to-end enterprise AI architectures across Gemini Enterprise, enterprise search, connectors, retrieval services, custom agents, APIs, integration services, models, tools  
Make architecture decisions regarding platform configuration, low-code extension, custom development, and integration with existing enterprise systems.  
Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, architecture decision records, and technical standards for enterprise AI solutions.  
Design for scalability, performance, reliability, maintainability, interoperability, & cost efficiency  
  
Enterprise Knowledge and Retrieval  
Define the enterprise knowledge architecture, including source-system onboarding, content ingestion, metadata, indexing, refresh, synchronization, retention, and deletion  
Design retrieval-augmented generation patterns using semantic search, hybrid search, embeddings, reranking, grounding, and contextual retrieval.  
Establish identity mapping, source-permission enforcement, document-level access controls, and security trimming across enterprise knowledge sources.  
Guide the use of structured data, unstructured content, semantic models, taxonomies, ontologies, and knowledge graphs where appropriate.  
Define controls to maintain freshness, relevance, traceability, and source attribution for AI-generated responses.  
  
Agent and Integration Architecture  
Design enterprise AI agents and multi-agent solutions, including orchestration, tool/function calling, memory, planning, approvals, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Define secure integration patterns across enterprise applications, APIs, data sources, and business platforms, including identity, authorization, and delegated access controls.  
Establish governance and guardrails for agentic solutions, covering security, risk management, approval workflows, safe automation, and responsible action execution  
  
Responsible AI, Security, and Governance  
Establish Responsible AI and governance standards covering privacy, security, safety, compliance, explainability, auditability, and human oversight.  
Define security, risk, and control frameworks for enterprise AI solutions, including agent governance, prompt security, data protection, threat modelling, and regulatory compliance.  
Implement monitoring, traceability, and audit mechanisms across AI interactions, retrieval systems, agent actions, tool execution, and business workflows.  
  
Evaluation and Production Readiness  
Define evaluation standards and production acceptance criteria for AI solution quality, safety, grounding, reliability, and effectiveness.  
Establish production architecture standards covering scalability, performance, observability, security, cost, and operational readiness.  
Implement LLMOps practices including evaluation, testing, prompt and model lifecycle management, CI/CD, release governance, and production monitoring  
  
Engineering and Technical Leadership  
Lead and mentor engineering teams through the end-to-end delivery of enterprise AI solutions, from ideation and prototyping through production deployment and support.  
Provide architecture governance + hands-on tech leadership through design, code, security, infrastructure & deployment reviews, while developing reusable patterns and accelerators  
  
Client and Delivery Leadership  
Lead client architecture discussions and communicate complex technical decisions to business and technology stakeholders  
Contribute to pre-sales activities, proposals, estimations, solution shaping, demonstrations, and architecture presentations  
Manage architecture risks, dependencies, assumptions, non-functional requirements, and technical decision points  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Google Cloud and Enterprise AI  
Strong Google Cloud architecture experience, with practical exposure to Gemini, Vertex AI, or equivalent enterprise AI capabilities.  
Understanding of enterprise AI platform architecture, model consumption patterns, data boundaries, quotas, performance considerations, and cost management.  
  
GenAI, Search, and Agentic AI  
Gemini Enterprise, Google Agent space, Vertex AI, or equivalent enterprise AI platform experience.  
Experience designing enterprise search and knowledge-assistant solutions  
Understanding of prompt engineering, context management, model limitations, hallucination risks, evaluation approaches, and AI safety controls.  
  
Enterprise Architecture and Integration  
Strong enterprise architecture expertise across application, integration, data, security, identity, cloud, and AI domains, with experience producing solution blueprints and architecture governance artifacts.  
Experience integrating enterprise platforms and data sources using APIs, connectors, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and custom services.  
Deep understanding of enterprise AI patterns including RAG, semantic search, enterprise search, grounding, retrieval, and agent architectures.  
Ability to assess business requirements and determine when to apply GenAI, agentic AI, traditional automation, or custom solution approaches.  
  
Preferred Experience  
AI agent design and implementation, including multi-agent orchestration, MCP, A2A, ADK, and agent runtimes.  
Enterprise search, knowledge management, taxonomy, ontology, and knowledge-graph solutions.  
GenAI governance, evaluation, observability, safety, and Responsible AI frameworks.  
Experience across leading enterprise AI ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, Amazon Q, OpenAI, Anthropic) and relevant cloud/AI certifications.  
  
Additional Information:

700a591a.description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**

* SD-WAN Technical Expertise — Serve as the solution expert for multi-vendor SD-WAN platforms including Silver Peak, Versa, VeloCloud, Fortigate, Meraki, and Citrix.
* Complex Design Interpretation — Understand and validate complex SD-WAN architectures, customer-specific requirements, and proposed solutions.
* End-to-End Implementation — Lead SD-WAN build activities across greenfield, brownfield, transformation, and organic growth deployments.
* HLD & LLD Development — Prepare and update High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs, test plans, and technical documentation.
* Solution Optimization — Recommend improvements to SD-WAN design, features, routing policies, and deployment models.
* Project Delivery Leadership — Own all project activities including planning, execution, testing, migration, and HOTO (handover to operations).
* Vendor & Partner Coordination — Collaborate with OEMs, service providers, and partners to resolve technical issues and align on solution design.
* Training & Knowledge Transfer — Deliver training to L1/L2 teams and support operations managers in establishing service delivery processes.
* Escalation Management — Act as the first escalation point post-cutover for technical issues and stabilization.
* Technology Awareness — Stay updated with emerging SD-WAN, SASE, and WAN technologies, features, and best practices.
* Transport Technology Understanding — Work with diverse WAN transports including MPLS, DIA, Broadband, and LTE/5G.
* Lab & POC Execution — Use lab environments to recreate issues, validate configurations, and support customer demos/POCs.

**About You**

* SD-WAN Expertise — Total 15 + years of experience in connectivity domain. Along with atleast 3+ years of hands-on experience with at least 3 major SD-WAN platforms (Silver Peak, Versa, VeloCloud, Fortigate, Meraki, Citrix).
* SD-WAN Implementation & Operations — Proven experience in end-to-end SD-WAN deployment, configuration, migration, and operational support for large enterprise customers.
* WAN Migration Projects — Mandatory background in executing complex customer WAN migrations, including brownfield transformations and greenfield builds.
* SDN & Security Technologies — Strong knowledge of ACLs, VPN templates, L2VPN, L3VPN, IPsec, GRE, OMP, BFD, DPC, DMPO, ZTP, PnP, and secure service chaining.
* Data Center Networking — Experience with VRF-Lite, BGP, VXLAN, FCoE, FabricPath, OTV, IS-IS, VPC, and multi-tenant data center architectures.
* Virtualization Platforms — Hands-on experience with VMware, Hyper-V, NSX-T, and integration with VMware NSX Data Center for SD-WAN and security overlays.
* Data Center Transformation — Experience in data center consolidation, migration, and transformation projects involving hybrid WAN and SDN technologies.
* Cloud Networking — Knowledge of AWS, Azure, and GCP networking, cloud gateways, routing, and orchestration frameworks.
* SDN & NFV Knowledge — Understanding of Software-Defined Networking and Network Function Virtualization, including virtual edge deployments and service chaining.
* Automation & Scripting — Experience with Python, Ansible, REST APIs, JSON, and Postman for automation, configuration, and integration tasks.
* Complex SDN Build Projects — Proven ability to design, build, and migrate complex SDN/SD-WAN infrastructures in multi-vendor environments.
* Advanced Troubleshooting — Strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve complex WAN/LAN issues using packet analysis, lab replication, and vendor collaboration.
* Lab & POC Execution — Ability to recreate customer issues in lab environments, validate configurations, and support customer demos and POCs.
* Technical Leadership — Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring teams, and coordinating with vendors, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Documentation Excellence — Ability to create HLDs, LLDs, test plans, migration runbooks, and operational documentation for SD-WAN solutions.
* Certifications — Preferred: SD-WAN vendor certifications. CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, NSE, VCP-NV, or equivalent.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
* Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
* Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
* Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
* Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
* Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

7d4d2643.title: Senior Managed Services Consultant
7d4d2643.description:
**About ITRS**

At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.

We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you'll find:

* **A culture that backs you**
  - We're proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.

* **Work that matters**
  - Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.

* **Room to grow**
  - Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we're committed to your development. Just ask our team members who've been excelling here for 10+ years.

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity-backed global partner. 

**Scope of Role**

Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client's Geneos environment. We also work with our on-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.

**As an Onsite Senior Managed Services Consultant, you will:**

* **Monitor**
  ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.
* **Answer Client Queries**
  providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.
* **Restore Client Incidents**
  by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis**
  using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands-on implementation of technical solutions**
  to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors**
  and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests**
  by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information**
  by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions**
  improve products, services, or processes.

**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:**

* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.

* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 6 years' experience in a client-facing role, preferably within a financial institution, vendor environment, or IT Operations
* Strong experience working in project-driven and time-sensitive environments, with the ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues effectively
* Proven track record of initiative and driving continuous improvement
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and user-friendly manner
* Experience or strong interest in Business Analysis and Project Management practices
* Solid experience with Unix/Linux and Windows operating systems (e.g., Linux, Solaris, Windows Server)
* Working knowledge of databases (e.g., Oracle) and SQL
* Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Bash, Shell, Perl, Python, PowerShell, XML)
* Experience with IT Service Management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy)
* Familiarity with deployment and automation tools (e.g., Chef, Ansible, Jenkins)
* Experience in setup, configuration, and maintenance of IT monitoring tools
* Willingness to work onsite in Mumbai and on a shifting schedule

**Benefits**

* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements

ITRS is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.

We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* AWS Managed Services
* Cloud Operations / CloudOps

* DevOps / DevSecOps
* ITSM / Service Management
* Incident, Problem & Change Management
* Cloud Infrastructure Management

* Observability & Monitoring

* Cloud Automation

* Managed Services Manager

4e58b71a.description:
**Our Why At Dotmatics**

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

**We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.**

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

**Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics**

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

**We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.**

**What do we need**

Dotmatics is seeking a Field Application Scientist/Pre-Sales Engineer to deliver compelling technical messaging and product demonstrations in support of new business opportunities. In this role, you will work closely with customers, as well as Sales and Services teams, to understand customer use cases, workflows, and technical requirements. You will also support the planning and execution of Proof-of-Concept projects and evaluations, and contribute to the delivery of customer training in conjunction with these initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead end-to-end demo cycles, RFP responses, and technical customer engagements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and consultants, developing executive sponsors for Dotmatics and identifying opportunities to increase satisfaction and deepen long-term partnerships.
* Architect and design solution proposals and bids aligned to customer requirements and business outcomes.
* Support, attend, and lead internal and external meetings, discussions, and negotiations with stakeholders, consultants, and third-party vendors to drive preferred outcomes.
* Provide coaching and technical support to sales professionals and BDRs throughout the sales cycle.
* Partner with sales teams and customers to define technical requirements and advise on fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Ensure effective handover of proposed solutions to delivery teams and Customer Success Managers, potentially remaining engaged with customers as a trusted advisor for future opportunities.
* Maintain up-to-date technical expertise across the Dotmatics SaaS portfolio by participating in ongoing training provided by Commercial leadership and Development.
* Provide structured feedback and collaborate with Product Management to ensure the Dotmatics product portfolio continues to meet the evolving needs of customers and regional markets.

**We are looking for**
**people who**
hold an advanced degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry and have a minimum of 3-5 years experience in a customer facing role. You will be experienced in presenting solutions and utilising knowledge of Pre-sales best practice for software demonstrations.
**In this role you should be willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%.**

The key skills we are looking for

* Extensive knowledge of antibody drug development and molecular biology
* Personal use of AI-driven work practices
* Working Knowledge of Scientific/informatics software
* Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security
* SQL and Python in order to build prototypes of workflows and integrations to enable customer understanding the configuration extensions
* Experience with Dotmatics’ applications such as Snapgene, Geneious Prime and Biologics, and Prism
* Modeling scientific data, and crafting solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices
* Conduct & deliver needs analysis to understand scientific challenges, business needs, and critical requirements
* Working understanding of implementing, supporting, and/or integrating scientific systems

You may also demonstrate

* Additional language skills
* An understanding of the lifecycle of pharma, biopharma industries
* An understanding of Consumer Packaged Goods industry processes
* Written and oral communication & presentation skills for internal & external audiences

Client of Hiringflow

Artificial Intelligence

₹ 30-35 Lacs PA
  
  
**Job Description**
**This is a Permanent Role with a Premium Client of HiringFlow.**
**About The Role**
Client of Hiringflow is looking for a hands-on Associate Solution Architect who enjoys sitting at the intersection of technology and customers - understanding problems, building demos and showing customers what is possible.
  
  
This is a role for someone who likes to build as much as they like to talk to customers - running technical conversations, building proofs of concept and demos, and helping customers and sales teams turn opportunities into successful engagements.
  
  
You will work across cloud, data and Generative AI solutions on AWS, supporting the full pre-sales journey from first conversation to a technical win and a smooth handover to delivery.
  
  
You will get the opportunity to work on a wide range of customer problems across industries.
  
  
You don't need to know every technology on day one. What matters is strong technical fundamentals, curiosity, clear communication and the ability to learn and build quickly.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Partner with sales and account teams to qualify opportunities and run technical discovery with customers.
* Understand customer business problems and map them to solutions using AWS services and accelerators.
* Build compelling demos and proofs of concept for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, data and cloud-native solutions using services such as Amazon Bedrock, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and OpenSearch.
* Write working code in Python or TypeScript and use infrastructure as code (CDK/Terraform) to build repeatable demo environments.
* Present solutions and architectures to technical and business audiences, from engineers to CXOs.
* Respond to RFPs and RFIs, and contribute to solution proposals, architecture diagrams and effort estimates.
* Run technical workshops, hackathons, immersion days and webinars for customers.
* Work with AWS partner teams on joint opportunities, funding programs and co-selling activities.
* Handle technical objections and questions around security, compliance, performance and cost.
* Ensure a smooth handover of customer requirements and context to delivery teams.
* Maintain and improve library of demos, POCs and pre-sales assets.
* Share customer feedback with product and engineering teams to shape accelerators and offerings.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of experience in solutions engineering, pre-sales, software engineering or cloud consulting.
* Hands-on experience with AWS and a good understanding of core services across compute, storage, databases, networking and security.
* Ability to write working code in Python, TypeScript or a similar language to build demos and POCs.
* Good understanding of Generative AI concepts such as LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG and AI agents, and hands-on experience building with them.
* Experience presenting technical solutions to customers and adapting the message for different audiences.
* Experience contributing to proposals, RFP responses or solution designs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer opportunities at the same time.
* A customer-first mindset and willingness to get hands-on when something needs to be built or shown.

d17c6ee2.description:
**Job Description: Presales & Technical Resource – Microsoft Technologies**
*Location: Bangalore / Gurugram (NCR) | Function: Presales / Technical Sales | Industry: IT Software / Microsoft Ecosystem*
**About The Role**
We are looking for a techno-commercial Presales and Technical Resource with deep expertise across Microsoft Technologies to support enterprise sales cycles. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth (Level 300) with the ability to translate customer business needs into compelling technical and commercial narratives — leading discovery, solutioning, demonstrations, and proposal development. This role sits at the intersection of technology and sales, requiring both credibility with technical stakeholders and fluency in commercial/business conversations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with the sales team through the full presales cycle — from lead qualification to solution design, proposal, and deal closure.
* Lead structured customer discovery sessions to uncover business outcomes, technology landscape, constraints, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures spanning Microsoft Copilot, Data Modernization, Fabric, Azure Infrastructure, and Security.
* Build and deliver technical presentations, live demonstrations, proofs of concept (PoCs), and proposals tailored to customer priorities.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with technically sound and commercially competitive solutions and business cases.
* Articulate business and technical differentiation of Microsoft solution areas relative to competitive alternatives.
* Drive deal progression by removing presales blockers, aligning stakeholders, and maintaining momentum on agreed action items.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and the internal sales team, balancing technical accuracy with commercial pragmatism.
* Stay current on Microsoft's evolving technology roadmap, licensing models, and competitive landscape.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**Technical Expertise (Level 300)**

* Microsoft Copilot — architecture, licensing, use-case design, and adoption scenarios.
* Data Modernization — modern data platforms, migration strategies, and data estate transformation.
* Microsoft Fabric — end-to-end analytics, data engineering, and integration capabilities.
* Azure Infrastructure — hybrid cloud, virtualization, App Modernization, and cloud migration patterns.
* Security — Microsoft security stack (identity, data protection, threat management) and secure solution design.

**Experience & Attributes**

* Prior experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within IT software or the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Demonstrated techno-commercial capability — equally comfortable in technical deep-dives and commercial/business discussions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences.
* Microsoft Technology certifications at associate/expert level (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer, Security Engineer, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience building business cases, ROI/TCO models, and RFP responses.
* Self-driven and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, competitive, quota-influenced environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with partner co-sell motions and Microsoft funding/incentive programs.
* Exposure to enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger Sale) from a presales perspective.
* Prior experience in industry-specific solution positioning (BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, etc.).

*This role can be based out of Bangalore or Gurugram (NCR) and requires close collaboration with sales, delivery, and Microsoft partner teams to drive technically credible, commercially sound opportunity progression.*
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. MBA is a plus.

7a4669d4.title: Solutions Engineer
7a4669d4.description:
Our Purpose
  
  
At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
  
  
**About Us**
SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
  
  
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
  
  
**What Are We Looking For?**
We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
  
  
As Associate Solution Engineer, you will work with prospects and customers, aligning their goals and requirements with the SentinelOne offerings. SentinelOne is seeking a security pre-sales engineer with expertise in security operations focused on prevention, EDR, Cloud native security, SIEM/SOAR, and Threat Hunting. We need a self-starter who excels in a high-paced environment and thrives on pitching revolutionary technology to executives and security practitioners.
  
  
This individual will be instrumental in accelerating our sales initiatives in India. Candidates should ideally be based in Delhi NCR.
  
  
What Will You Do?
  
  
Primary responsibilities include:
  
  

* Act as a technical advisor for our sales teams and the technical point of contact during the sales cycle, participating in discovery calls, running customised demonstrations, and providing technical insight and, where required, Proof of value (POVs) to our prospects and customers when requested.
* Being a thought leader and advisor, you will give technical cybersecurity advice and guidance to our customers while building strong relationships with prospects.
* Achieve mastery of all SentinelOne technologies and maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry, technical and competitive landscape to ensure the presentation and sale of SentinelOne solutions.
* Effective technical sales coverage of the account base
* Provide guidance on complex technical solutions utilising in-depth knowledge of SentinelOne, products, industry and solutions
* Present & evangelise SentinelOne technologies at industry, partner or customer events.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?
  
  
Ideal candidates will have:
  
  

* At least five years experience in cyber security, preferably security operations, offensive/defense security or Cloud security
* At least 4-5 years of vendor presales solution engineering/architecture experience
* Demonstrable experience in objection handling and positioning against competitive technologies
* Demonstrable experience speaking to both small and large audiences
* Concise written and oral communication skills to effectively lead business and technical presentations, demonstrations, and conversations with both executives and technical audiences
* Must have demonstrable experience successfully selling to mid-to-large customers
* Technical experience in one or more of the following areas:

+ Endpoint Protection
+ Endpoint Detection and Response
+ Data Analytics, SIEM, SOAR and Security Automation
+ Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) including Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Service Network Security (CSNS), and Cloud Workload Protection Platform (CWPP)

* Must have basic knowledge of hacking and exploitation tools and methodologies, detection evasion techniques, notable malware, and anti-malware solutions and techniques.
* Team-focused approach and positive attitude are a must
* Experience working in computer forensics, security architect, penetration/red teamer, or incident responder is a plus.
* Experience with cloud solutions such as AWS, Azure, and GCP a plus.
* Travel up to 30% possible.

Why SentinelOne?
  
  
AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
  
  
We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:
  
  
**Equity & Rewards**

* Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

**Time Off & Wellbeing**

* Competitive leave benefits
* Gender-neutral parental leave

**Insurance & Financial Security**

* Medical and insurance benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Work Perks & Flexibility**

* Global home office allowance
* Internet allowance
* LinkedIn Learning license
* Social Connect program
* Food allowance (Bangalore office)
* Meal vouchers (Sodexo)

**Wellness & Lifestyle**

* Health & wellness benefit

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

73d39fef.title: Software Architect
73d39fef.description:
An architect is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of software applications using a back-end stack (Java, Node.js or .NET) and a modern front-end framework (e.g. React, Angular or Vue). This includes working with technologies such as Java (Spring Boot), Node.js (NestJS/Express) or .NET (ASP.NET Core), message brokers (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus) and ORMs (e.g. Hibernate/JPA, TypeORM/Prisma, Entity Framework), as well as front-end web development technologies such as React, Angular or Vue, TypeScript, HTML and CSS. An architect will be involved in all aspects of the software development life cycle, including requirement gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment. Strong technical skills and experience with both front-end and back-end development are essential for this role. Good knowledge of DDD design patterns, CQRS and Clean Architecture is mandatory. In addition, experience with microservices and micro frontends is expected. Strong skills in at least one modern front-end framework are expected. They will also be able to collaborate with other team members, including other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality software on time.  
  
The Architect is expected to participate in sales workshops, assess client requirements and discuss technical feasibility, participate in knowledge sharing sessions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Participating in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-up meetings, and retrospectives.
* Working with product owners, business analysts and clients to translate business requirements into architecture, technical designs and delivery plans.
* Leading the design and hands-on development of back-end services using Java (Spring Boot), Node.js (NestJS/Express) or .NET (ASP.NET Core), together with the relevant ORM and data-access frameworks.
* Guiding front-end architecture (including micro frontends) and contributing to development using React, Angular or Vue, together with TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
* Designing API contracts and integration patterns (REST, event-driven messaging) between services and external systems.
* Defining and promoting software development best practices – clean code, SOLID principles, automated testing, secure coding, CI/CD and documentation – to ensure code quality and maintainability.
* Driving the adoption of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) across the team and defining guidelines for their safe and effective use.
* Leading code and design reviews, and mentoring engineers to raise the team's technical capability.
* Troubleshooting and debugging issues.Continuously improving the software development process and practices.
* Presenting architecture options, trade-offs and risks to stakeholders and team members to ensure project goals are met.
* Keeping up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends, evaluating them through proofs of concept, and sharing knowledge across teams.

**Job Requirements**

**Essential Skills**:

* Strong hands-on development skills in at least one back-end stack – Java, Node.js (TypeScript) or .NET – and strong skills in a modern front-end framework (React, Angular or Vue); solid experience with microservices, cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP), message brokers and ORMs.
* Strong written and verbal skills for discussing requirements with business stakeholders, PMs, designers, engineering.
* Ability to make and argue technical decisions on security, performance and manageability
* Significant experience in technical design and implementation of successful software products
* Ability to define application structure, behaviour, interaction, non-functional properties
* Ability to analyse impact and risks for business and subsequent architectural decisions
* Code and process reviews, adherence to best practices
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily work, with a critical understanding of their strengths, limitations and risks (e.g. code quality, security, IP)

**Nice to Have Skills:**

* Experience in pre-sales activities, including RFP/RFI responses, technical solution proposals and effort estimation.
* Experience in client consulting: running discovery and solution workshops, assessing business needs and advising on technology choices.
* Ability to present technical solutions convincingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders.
* Experience designing and integrating GenAI/LLM-based solutions (e.g. RAG, AI agents, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), including evaluation, cost and responsible-AI considerations.

**What we offer:**

* Opportunity to be part of a global organization.
* Encouraging working atmosphere, engaging activities, and extra benefits (e.g. additional medical insurance (covers gym subscription), team events, outreach activities, and others);
* Hybrid work model with remote work opportunities ( 3/5 days weekly from the office)
* Open, modern, and ergonomic work environment when working from the office with the multicultural community.
* Opportunity to grow professionally and personally (e.g. Udemy) and continuously develop within the domain.
* The salary range for this position is from **6000 to 7300 EURO gross before taxes.\***  
  + Salary offer for the candidate is determined based on the predefined salary ranges for the position and depends on the level of competence and experience of the candidate.

Cognizant, as a digital company, makes employee health and safety its top priority. With that in mind, we are implementing virtual hiring and work practices which means all interviews will be conducted online as well as live from the office  
We will be looking forward to Your CV.  
Only suitable candidates will be contacted within 7 days from application.

eab4046e.title: Solution Architect
eab4046e.description:
**Ciklum** is looking for a **Solution Architect** to join our team full-time in India.

  

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

  

**About the role:**

As a Solution Architect, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. You will be joining a greenfield B2B Marketplace development for Client Procurement Company (VPC) a centralised procurement entity within the Group based in Luxembourg. The platform is a self service ordering portal for VF WEST deployment partners rolling out fiber-to-home infrastructure across Germany. It replaces fully manual, Excel-based procurement with a governed digital ordering channel integrated into VPC's existing enterprise systems. The solution is built as an API-led web application with a React frontend, .NET backend services, Azure infrastructure, and Entra ID (Azure AD B2C) for authentication. Core integrations include SAP S/4HANA (NSS), WMS (CFL), Transporeon TMS, MDM/MMOLA, and SAP Finance all via an integration middleware layer. The platform covers end-to-end procurement operations: catalogue and stock visibility, partner-specific pricing, checkout, bulk order upload, allocation-based order governance, shipment tracking, invoicing, returns initiation, operational reporting and automated notifications. The architecture is modular and designed to scale across additional customers and deployment partner networks without redesign.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the end-to-end solution architecture for a B2B Marketplace platform integrating with SAP S/4HANA, WMS, TMS, MDM and Azure AD B2C
* Design the integration middleware layer, API contracts and data flow between the Webshop and client backend systems
* Ensure architectural decisions align with enterprise security, scalability and data segregation requirements
* Lead technical discovery sessions with client system owners
* Produce and maintain architecture documentation, integration specs and decision records
* Support engineering teams during implementation to validate alignment with the target architecture
* Participate in pre-sales and client-facing sessions to present and defend technical approach

  

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles
* Proven experience designing API-led integrations with SAP S/4HANA or equivalent ERP systems
* Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services, Entra ID and API management patterns
* Experience with B2B platform or e-commerce portal architecture
* Ability to produce clear architecture diagrams, integration maps and technical documentation
* Comfortable working in Fixed Price delivery with defined scope boundaries
* Strong communication skills — able to present complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders
* Experience in supply chain, logistics or procurement platforms is a strong advantage

  

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

  

**About us:**

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

  

**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

df2a4a48.title: Forward Deployed Architect, Industry Solutions
df2a4a48.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partners product.

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.

Learn more about LifeAtMongoDB here!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

**What you'll do at MongoDB**

* Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
* Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
* Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
* Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
* Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
* Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
* Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

**As an ideal candidate, you will have**

* 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
* Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
* Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

**As an ideal candidate, you may also have**

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDBs broader product portfolio

**What you will learn**

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

54548d07.title: Engineering Lead / Solution Architect
54548d07.description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Lead / Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and production readiness of AI-powered and SaaS applications. The role combines solution architecture, technical decision-making, hands-on coding, code quality ownership, and developer mentoring. This is a technical leadership role rather than a project management position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Technical Design**

* Design scalable, secure, maintainable SaaS and AI application architectures.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Define frontend, backend, API, database, and integration architecture; select appropriate technologies and infrastructure.
* Create architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
* Assess feasibility, scalability, performance, security, and technical risks before development begins.

**Technical Leadership & Code Quality**

* Lead and mentor a team of approximately 67 software developers, including junior engineers.
* Review code and pull requests; establish coding standards, Git workflows, and branch protection practices.
* Write production-quality code for complex or critical modules and resolve challenging technical issues.
* Identify design flaws, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and technical debt.
* Guide developers on debugging, refactoring, testing, and maintainable software design.

**AI-Assisted Development & AI Architecture**

* Define standards for responsible AI-assisted coding using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools.
* Review AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance.
* Establish safe practices for handling confidential information, source code, and credentials when using AI tools.
* Design and review AI-powered application architectures, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Guide document ingestion, embeddings, vector search, retrieval pipelines, and LLM API integrations.
* Evaluate AI response quality, latency, security, and operating costs; support integrations with ML or computer vision systems when required.

**DevOps, Security & Production Readiness**

* Define CI/CD pipelines, deployment standards, and development, staging, and production environments.
* Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or DigitalOcean and container technologies such as Docker.
* Establish secure configuration and secrets management, logging, monitoring, alerting, and error tracking.
* Review authentication, authorization, database migrations, backups, disaster recovery, and rollback procedures.
* Support production incidents, root-cause analysis, and release-readiness reviews.

**Quality Assurance, Mentoring & Delivery**

* Define unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing standards and promote automated test coverage.
* Work with QA to define release acceptance criteria and prevent releases with critical unresolved defects.
* Mentor developers through code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and structured feedback.
* Break complex features into manageable technical tasks, estimate effort, and identify dependencies.
* Coordinate technical work across products and report progress, risks, and engineering quality metrics.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Backend development with Python, Node.js, TypeScript, or equivalent technologies.
* REST API design, authentication, authorization, API security, and microservices or modular-monolith architecture.
* Working knowledge of React, Next.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
* Relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimization.
* Understanding of vector databases, caching, LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines.
* Docker, CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Linux administration, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and incident management.
* Git and pull-request workflows, SOLID principles, design patterns, automated testing, secure coding, and OWASP principles.
* Technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and technical decision records.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8–12 years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in technical leadership or solution architecture.
* Demonstrated experience delivering and supporting production applications.
* Strong hands-on coding, debugging, system design, API architecture, and database design skills.
* Experience leading and mentoring developers, with practical knowledge of cloud deployment, CI/CD, and application security.

**Success Measures**

f0fc7bdf.title: Enterprise Architect
f0fc7bdf.description:
### **Who We Are**

VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a **Human First** philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world's leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML's global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.

VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.

**We are looking for an Enterprise Solutions Architect to join us on a permanent basis. This role can be remote or ideally from Noida or Bangalore.**  
  
**The opportunity:**  
  
Step beyond traditional data modeling into a high-impact, strategic leadership role where you help shape and scale at true enterprise scale. Rather than focusing solely on pipelines and schemas, you will architect the operational backbone of the broader Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem—designing robust frameworks for cross-platform reliability, proactive observability, automated health monitoring, and governance, while bridging product gaps and directly influencing the core engineering roadmap. To succeed, you'll bring broad architectural fluency across Adobe's product suite (including AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and CJA), strong technical command of cloud integrations and APIs, and the executive-level technical leadership required to align cross-functional teams and translate complex platform signals into measurable business value.

### **What we want from you**

* Enterprise solution architecture across multiple products, teams, operational models, and business use cases.
* Ability to design scalable frameworks for platform reliability, health monitoring, operational insights, proactive issue detection, and executive visibility.
* Strong understanding of governance architecture, including access visibility, entitlement tracking, auditability, privacy, compliance, and operational accountability.
* Ability to identify gaps between business needs, operational needs, and current product capabilities, then define practical architecture patterns or prototypes to close those gaps.
* Cross-platform Adobe Experience Cloud understanding across AEP, RTCDP, AJO, CJA, Analytics, Workfront, GenStudio, Experience League, and related integrations.
* Ability to translate complex platform signals into meaningful KPIs, value realization metrics, leadership reporting, and decision-ready insights.
* Strong architecture judgment to decide what should be automated, standardized, monitored, governed, or escalated to product/engineering roadmap.
* Technical fluency with data, APIs, reporting, cloud platforms, and integration patterns, without the role being limited to hands-on pipeline engineering.
* Strong technical leadership to influence cross-functional teams, align stakeholders, guide implementation teams, and connect platform capabilities with measurable business outcomes.

### **What you'll be doing**

We are not looking for traditional AEP DA here. We are looking for solution lead who can guide team, unblock and help R&I take to next level. Few points to consider...

* A traditional AEP Data Architect is primarily focused on core data architecture areas such as XDM design, datasets, identity strategy, ingestion patterns, data modeling, and activation readiness within AEP.
* The R&I Solution Architect role is broader and more outcome-driven.
* It focuses on making Adobe on Adobe reliable, governable, observable, automated, measurable, and scalable across teams and products.
* This includes designing solutions for platform health monitoring, data quality, access governance, operational insights, value realization, automation, and proactive issue detection.
* The key difference is that R&I is not only designing how data flows through AEP. It is designing how the overall Adobe ecosystem operates successfully at enterprise scale.
* R&I also helps close product gaps where out-of-the-box capabilities may not fully meet Customer Zero needs, while partnering closely with engineering and product teams to influence future roadmap.

In short, the R&I Solution Architect role combines solution architecture, operational excellence, governance, automation, observability, and business value measurement. It is a strategic architecture role that goes beyond traditional AEP data design and directly supports the success and scale.

### 

### **What we can offer you**

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we'll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We'll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with **Heart**, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.  
We empower your **Brains** for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.  
And we champion **Courage**, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

  

### **AT VML Enterprise Solutions**

Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world's leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi-channel growth for world-leading brands.

We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes-Benz, Johnson & Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury's, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany & Co. We've built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.

As our business grows internationally, we're looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client's successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

a32f6bc8.title: Principal Architect, Service Now
a32f6bc8.description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Platform Architect, ServiceNow Platform**

**Job Description**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Platform Architect for ServiceNow** to lead complex, cross-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the ServiceNow platform capabilities. This role will be responsible for the overall technical vision, architecture, and integrity of our ServiceNow platform. This role will work closely with Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect, IT leadership, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to ensure our ServiceNow instance is reliable, secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. You will set technical standards, lead platform governance, and design solutions that meet complex business requirements while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

**Experience Range:** 15+ years **Role Level:** Principal, Arch Solutions

**Responsibilities**

**Platform Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and evolve the ServiceNow platform architecture with the Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect, aligning technical decisions with enterprise architecture, technology strategy, and business objectives.
* Translate complex requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions, establishing reusable architectural patterns across applications, data, integrations, security, and automation.
* Provide architectural guidance across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, DevOps, and custom applications.

**Platform Modernization & Innovation**

* Evaluate new ServiceNow releases, features, products, and capabilities, recommending adoption based on business value, architectural fit, and risk.
* Provide architectural leadership for platform upgrades and modernization, increasing adoption of strategic and native capabilities while reducing legacy customization.
* Stay current with ServiceNow innovation and industry trends, contributing to the platform technology roadmap and its ongoing evolution.

**Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards**

* Define and enforce architecture principles, technical standards, design patterns, and engineering guardrails through architecture and design reviews.
* Champion configuration-first and out-of-the-box approaches, reducing unnecessary customization, technical debt, complexity, and architectural risk.
* Promote consistent engineering practices and provide architectural guidance to internal teams and implementation partners.

**Solution & Integration Architecture**

* Design ServiceNow solutions for complex business requirements while maintaining platform integrity, scalability, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Define architecture for enterprise integrations, APIs, MID Servers, data flows, and automation, establishing reusable patterns that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.

**Security, Risk & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security, Risk, Privacy, and Compliance teams to embed security, privacy, resiliency, auditability, and regulatory requirements into platform architecture.
* Assess security and architectural implications of new applications, integrations, plugins, and capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and security standards.

**Reliability, Scalability & Performance**

* Ensure platform architecture supports enterprise requirements for availability, reliability, scalability, performance, and recoverability.
* Provide architectural direction for complex platform, integration, and performance challenges.
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to continuously improve platform health, resilience, and maintainability.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor, working closely with the Lead ServiceNow Platform Architect and Platform Engineering Leads to maintain a cohesive enterprise-wide architectural direction.
* Collaborate across Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Infrastructure, Product Management, Engineering, and business teams.
* Guide technical teams and clearly communicate architecture decisions, options, risks, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 15+ years of IT experience, including significant ServiceNow architecture, engineering, or solution design experience.
* 5+ years as a ServiceNow Architect in a large enterprise environment.
* Strong knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, configuration, application development, integrations, data, and security.
* Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, and enterprise integrations.
* Experience establishing architecture standards, design patterns, governance, and engineering guardrails.
* Strong understanding of ITSM/ITIL, security, privacy, risk, and enterprise technology practices.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.
* Strong communication and influencing skills across technology and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in **financial services or another highly regulated industry**.
* Experience across ServiceNow products such as **ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, IRM, SecOps, HRSD, and DevOps**.
* Experience with enterprise-scale ServiceNow modernization or transformation.
* ServiceNow **CSA** certification; **CIS, CAD, or CTA** certifications preferred.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  

**About Our Pune Office**

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
