2409bb15.title: Lead Engineer Integrated Smart Pole Solutions
2409bb15.description:
**JOB** **PURPOSE : Smart pole development**

Own the end-to-end architecture, integration, development and validation of an integrated Smart Pole solution combining smart lighting, video surveillance, environmental sensing, EV charging and digital LED display capabilities. Deliver a secure, interoperable, remotely managed solution by integrating field devices, embedded firmware, communication protocols and software platforms into a scalable, reliable product for smart cities, infrastructure and commercial applications.

**KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define end-to-end system architecture for an integrated Smart Pole, covering smart LED lighting, CCTV/IP cameras, environmental sensors (air quality, temperature, humidity, noise and other applicable parameters), EV chargers, digital LED display/signage and the central connected management platform.
* Translate business, customer and project requirements into system specifications, interface-control documents, block diagrams, integration plans, acceptance criteria and product requirements.
* Lead hardware, embedded firmware, device, network and application integration across heterogeneous vendors and technologies; manage interface dependencies and resolve system-level issues.
* Integrate communication and application protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, Modbus, TCP/IP, ONVIF, RTSP, BLE, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, LoRaWAN, cellular and other relevant protocols as applicable to selected devices.
* Define and integrate device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, remote monitoring, diagnostics, alarms, OTA firmware/software updates, data logging, dashboards and fleet/device lifecycle management.
* Lead firmware and software integration with cloud/edge platforms, mobile/web applications, analytics, video management systems, lighting controls, EV charging management systems and third-party enterprise/city platforms.
* Establish cybersecurity-by-design for devices and platforms, including secure boot, signed firmware, identity and certificate management, authentication/authorization, encryption, key management, network segmentation, vulnerability management and secure update mechanisms.
* Ensure interoperability, scalability, availability and performance across multi-vendor devices; define fallback modes, offline behaviour, time synchronisation, data integrity and fault recovery.
* Plan and execute integration testing, system verification, field trials, reliability testing, cybersecurity testing and user acceptance; manage defects through root-cause analysis and closure.
* Coordinate with electronics, mechanical, lighting, firmware, software, cloud, cybersecurity, EV charging, camera, sensor, display, manufacturing, quality, sourcing and service teams, as well as external technology partners.
* Evaluate vendors and technical solutions; review datasheets, SDKs, APIs, protocol specifications, firmware release notes and compliance evidence. Drive proof-of-concepts and technical due diligence.
* Prepare and maintain architecture documents, interface specifications, BOM inputs, test plans, deployment guides, service procedures and technical documentation.
* Support design-for-manufacturing, installation and commissioning, remote serviceability, lifecycle management, cost optimisation and product roadmap planning.
* Drive project execution, risks, milestones and technical reviews; mentor engineers and ensure delivery against agreed quality, cost, performance and schedule targets.

**EDUCATIONAL** **QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelors degree in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication / Electrical / Instrumentation / Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
* Master’s degree or relevant specialisation in embedded systems, IoT, networking, cybersecurity or systems engineering is an advantage.

**WORK** **EXPERIENCE**

  

* 10–12 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, system integration, connected devices or industrial/urban technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership of at least one complex, multi-device solution from architecture and proof-of-concept through integration, validation and deployment.
* Hands-on experience integrating hardware, firmware, communication protocols, APIs and cloud/edge software across multiple vendors.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

  

Relevant certifications in IoT, embedded systems, networking, cloud architecture or cyber-security are desirable (e.g., cloud/IoT platform, networking or security certifications).

**PREFERRED/** **ADDITIONAL** **REQUIREMENT**

  

* Strong understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS, device drivers, firmware lifecycle, OTA updates, APIs, SDKs, databases and cloud/edge architectures.
* Practical exposure to smart lighting controls, IP video surveillance, environmental sensors, EV charging systems and digital signage is highly desirable.
* Experience with MQTT brokers, REST APIs, device management platforms, Linux tools, packet/protocol analysis and integration/debugging tools.
* Knowledge of device and platform security, secure coding practices, threat modelling, vulnerability handling and relevant standards such as IEC 62443 is an advantage.
* Ability to read schematics, interface diagrams, protocol documents and firmware/software logs; strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience in smart city, street lighting, infrastructure, industrial IoT or public-space deployments is preferred.
* Willingness to support field integration, commissioning and troubleshooting at customer/vendor locations as required.

**REPORTEES**

  

May guide and coordinate integration engineers / cross-functional project resources; formal direct reportees to be defined based on project structure.

**INTERNAL** **/** **EXTERNAL** **INTERFACE**

  

Internal: R&D – Electronics, Firmware, Software, IoT/Cloud, Lighting, Mechanical, Cybersecurity, Quality, Testing & Validation, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Product Management, Sales/Projects and Service.

External: Camera, sensor, EV charger, LED display and lighting suppliers; system integrators; cloud/platform partners; telecom/network providers; cybersecurity/testing agencies; customers, EPCs and smart-city/municipal stakeholders.

**FUNCTIONAL** **COMPETENCIES**

  

* System architecture and systems engineering
* IoT and multi-protocol integration / API integration
* Embedded firmware and device lifecycle management
* Cloud/edge platform and application integration
* Device, network and platform cybersecurity
* Integration planning, verification, validation and field commissioning
* Technical documentation, vendor evaluation and root-cause analysis
* Project execution, risk management and cross-functional coordination

**BEHAVIORAL** **COMPETENCIES**

  

* Think Beyond
* Put Customers first
* Collaborate to Win
* Develop Talent
* Be the Best
* Be Agile

33771a39.title: Solutions Engineer II
33771a39.description:
At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world, a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.  
  
The Enterprise Technology mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross-company collaborative innovation. Our group drives competitive advantage by enhancing our consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence.

Team Description:

As a Solutions Architect, Citizen Development & AI at Disney Enterprise Tech Collaboration Experiences, you are responsible to drive world-class solution architecture and citizen development practices that empower business users to build intelligent applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI. You’ll partner across technology, engineering, product management, and business teams to enable scalable, secure, and transformative AI-powered solutions that enhance collaboration and productivity across the enterprise.

Responsibilities of Role:

Solution Architecture:

* Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Azure AI, integrating with SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive and enterprise systems such using available connectors or creating them.

* Design and deploy custom Copilot agents and AI workflows that automate business processes and enhance productivity for citizen developers and business users.

* Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI-powered solutions.

* Define and implement governance frameworks for agent development, deployment, and lifecycle management, ensuring compliance with enterprise security and data protection standards.

* Evaluate and optimize AI solutions for performance, cost efficiency, and user experience.

Enablement & Community:

* Lead technical workshops, training sessions, and hackathons to enable citizen developers and promote AI literacy across the organization.

* Consult with business stakeholders to gather detailed requirements and collaboratively identify tailored solution pathways that address their needs and drive enterprise transformation.

* Contribute to the AI Community of Practice, sharing best practices and mentoring junior architects and developers.

Must Haves:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, with at least 2 years focused on AI, automation, or low-code platforms.

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Azure AI services.

* Strong understanding of declarative and custom-engine agent development, orchestration models, and integration with Microsoft Graph and external connectors.

* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex technical solutions in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

* Familiarity with AI governance, data privacy, and security frameworks.

Nice To Haves:

* Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure AI, or Solution Architecture.

* Experience with citizen development enablement, including training, onboarding, and community building.

* Knowledge of MCP, A2A and Agent Frameworks.

* Knowledge of Copilot Studio reference architectures, adaptive cards, and generative orchestration strategies.

* Prior experience in the media, entertainment, or streaming industry.

* Familiarity with Disney’s technology platforms, data environments, and compliance standards.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field (Master’s preferred) or equivalent experience.

 **Disclaimer**  

This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call The Walt Disney Company (Corporate).

To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here.

Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

86f06880.title: FSI Solutions Arch, FSI Solutions Arch
86f06880.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
AWS India is looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to help advise our Financial Services & Insurance (FSI) customers in India on how to best adopt and leverage the value of AWS technology. This is an ideal role for someone with deep experience in the FSI industry, expert knowledge of financial services applications and infrastructure and a solid understanding of the transformational value cloud technologies can bring.
  
  
In this role, you will engage with customers in India to determine business needs, identify opportunities and issues, and develop related technical solutions and value propositions leveraging the power of AWS cloud technology.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
#aws-ags-India
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design customer solutions with a focus on the Financial Services industry, collaborating with the AWS Business Development function and internal teams in India to help customers migrate to AWS cloud-based technology solutions.
* Architect solutions leveraging AWS technology, including solution development and potentially demonstrate technical feasibility through mechanisms including proof-of-concepts and/or prototypes.
* Serve as a thought leadership, evangelizing AWS services and technologies through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking opportunities such as AWS first-party events and third-party industry events.
* Capture and share best practices and insights internally and with Partners and customers in India.
* Identifying customer requirements and providing feedback into appropriate AWS services teams. Provide updates on customer progress and ensure plan execution by partners.
* The right individual will leverage FSI Industry expertise, architecture experience, and customer-facing skills to be a "trusted advisor" to customers. They will be able to facilitate relationships with senior executive stakeholders, as well as easily interact with and give guidance to technology experts, software developers, IT professionals, and system architects to ensure better CX and compliance with global AWS standards, practices and policies.
* The right individual will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges. If you are someone who enjoys innovating, likes solving hard problems and working on cutting edge technology, we would love to hear from you.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS India - Maharashtra

**AI-first software engineering company**
helping startups, scale-ups, and enterprises build intelligent software products, modernize legacy systems, automate operations, and accelerate digital transformation.

**AI + human engineering expertise**
to deliver scalable solutions across AI, Cloud, Data, Automation, Digital Engineering, and Product Development.

**Solutions Architect**
who can bridge business requirements and technical execution.

You will work closely with clients, founders, business development, product, and engineering teams to understand complex business challenges and translate them into
**scalable, secure, AI-powered technology solutions**
.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable discussing business problems with a
**CTO/CIO**
and diving deep into architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data systems, AI/ML, integrations, and software engineering.

**client-facing and hands-on architecture role**
with significant ownership across the solution lifecycle.

* Design end-to-end technology architectures for complex software and AI initiatives.
* Translate business requirements into scalable and technically feasible solutions.
* Define application, system, data, AI/ML, cloud, integration, and infrastructure architecture.
* Select appropriate technologies, frameworks, platforms, APIs, and third-party services.
* Create architecture diagrams, technical specifications, solution blueprints, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate scalability, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
* Identify technical risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.

  **Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, conversational AI, NLP, machine learning, and AI automation**
  .
* Identify opportunities where AI can improve business processes, products, and customer experiences.
* Architect AI-powered applications and intelligent automation workflows.
* Evaluate LLMs, AI models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, APIs, and AI infrastructure.
* Design solutions for integrating AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications.

Cloud & Infrastructure

* Design cloud-native solutions using platforms such as
  **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud**
  .
* Define infrastructure architecture, deployment strategies, networking, security, scalability, and observability.
* Work with DevOps engineers to establish CI/CD and infrastructure automation requirements.
* Evaluate cloud architecture based on performance, security, scalability, and cost optimization.

Data & Integration

* Define API, microservices, event-driven, and third-party integration architectures.
* Architect integrations with enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, payment systems, CRMs, ERPs, and other business applications.

* Lead technical discovery and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Create technical proposals, solution approaches, architecture presentations, and statements of work.

* Cloud-Native Architecture
* System Design

* AI APIs and orchestration frameworks

* Infrastructure as Code

* Monitoring & Observability

* GraphQL

* Third-party integrations
* Message queues and event streaming

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong client-facing and consulting mindset.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in simple business language.

* Ability to manage multiple solutioning opportunities simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and decision-making ability.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

* AI/ML consulting
* Software engineering services
* Digital transformation
* IT consulting
* SaaS
* Enterprise technology
* Cloud consulting
* Product engineering
* System integration
* Technical pre-sales

Experience working with
**US, UK, Canada, Australia, or UAE-based clients**
will be an advantage.

* Architecture diagrams and technical documentation
* AI/technology solution assessments
* Technical proposals and solution presentations
* Technical discovery workshops
* Technology recommendations
* Proof-of-concept planning
* Project implementation roadmaps
* Architecture reviews
* Technical risk assessments
* Client technical presentations
* Engineering guidance and mentorship

* Architecture scalability, security, and cost efficiency.

**Senior Solutions Architect → Principal Solutions Architect → Head of Solutions Architecture → Head of Engineering → CTO**

  **AI-first technology solutions**

9e5cd6af.description:
**Description**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Knowledge of cloud architecture
* 10+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies
* Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals
* 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* 10+ years' experience in designing and implementing large distributed systems, with deep expertise in core infrastructure, solution architecture, and distributed computing patterns.
* Professional experience in pre-sales consulting with proven presentation skills, executive engagement capabilities, and track record of effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels while managing ambiguous requirements.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

11e6219b.title: AI Security Architect
11e6219b.description:
About the Role

HCLSoftware is seeking an accomplished security expert as Senior Security Architect to design our Secure Design and Supply Chain Security operations program. The successful candidate will act as the senior most expert within the organization on Secure Design and Supply Chain Security. The candidate will shape and influence design decisions and set the bar across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have a strong development background combined with an expert understanding of cybersecurity principles.

Key Responsibilities

**Secure Design & Architecture**

* Rapid architectural triage: Demonstrated ability to quickly unpack unfamiliar product architectures across diverse ecosystems (Java, JS/TS, C/C++, Go, Python), identify systemic risks, and provide pragmatic security guidance.
* Code-to-cloud security: Deep understanding of container security (from Linux kernel primitives up through Kubernetes) and common hyperscaler patterns for securing applications.
* Adversarial perspective: Ability to look at designs through an attacker's lens to poke holes in assumptions, trust boundaries, and multi-tier architectures during the design and coding phases. Ability to find issues before they ship.

**Supply Chain Security, Cryptography & DevSecOps**

* Supply chain and cryptography: Strong command of software supply chain security, artifact authentication, and the enterprise management of secrets, keys, and high-value cryptographic assets.
* Hacker/builder mindset: Active or recent development background. Comfortable writing glue code and building pragmatic internal solutions rather than waiting for expensive, off-the-shelf commercial software.
* SBOM and open source fluency: Experience operationalizing SBOM pipelines (e.g., Dependency-Track) and a deep understanding of open-source risks like typosquatting and dependency confusion.
* Enterprise code signing and CLM: Hands-on experience deploying, automating, and maintaining enterprise-scale code signing systems and Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms.

**Applied AI & Security Automation**

* DevSecOps w/ AI experience: Command of modern CI/CD pipelines with knowledge of how AI tooling can be integrated into architecture reviews, code analysis, and threat modeling workflows.
* Individual technical communication: Strong written communication skills. Able to dissect complex security designs and document nuanced threats independently without relying on superficial, AI-generated filler.
* Open weight model use: Experience exploring, benchmarking, or deploying open-source AI models (e.g., Qwen, Gemma) for internal automation, static analysis, vulnerability triage, or cost-efficient security operations.
* AI threat surfaces/defenses: Understanding of novel attack patterns targeting AI-enabled applications (prompt injection, model tampering, training data risks, and AI supply chain dependencies).

**Leadership, Strategic Buffer & Execution**

* Strategic buffer and priority management: Proven ability to act as an operational shield for a small team absorbing executive priority shifts, triaging ad-hoc tangents, and translating ambiguous directives into clear, protected sprint goals.
* Influence and political acumen: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the confidence to navigate difficult, high-stakes conversations with senior engineering leadership and product managers about risk vs. velocity tradeoffs.
* High-concurrency execution: Thrives as a scrappy "player/coach". Skilled at using Jira to aggressively track and deliver across a massive backlog of concurrent initiatives, while remaining comfortable jumping into the weeds to help troubleshoot technical blockers.

Required Qualifications

* 10+ years of relevant experience spanning cybersecurity, application security, software engineering, or secure software development.
* Significant hands-on software development experience, with depth in at least one major language ecosystem (Java, JS/TS, C/C++, Go, Python) and the ability to assess unfamiliar codebases and architectures.
* Demonstrated experience leading threat modeling, security architecture reviews, and remediation discussions with engineering teams.
* Proven experience with container security (Linux kernel primitives, Kubernetes) and securing cloud application architectures.
* Strong command of software supply chain security, artifact authentication, and enterprise management of secrets, keys, and cryptographic assets.
* Demonstrated expertise operationalizing Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) pipelines (e.g., Dependency-Track) and mitigating open-source supply chain risks.
* Experience integrating AI tooling and automation into CI/CD pipelines, code analysis, architecture reviews, and threat modeling workflows.
* Strong written and technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly document complex threats and architectural guidance independently.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills to manage priority shifts, act as an operational shield for engineering teams, and navigate high-stakes technical conversations.

Preferred Qualifications

* Strong adversarial perspective to identify architectural vulnerabilities, trust boundary assumptions, and design flaws prior to shipment.
* Hands-on experience deploying, automating, and maintaining enterprise-scale code signing systems (e.g., Garasign) and Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms.
* Experience exploring, benchmarking, or deploying open-weight AI models (e.g., Qwen, Gemma) for internal automation, static analysis, or vulnerability triage
* Understanding of novel attack surfaces and defense strategies targeting AI-enabled applications (prompt injection, model tampering, training data risks).

You own end-to-end architecture for your projects, stay close to implementation where it matters, and work with teams to meet goals for value, security, performance, reliability, and cost. At this level, you lead solution design in your primary domain, guide engineers day to day, and mentor other architects and technical leads. You turn business needs into clear technical plans, help teams make good tradeoffs, and keep delivery predictable and high quality.

***Responsibilities***

Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

* Own end-to-end architecture and scope for your projects, leading teams to design and deliver Azure solutions that meet agreed goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.

* Design end-to-end analytics architecture spanning ingestion, lakehouse, semantic layer, and consumption—including a conversational/agent layer built on Microsoft Fabric data agents and Databricks Genie.
* Advise clients on Power BI / Microsoft Fabric architecture, governance, capacity, and deployment strategy.
* Embed AI-augmented and agentic capabilities—LLMs grounded on governed semantic models via Model Context Protocol (MCP)—and intelligent decision systems into solution designs.
* Architect end-to-end decision-intelligence systems across the data signal decision action learning stack—OneLake/Lakehouse and Databricks, AI-ready semantic/knowledge models, Fabric data agents and Databricks Genie, translytical task flows, and AI-augmented decision workflows.
* Design the agent, write-back, and human-in-the-loop governance layers so analytics drives action directly rather than handing off to a separate operational system.
* Delivery and Consulting Excellence
* Lead discovery and requirements sessions for your workstreams, clarifying scope, dependencies, and risks, and shaping a prioritized backlog with clear acceptance criteria tied to business outcomes.
* Explain complex technical topics in simple, direct language for both technical and non-technical audiences, and consistently connect technical decisions back to client goals.
* Build trust with managers and product owners, influencing priorities and roadmaps in ways that support the client’s long-term interests.
* Enable teams to deliver with stable velocity and low defect rates by providing clear architecture, interfaces, and automation across build, test, and deployment, and by designing for incremental delivery with a clear Definition of Done.
* Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through delivery.
* Support effective Agile practices by ensuring the architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, a clear Definition of Done, and data-informed course corrections based on telemetry and feedback.
* Mentorship and Team Development
* Mentor others through pairing, design reviews, and clear feedback that strengthens design skills, technical judgment, and confidence, with a particular focus on senior engineers and technical leads.
* Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and teaching others when to keep designs simple and when to introduce new patterns or technologies.
* Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and cross-project mentorship.
* Growth and Innovation
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities across all our capabilities (beyond own specialty) and communicating them to the sales director.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on pursuits by defining the cloud vision, contributing architectural viewpoints, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap discussions.
* Produce solution options, high-level designs, and estimates in your domains, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and explaining how proposed approaches drive business value and reduce risk.
* Create and maintain reusable assets—such as runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that make it easier for engineers to deliver consistent solutions.
* Champion modern frameworks, patterns, tools, and AI-assisted practices that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a secure and responsible way.
* Actively participate in enablement efforts that support a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing

***Requirements***

* 6+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary domain such as application development, cloud platform engineering, DevOps, or data and analytics.
* 3+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams.
* 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or 5+ in consulting.
* Deep expertise in Power BI, including:
* Enterprise report and dashboard design.

* Power BI Service administration and deployment pipelines.

* Strong SQL skills and experience optimizing analytical queries.

* Expertise in at least one major public cloud platform, with Azure strongly preferred.
* Deep understanding of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them to build robust, maintainable systems.
* Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions through APIs, libraries, or cloud-based AI services.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Direct Lake, Dataflows Gen2, data agents) and/or Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Genie).

* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

a96c701a.description:

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Sovereign Cloud Client Manager will lead Lenovo’s growth agenda for sovereign, private, hybrid and disconnected cloud solutions across strategic enterprise and public-sector customers. The role will identify, shape and close complex opportunities where data control, jurisdictional requirements, security, operational authority, resilience and regulatory compliance are critical.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the primary customer-facing sales leader, engaging CXOs, technology leaders, risk and compliance stakeholders, and lines of business. The role will orchestrate Lenovo infrastructure, services, software, security, financing and partner capabilities to deliver end-to-end sovereign cloud outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Account Leadership
  
  

* Own the sovereign cloud strategy and sales plan for a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and sectors.
* Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity roadmaps and executive engagement strategies.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, risk and compliance leaders, and business decision makers.
* Lead long-term transformation conversations rather than transactional infrastructure sales.

Sovereign Cloud Opportunity Creation
  
  

* Identify opportunities across sovereign private cloud, hybrid cloud, disconnected environments, data residency, regulated workloads, secure collaboration, sovereign AI and workload repatriation.
* Qualify customer requirements covering data location, access control, encryption-key custody, operational control, auditability, resilience and legal or regulatory exposure.
* Translate business, security and compliance challenges into measurable customer outcomes and compelling business cases.
* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria and forecast discipline.

Solution Shaping Advisory
  
  

* Work with solution architects and services teams to define the customer’s target sovereignty posture and deployment model.
* Shape solutions spanning Lenovo ThinkAgile, compute, storage, networking, security, management, lifecycle services and as-a-service capabilities.
* Position hybrid and disconnected operating models based on workload criticality, regulatory needs, connectivity and operational requirements.
* Ensure the proposed architecture aligns infrastructure, software, services, governance and customer operating processes.

Pursuit Deal Management
  
  

* Lead pursuit strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder sovereign cloud opportunities.
* Orchestrate resources across ISG, SSG, product, pre-sales, security, finance, legal, delivery and business partners.
* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.
* Maintain opportunity hygiene, forecasting accuracy, review cadence and executive sponsorship.

Executive Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Create and execute CXO engagement plans, executive briefings, workshops and sovereignty discovery sessions.
* Position Lenovo as a strategic partner for secure, compliant and resilient cloud transformation.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and other cloud, software, security, networking and services partners to build differentiated solutions.
* Represent customer requirements internally and influence solution, go-to-market and investment priorities.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified sovereign cloud pipeline and progression through agreed sales stages.
* Revenue, margin and signings performance against assigned targets.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and expansion within priority accounts.
* Quality of account plans, executive relationships, forecast accuracy and cross-functional execution.
* Customer adoption outcomes and creation of repeatable references or use cases.

Education Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; full-time MBA preferred.
* 12-18 years of overall experience, including at least 10 years in enterprise technology sales.
* Minimum 3 years of consultative or value-based solution selling in cloud, data center, security, infrastructure, managed services or complex transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing large accounts and multi-party pursuits involving customers, OEMs, cloud providers, software partners and system integrators.
* Experience in regulated industries, government, critical infrastructure or customers with stringent sovereignty requirements is strongly preferred.

Skills Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of sovereign cloud principles, including data residency, jurisdictional control, access governance, key custody, auditability, resilience and disconnected operations.

05ba5a62.description:
**Description**
Picture this: You're about to lead the team that decides whether a customer in London gets their package tomorrow or next week, whether a family in Madrid pays €5 or €15 for delivery, and whether someone in Luxembourg receives three boxes or one perfectly consolidated package. We're looking for an L6 Sr. Technical program Manager to join our Delivery Experience (DEX) team – think of it as mission control for Amazon EU's delivery operations, where your decisions ripple across millions of doorsteps every single day. You'll be the strategic mastermind behind our vision of high-speed, low-cost delivery for all EU customers, juggling the exciting challenge of making deliveries faster while simultaneously making them cheaper (yes, we know that sounds like magic, but that's why we need you!). This isn't just any Sr. TPM role – you're getting a front-row seat with the STeam, driving Stores' biggest bets in EU, and basically becoming the person everyone turns to when they ask "how do we crack the customer delivery experience?" Based in Bengaluru, you'll be working on problems so complex and impactful that your morning coffee conversations will involve optimizing networks across entire countries. Ready to turn delivery from a logistics challenge into a customer superpower?
  
  
You understand that a successful program needs to solve meaningful problems for our customers, for our business, and for our technology. You will work with engineers, designers, and our business teams to build a global marketplace product that expedites Amazon’s expansion worldwide.

* You can raise the bar on customer-obsessed thinking – at a global scale.
* You are strategic thinker with a strong focus on delivery on strategy and tech
* You communicate your ideas boldly and vision to all levels of the company – both verbally and in writing.
* You align stakeholders on your roadmap
* You thrive on data - a statement that is not supported by data is just another opinion.
* You are brave, have persistence and grit, never hesitate to challenge the status quo.
* You are curious, can dive into technical detail, and ask engineers insightful questions about the services and systems you influence.
* You are a self-starter who is able to work in an environment of high complexity and ambiguity.
* You think long-term, can balance diverse and conflicting customer needs, and converge on outcomes that earn customer loyalty.
* You break down the big picture into actionable goals and deliver them.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
**You Will Be Responsible For**

* You will own delivery and roadmap for 20+ HC team.
* Articulating tech vision and value proposition for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansion.
* Working backwards from the customers around the globe to build, manage, and deliver a technical marketplace expansion roadmap.
* Working with Amazon EU businesses around the globe to define solutions for Amazon’s worldwide marketplace expansions in the different regions.
* Influencing technical priorities and business strategy through data-driven contributions, working directly with business stakeholders, engineering managers, engineers, and designers.
* Driving product discussions as well as commissioning market research, usability studies, and focus groups.
* Developing product plans with clear measurable success criteria, using mechanisms and metrics for KPIs, funnels, conversion, and awareness.
* Supporting branding and marketing of your team and programs.

A day in the life
  
  
Successful applicants will have experience solid delivery, leading cross-functional teams, and communicating to a large number of diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**

**300+ native integrations**

**200+ global security standards natively**

**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
This role owns technical success for Sprinto's most complex enterprise deals, partnering with senior CISOs and executive stakeholders across regulated industries. It combines deep information security expertise, enterprise solution design, and stakeholder management to drive complex sales cycles, influence product direction, enable seamless implementation handoffs, and establish best practices for enterprise solution engineering.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Own the technical strategy and solutioning for Sprinto's most complex enterprise opportunities across BFSI, telecom, manufacturing, critical infrastructure, and other regulated industries
* Build trusted relationships with senior CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, GRC leaders, and executive stakeholders by confidently discussing security architecture, control design, compliance frameworks, and risk management
* Lead technical discovery, solution workshops, and tailored product demonstrations for complex, multi-entity enterprise environments
* Design and execute proof-of-concepts (POCs), sandbox evaluations, solution architectures, and business cases with clearly defined success criteria
* Partner closely with Account Executives to navigate long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving security, IT, procurement, legal, compliance, and business teams
* Drive technical wins by addressing enterprise security reviews, technical objections, and regulatory requirements across multiple frameworks
* Ensure seamless handoffs to implementation and Customer Success teams, enabling successful customer onboarding and long-term adoption
* Act as the voice of enterprise customers by influencing Sprinto's product roadmap with insights from regulated industries and large-scale deployments
* Build and continuously improve enterprise solution engineering assets, including playbooks, competitive positioning, framework-specific messaging, and demo environments
* Mentor Solution Engineers and help establish best practices for engaging senior technical buyers across enterprise accounts

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* 8–12+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Pre-sales, Solution Architecture, Information Security, or GRC consulting
* Demonstrated success supporting complex enterprise sales cycles with senior security stakeholders across large organisations
* Deep understanding of enterprise security, governance, risk, and compliance, with hands-on knowledge of frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, NIST, NIS2, TISAX, and similar standards
* Familiarity with regional regulatory requirements across APAC and EMEA, including RBI, SEBI, IRDAI, CERT-In, DPDP Act, and related security regulations
* Strong cloud and SaaS architecture knowledge across AWS, Azure, GCP, identity management, and hybrid enterprise environments
* Ability to engage experienced CISOs as a trusted advisor by discussing security strategy, control philosophy, audit readiness, and risk—not just product capabilities
* Experience working with enterprise security or GRC platforms, or within consulting organisations advising large regulated enterprises
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor are highly preferred
* Strong executive presence, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business leaders while going deep with security practitioners
* Proven ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, Implementation, and Customer Success while operating with high ownership, curiosity, and a bias for action

**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

7d0a2f0c.title: Presales Consultant
7d0a2f0c.description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Global Sales**
at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Sales Specialists & Consultants are product, services, software or solution specialists that are responsible for leading pursuit in their assigned focus areas. Collaborates with and supports Account Managers and provides specialist expertise within the sales team. Drives proactive campaigns to build the pipeline, uses specialized knowledge and skills to prospect, qualify, negotiate and close opportunities. May have named accounts allocated, cover a designated geography, or may be allocated to one high-potential, competitive attack account.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Applies intermediate level of subject matter knowledge to solve a variety of common business issues. Works on problems of moderately complex scope. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and limited project direction input. Exercises independent judgment within defined practices and procedures to determine appropriate action. Follows established guidelines and interprets policies. Evaluates unique circumstances and makes recommendations.
  
  
**The Services Sales Consultant**
is responsible for selling technology, services and/or technology management services (TMS) to end-user customers (and/or partners) in an assigned geographic territory or industry focusing on new business or up-selling within an account. The position requires a solid understanding of the services value proposition and how customers assign services contracts. Knowledge of marketing campaigns to align initiatives with account planning activities is also required. The Services Consultant develops consultative customer proposals, tailoring strategy and solutions to meet the needs of the customer. They understand the customer’s business challenges /objectives to provide value added services and solutions. In some instances these specialists may also be responsible for outsourcing deals.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Actively prospects within accounts to discover or cultivate solutions sales opportunities within area of technical specialty (in close cooperation with the account manager.
* Manage sales pipeline.
* Formulate and expand solutions to generate additional product or service attachments and up sell revenue.
* Certain roles may also sell through the channel.
* Establish a professional, working, and consultative, relationship with the client, by developing a core understanding of the unique business needs of the client within their industry.
* Work with the client up to IT management level.
* Contribute to building of the pipeline by generating leads and referrals and new customer opportunities within specialty area.
* May focus on growing contractual renewals for small-to-mid size accounts with limited complexity, to higher-total contract-value renewals.
* Interface with both internal and external/industry experts to anticipate customer needs and facilitate solutions development.
* Build sales readiness and reduce client learning curve through effective knowledge transfer in area of specialization.

**What You Need To Bring**

* University or Bachelor's degree preferred. Demonstrated achievement of progressively higher quota, diversity of business customer and higher level customer interface.
* Detailed knowledge of key customer types or customers on given products.
* Typically 3-5 years of experience in specialty sales.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* In depth knowledge about product, service, solution and differentiators between own offerings and what competitor's offerings.
* Applies specialized technical product/service/ solution knowledge in working with account teams to screen and prioritize multiple leads for feasibility.
* Use knowledge in specialty, and consultative selling skills, to proactively help customers with making IT business decisions.
* Assesses solution feasibility from a technical and business perspective to determine "qualify-in"/"qualify-out" status
* Solid communication and presentation skills within IT at the manager level.
* Product demonstration, customer training, product installation skills. (for product specialty roles)
* Conceptualizes and articulates well-targeted solutions in area of specialty - product, service, solution -- from proposal to contract sign- off.
* Have enough knowledge about a product, service or solution to be able to qualify a deal.
* Negotiates profitable deals so that the company can expand opportunities based on the existing business and increase the company's footprint and revenue.
* Opportunity prospecting as related to specialty area and in expanding existing client business, in order to generate leads/referrals to account team.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends, associated solutions, and key partner/ISV solutions.
* Regular use of Siebel updating deal profile and forecasting accurately.

**Accessibility**
HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
  
  
Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
**Health & Wellbeing**
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
  
  
**Personal & Professional Development**
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
  
  
**Unconditional Inclusion**
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
  
  
**Let's Stay Connected**
Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

f96bde7a.title: Network - Specialist Solutions Engineer
f96bde7a.description:
AHEAD’s Specialist Solutions Engineers are the technical experts that collaborate with our AHEAD account teams to help identify, qualify, and build solutions that support our customer’s Digital Business transformation.

The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of **Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies**. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple **SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies.** Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement.

The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Active participation in the AHEAD Network SSE team, advisory and delivery teams.
* Working with the AHEAD partner management team and directly with selected strategic vendors to maintain technical and sales relationships.
* Be a thought leader within the Solutions Engineering organization, responsible for designing, architecting, and at times consulting for AHEAD clients.
* Build skills, relationships, and industry credibility across many segments to drive product, services, and consulting sales.
* Support the sales teams during engagements by providing advice and solutions or proposals optimized to meet customer technical and business requirements.
* Develop relationships with other Network SSE team members, leaders, and partners in support of sales objectives.
* Strategize and execute technical sales calls.
* Complete required pre-sales documentation (configurations, pricing, services, presentations, justifications, etc.) quickly and accurately.
* Qualify sales opportunities in terms of customer technical requirements, decision-making process, and funding.
* Present and market the design and value of proposed AHEAD solutions and business justification to customers, prospects, and AHEAD management.
* Participate in the mentorship of entry-level team members.
* Possess strong, detailed product/technology/industry knowledge.
* Knowledge of job-associated software and applications.

### **Qualifications:**

* Network Infrastructure Experience
* Cisco certifications are required. Examples: CCIE, CCNP
* Cisco Nexus 9K, ACI, 7K, 5K, 2K, 1K
* Experience with Converged Network Fabrics / Converged Infrastructure Systems.
* IP Routing Protocols
* Layer 2 protocols and technologies
* Cisco Core Datacenter Technologies
* ACI
* Network Management
* MPLS,DMVPN, Multicast
* Firewalls,VPN, IPSec / L2TP etc.
* Network Security

### **Other Skills:**

* **Innovation Mindset:** Ability to identify and leverage emerging Datacenter technologies to drive innovative solutions that meet evolving client needs.
* **Automation Expertise:** Advanced understanding of automation frameworks and scripting to optimize Datacenter operations and reduce manual effort.
* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills with a focus on troubleshooting complex Datacenter environments, including storage, compute, and networking issues.
* **Consultative Approach:** Ability to engage with clients as a trusted advisor, guiding them through the decision-making process with clear, strategic recommendations.
* **Collaboration Skills:** Proven track record of working effectively across teams, including sales, engineering, and vendor partners, to deliver cohesive solutions.
* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest industry trends, certifications, and best practices related to Datacenter technologies.
* **Security Awareness:** Knowledge of Network security best practices, ensuring that proposed solutions adhere to compliance and regulatory standards.
