506e216d.title: Senior Sales & Client Delivery Manager
506e216d.description:
**About Dole’s Music**

Dole’s Music is a premier music production house and audio studio dedicated to empowering independent artists, creators, and musicians. From state-of-the-art music production, recording, and mix-mastering to creative mentoring, we provide end-to-end solutions that turn raw talent and creative concepts into industry-ready sound.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an energetic, execution-driven
**Senior Sales & Client Delivery Lead**
to head our B2C sales and client fulfillment engine. In this role, you will convert aspiring artists, musicians, and creators into long-term clients, own revenue quotas, and manage the full client lifecycle - from the initial consultation to coordinating with studio engineers and delivering finished projects.

You will also hire, train, and manage an agile team of sales and project coordinators, building structured playbooks to ensure exceptional conversion rates and seamless project handoffs.

**Key Responsibilities1. B2C Revenue Generation & Pipeline Conversion**

* Own team revenue targets by converting inbound inquiries, social media leads, walk-ins, and workshop attendees into enrolled clients and package bookings.
* Conduct consultative discovery calls, studio tours, and pitches to artists, independent creators, and music enthusiasts.
* Lead high-touch negotiations, overcome price/creative objections, and close high-ticket production or recording packages.
* Coordinate closely with the performance marketing team to provide real-time feedback on lead quality, campaign targeting, and cost-per-acquisition.

**2. Project Coordination & Delivery Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients once a deal is closed, ensuring a white-glove onboarding experience.
* Coordinate scheduling, track milestones, and manage deadlines between clients and internal studio personnel (audio engineers, producers, mixing/mastering artists).
* Handle scope management, client feedback cycles, and revision handoffs to guarantee projects are delivered on time and within agreed creative specs.
* Drive post-delivery satisfaction to secure client retention, up-sells, referral business, and recurring artist packages.

**3. Team Building, Coaching & Training**

* Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of B2C sales executives and project coordinators.
* Develop standardized sales collateral, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and project management SOPs.
* Conduct regular call audits, pipeline reviews, and performance coaching to improve individual conversion benchmarks and coordination efficiency.

**4. CRM, Operations & Performance Reporting**

* Ensure strict CRM discipline across the team (tracking leads, conversion stages, payment status, and delivery schedules).
* Report weekly and monthly metrics to leadership, including sales conversion rates, CAC feedback, pipeline health, client turnaround times, and customer satisfaction scores.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  4–7 years of demonstrated success in high-velocity B2C sales, sales-assisted conversions, or client account management. Experience in
  **music academies, creative studios, or media production**
  or similar fields is preferred.
* **Coordination & Project Ownership:**
  Proven ability to manage client deliverables, timelines, and multi-stakeholder operational workflows without dropping details.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Experience hiring, training, and running a quota-carrying sales or client operations team.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in
  **English and Hindi**
  with the ability to connect authentically with creative artists and musicians.
* **Tech Stack:**
  Hands-on experience with CRM tools, Google Sheets/Excel etc
* **Work Style:**
  High empathy, disciplined follow-up habits, and comfort balancing consultative selling with operational delivery.

**What We Offer**

* A high-ownership role at the intersection of commercial growth and creative studio operations.
* Direct working access with seasoned audio professionals and top emerging indie talent.

**Salary Range**

* ₹ 40,000/month -
  ₹ 60,000/month + Incentives (uncapped)

a4062edd.title: Principal Program Manager
a4062edd.description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Program Manager**
=============================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a Technical Program Manager who will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs. You will work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business teams to ensure large-scale initiatives are delivered with clarity, predictability, and impact. This role requires a strong technical foundation combined with exceptional program management skills to orchestrate multiple workstreams and stakeholders toward shared outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will…**
  
  
**Program Planning & Execution**

* Own end-to-end program management for large-scale, cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, products, and business units.
* Define program scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and resource requirements in collaboration with engineering and product leadership.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, roadmaps, and schedules with clear dependencies, critical paths, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Drive program execution through structured governance — standups, status reviews, steering committee meetings, and escalation workflows.
* Track and report program health, progress, risks, and blockers to senior leadership and stakeholders through dashboards and executive summaries.
* Manage program-level trade-offs across scope, timeline, quality, and resources — making recommendations grounded in data and technical context.
* Conduct retrospectives and post-mortems to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in delivery processes.
* Identify process bottlenecks and inefficiencies across teams and implement improvements to accelerate delivery cycles.
  

**Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Partner with engineering leaders and architects to understand system designs, technical dependencies, and integration points across programs.
* Facilitate architecture and design reviews to ensure alignment across teams and identify cross-cutting concerns early.
* Coordinate platform migrations, infrastructure upgrades, API versioning, and other technical initiatives that span multiple teams.
* Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure release readiness, deployment coordination, and operational handoffs for program deliverables.
* Define and drive Agile-at-scale practices (SAFe, Scrum of Scrums, or similar) across engineering teams to improve delivery predictability and velocity.
* Facilitate alignment between product roadmaps, engineering capacity, and business priorities to ensure realistic commitments.
  

**Stakeholder Communication & Risk Management**

* Serve as the central point of communication for program status, decisions, and escalations across engineering, product, design, QA, and business teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts and program details into clear, concise updates for executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively — surfacing trade-offs, timeline impacts, and scope changes early with data-backed recommendations.
* Build and maintain a risk management framework — proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they become blockers.
* Manage cross-team dependency tracking, capacity planning, and sprint/release coordination.
* Build strong relationships across the organization to enable effective collaboration and influence without authority.
  

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering project management, or a related role within software product organizations.
* 5+ years of hands-on software engineering or technical lead experience (prior to or alongside program management).
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs on time and within scope.
  

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, system architecture, distributed systems, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Familiarity with microservices architecture, API design, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
* Ability to read and understand code, technical design documents, and architecture diagrams at a level sufficient to assess risks and dependencies.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and scaling frameworks.
* Proficiency with program management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
  

**Communication & Leadership**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.
* Strong facilitation skills — able to lead productive meetings, drive decisions, and resolve conflicts constructively.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously.
* Proven ability to build trust and influence across engineering, product, and business functions.
* Proactive and self-driven with a strong sense of ownership over program outcomes.
  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in SaaS/enterprise product development environments.
* Exposure to AI/ML programs and their unique delivery challenges.
* Familiarity with talent management, HR tech, or learning management domains.
  

#LI-Onsite

  

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

Check us out on LinkedIn, Comparably, Glassdoor, and Facebook!

0f2790c6.title: Technical Program Manager - Ecommerce
0f2790c6.description:
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're an innovative problem solver we want to hear from you.
  
  
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the execution of high-impact technical initiatives across our e-commerce platform’s revenue streams: Direct, partner, and channel. In this role, you will lead and run programs focused on growing revenue and lead generation, optimizing the shopper journey, improving systems, and scaling our digital storefront. You will partner closely with our engineering and operations teams, product and campaign managers, and internal business teams to deliver reliable, high-performing software that directly impacts our global user base.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Leading the delivery lifecycle of core e-commerce projects, driving timelines for features across various business segments, catalog management, product launches, agentic commerce, and more.
* Running complex projects from writing requirements through launch, including implementing and running project schedules, meeting with engineering teams, solutioning roadblocks, and delivering results.
* Coordinating and documenting requirements, planning timelines, driving meetings with various collaborators as well as communicating progress, and status updates across teams.
* Monitoring and reporting on program health, operational and revenue metrics, and finding opportunities.
* Driving programs related to NVIDIA direct, partner, and channel sales in the ecommerce experience with great attention to detail and consistency.
* Increase revenue and conversion, improve buyer journeys, and strategize new concepts for growth in your owned areas.
* Working with internal and external teams to operationalize ecommerce business strategies, drive growth, and maintain programs.
* Supporting regional teams on localized requirements for growing markets.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of proven technical program or project management experience, specifically working within a modern e-commerce, retail tech, or digital marketplace environment leading and delivering complex projects.
* Outstanding program management, leadership, collaboration, and analytical skills with the ability to successfully deliver technical projects in a multifaceted organization.
* Consistent track record of being well organized, detail oriented, and consistently engaged in an environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements.
* Excellent professional verbal and written communication of objectives, status, and results; comfortable interacting with people at all levels.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in order to meet timelines, as well as pivot and stay flexible, with a positive problem solving demeanor.
* Detailed knowledge of project management methodologies and platforms, such as Agile and/or JIRA.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce platforms, including payment gateways, shopping cart mechanics, order management systems, inventory tracking, and APIs.
* Familiarity with web performance optimization, SEO technical requirements, and global data privacy standards (GDPR, PCI-DSS compliance).
* Both team oriented and highly independent, requiring little oversight to deliver results.
* Understanding of UI/UX, consumer journey, ecommerce best practices.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, and positive attitude in the face of challenges.
* Ecommerce thought leadership and business analysis capability.
* Commitment to tracking metrics and data driven decision-making.
* Experience with applying automation, A/B testing, and continuous improvement for optimization.
* Experience working in the high tech industry on professional and enterprise solutions.
* Proven ability to quickly grasp new technical concepts.

Leveraging a collection of organizational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance, we help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organization using business intelligence.

* Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and cloud-based data platforms is advantageous
* Experience working on projects using agile development practices

97cfc311.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
97cfc311.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting-edge proof-of-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Northern India area.
  
  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection & Response), Endpoint Security and Real-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre & Campus network solutions using leaf-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert-level knowledge of industry-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

16e3c11f.title: Network - Specialist Solutions Engineer
16e3c11f.description:
AHEAD’s Specialist Solutions Engineers are the technical experts that collaborate with our AHEAD account teams to help identify, qualify, and build solutions that support our customer’s Digital Business transformation.

The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of **Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies**. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple **SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies.** Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement.

The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Active participation in the AHEAD Network SSE team, advisory and delivery teams.
* Working with the AHEAD partner management team and directly with selected strategic vendors to maintain technical and sales relationships.
* Be a thought leader within the Solutions Engineering organization, responsible for designing, architecting, and at times consulting for AHEAD clients.
* Build skills, relationships, and industry credibility across many segments to drive product, services, and consulting sales.
* Support the sales teams during engagements by providing advice and solutions or proposals optimized to meet customer technical and business requirements.
* Develop relationships with other Network SSE team members, leaders, and partners in support of sales objectives.
* Strategize and execute technical sales calls.
* Complete required pre-sales documentation (configurations, pricing, services, presentations, justifications, etc.) quickly and accurately.
* Qualify sales opportunities in terms of customer technical requirements, decision-making process, and funding.
* Present and market the design and value of proposed AHEAD solutions and business justification to customers, prospects, and AHEAD management.
* Participate in the mentorship of entry-level team members.
* Possess strong, detailed product/technology/industry knowledge.
* Knowledge of job-associated software and applications.

### **Qualifications:**

* Network Infrastructure Experience
* Cisco certifications are required. Examples: CCIE, CCNP
* Cisco Nexus 9K, ACI, 7K, 5K, 2K, 1K
* Experience with Converged Network Fabrics / Converged Infrastructure Systems.
* IP Routing Protocols
* Layer 2 protocols and technologies
* Cisco Core Datacenter Technologies
* ACI
* Network Management
* MPLS,DMVPN, Multicast
* Firewalls,VPN, IPSec / L2TP etc.
* Network Security

### **Other Skills:**

* **Innovation Mindset:** Ability to identify and leverage emerging Datacenter technologies to drive innovative solutions that meet evolving client needs.
* **Automation Expertise:** Advanced understanding of automation frameworks and scripting to optimize Datacenter operations and reduce manual effort.
* **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical skills with a focus on troubleshooting complex Datacenter environments, including storage, compute, and networking issues.
* **Consultative Approach:** Ability to engage with clients as a trusted advisor, guiding them through the decision-making process with clear, strategic recommendations.
* **Collaboration Skills:** Proven track record of working effectively across teams, including sales, engineering, and vendor partners, to deliver cohesive solutions.
* **Continuous Learning:** Commitment to staying updated on the latest industry trends, certifications, and best practices related to Datacenter technologies.
* **Security Awareness:** Knowledge of Network security best practices, ensuring that proposed solutions adhere to compliance and regulatory standards.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

b46943c6.title: Cloud Engineer
b46943c6.description:
Team:

Product Agnostic WM

Close date:

Saturday, 31 October 2026

Working pattern:

Full time

Contract Type:

Permanent

Location:

Gurgaon (SEZ1)

Description & Requirements:

**Bravura’s Commitment and Mission**

  
  

At Bravura Solutions, collaboration, diversity and excellence matter. We value your ideas, giving you room to be curious and innovate in an exciting, fast-paced, and flexible environment. We look for many different skills and abilities, as well as how you can add value to Bravura and our culture.

  
  

As a Global FinTech market leader and ASX listed company, Bravura is a trusted partner to over 350 leading financial services clients, delivering wealth management technology and products. We invest significantly in our technology hubs and innovation labs, which inspire and drive our creative, future-focused mindset. We take pride in developing cutting-edge, digital first technology solutions that help our clients to achieve financial security and prosperity for their customers.

  
  

**Job Purpose**

  
  

We are looking for an experienced cloud engineer to work within our cloud engineering practice with a remit to develop, implement, optimize and maintain the AWS infrastructure for Bravura’s cloud hosted clients. The role requires an engineer who can leverage their extensive knowledge of AWS services to build AWS infrastructure using Terraform / Infrastructure as code in both BAU and project contexts.

You will need to be team focused, working collaboratively with other engineers within the global cloud program, proactively working to leverage and improving Bravura’s standard cloud architecture. You will also have extensive experience in Infrastructure as Code within a Gitlab repository, specifically you will need to be able to demonstrate your ability to write new code and build new pipelines, not just run it. We aim to deliver service building blocks that are simple, generic, secure and repeatable. You will have a quality focus, ensuring that all your deliveries are thoroughly tested.

  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to build the next generation cloud platform blending a mix of state-of-the-art tools / techniques

  
  

**What You’ll Do**

  
  

* Major focus on low level design, building via automation AWS infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters
* Focus on improving and further automating our SDLC; continuous delivery / continuous deployment pipelines
* Proactively look for opportunities to improve the way build and deliver AWS services more efficiently
* Establish productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage the expectations of key stakeholders by facilitating effective communication
* Adopt standard terraform modules to build out AWS infrastructure requirements
* Complete technical documentation including low level designs, technical release notes and unit test artefacts
* Build / Modify Terraform modules to meet architectural requirements
* Assist the Team with resolving security vulnerabilities and issues, including Pen Test findings, AWS security audits, Infosec requirements etc.
* Responding to critical incidents and alerts in accordance with contractual SLAs
* Work closely with other Practices – DevOps, Network and DBA/Middleware in the delivery of infrastructure services.
* Provide mentoring sessions for Junior Team members, document processes, best practices and lessons learned.
* Adopt lateral thinking to trouble shoot issues within the cloud infrastructure stack
* Develop methods to actively improve quality standards
* Collaborate with others to streamline and implement efficient processes
* Help team members to facilitate incident investigation, requirements gathering and technical design activities
* Mentor and regularly engage team members to drive performance and enhance Bravura’s delivery capabilities
  

  

**Unleash your potential.**

  
  

Key Skills

  

* AWS infrastructure and services (CloudFormation, EKS, VPC, EC2, IAM, ...)
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (having CKA would be an additional advantage)
* Hands on experience with Terraform/IAC (min 3-4 yrs of experience)
* Hands on experience with CI/CD (Gitlab) and automation tools (min 3 yrs of experience)
* Worked with monitoring / alerting tools such as Promethius and Grafana, AppDynamics
* Good understanding of Linux
* Knowledge of EKS upgrade and patching for UAT and production accounts would be an added advantage.
* Coding/scripting (Bash, Python, Go etc.)
* Good understanding of security fundamentals, including encryption, certificates, etc.
* Good knowledge of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, NAT, etc.
* Strong ability to independently acquire new technical skills to meet a cloud infrastructure requirement.
* An ‘eye for detail’ and quality focus
* Demonstrated customer focus
* Excellent communication and client service skills
* Strong ability to clearly communicate complex technology solutions
* Proactive and forward thinking, with the ability to suggest improvements to current processes and practices
* Flexible and adaptable approach to a range of different tasks
* Able to organize and prioritize your own work, whilst meeting agreed deadlines
* Ability to work respectfully with team members of different skill levels and capabilities
* Reliable and professional
  

  

Preferred

  

* Experience with Cloud automation frameworks, DevOps, infrastructure as code and containerization
* Experience with infrastructure and application performance monitoring
* Experience common Cloud Solutions and Services
* AWS Certifications highly regarded
* Change management/JIRA/ServiceNow
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal – able to communicate ideas, concepts, and facts to both projects, peers and senior members of staff.
* Friendly, professional, and business-like approach to clients / Solutions staff.
* Delivery focused.
* Systematic, logical thinker with excellent attention to detail, but able to take a holistic view of the delivery organization and its associated processes.
  

  

**Qualification & Experience**

  
  

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in AWS services and infrastructure, particularly EC2, EKS, IAM, VPC, ELB
* Minimum 3-4 years of experience on Terraform coding and its understanding.
* Minimum 3 years of experience of Gitlab CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with Monitoring and Alerting at an infrastructure level, to ensure service interruption is appropriately monitored and alerted.
  

  

**Working at Bravura**

  
  

Our people are the heart of our business. We work hard to provide a rich employee with experience and a robust framework for ongoing career development.

  
  

* Competitive salary and employee benefits scheme.
* Flexible working hours, we value work-life balance.
* Maternity/ Parental (including secondary) leave policy.
* Cab facility is available in Delhi/NCR.
* Meal facility available
* Free Medical Insurance
  

  

**Corporate Responsibilities Environmental & Health & Safety**

  
  

* Ensure Annual Training is competed as required.
* Review Annually & Comply with all Company policies related to H&S and Environmental Management Systems
* Report all/any breaches or accidents/near misses immediately when discovered.
  

  

**So, what’s next?**

  
  

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion so even if you don’t match every listed skill or tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you.

  
  

Please note that interviews are primarily conducted virtually and if you require any reasonable adjustments or would like to note which pronouns you use, please let us know.

  
  

All final applicants for this position will be asked to consent to a criminal record and background check. Please note that people with criminal records are not automatically barred from applying for this position. Each application will be considered on its merits.

cd0cbd67.title: Solutions Engineer II
cd0cbd67.description:
At Disney, we’re storytellers.
  
  
We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world, a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences, and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.
  
  
The Enterprise Technology mission
  
  
is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross-company collaborative innovation. 12d1f676.title: PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer
12d1f676.description:
**Purpose And Scope**
The PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping and assuring digital solutions that support warehousing, inventory, transportation, logistics and distribution. The role translates business, operational and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure and compliant solution designs across Transportation Management Systems (TMS), SAP WM/IM, the logistics-execution elements of SAP SD, and associated integrations.
  
  
Working with Business Process Owners, System Owners, DigitalX, Enterprise Architecture, Quality, Validation and delivery partners, the role leads technical solution activities and coordinates system integration testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) support from requirements through implementation, stabilisation and transition to operations in a GxP-regulated environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**

* Solution Design and Technical Assurance

Translate warehousing, inventory, transportation and distribution needs into functional, technical, integration, data, security and non-functional requirements.
  
  
Develop solution options, target designs, data flows and fit-to-standard assessments across TMS, SAP WM/IM or EWM, SAP SD logistics execution and associated platforms.
  
  
Ensure designs align with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, quality, privacy and approved technology standards.
  
  
Own technical design quality and maintain clear design decisions, assumptions, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
  
  

* Delivery, Testing and UAT Support

Lead assigned technical workstreams from design through implementation, stabilisation and transition to support.
  
  
Define the technical test strategy and coordinate system integration testing and UAT support, including end-to-end processes, interfaces, roles, data, regression and applicable non-functional testing.
  
  
Ensure requirements traceability, test scripts, test data, evidence, defects, retesting and approvals are managed in accordance with applicable GxP and validation controls.
  
  
Lead defect triage and technical impact assessment, and ensure critical issues are resolved or formally accepted before release.
  
  
Review vendor and system-integrator deliverables against approved requirements, designs, standards and acceptance criteria.
  
  

* GxP Validation and Governance

Partner with Business Process Owners, System Owners, Quality and Validation teams on risk assessment, validation planning, traceability, evidence review, deviation management and release readiness.
  
  
Remain accountable for the completeness and quality of technical deliverables. Formal business acceptance, quality approval and validation approval remain with the designated accountable functions.
  
  
Support architecture governance, change control, CAB, audit readiness, records management and system lifecycle processes.
  
  

* SCM Process and Stakeholder Engagement

Act as the principal digital interface for warehousing, logistics, transportation and distribution stakeholders, DigitalX, architecture, quality and external partners.
  
  
Facilitate requirements, design, testing and decision workshops, clearly communicating solution options, risks, defects and trade-offs.
  
  
Promote global standards while addressing justified regulatory, legal and operational requirements.
  
  

* Technology, Data and Integration

Shape solutions supporting transportation planning and execution, carrier connectivity, tendering and booking, shipment visibility, exception management, freight settlement and integration with warehouse and distribution processes.
  
  
Define integration requirements across SAP, TMS, warehouses, carriers, freight forwarders, third-party logistics providers and enterprise platforms using APIs, middleware, EDI and event-based patterns.
  
  
Define master-data, migration, reconciliation, reporting, analytics and information-quality requirements.
  
  
Assess appropriate automation, analytics and AI opportunities while ensuring security, compliance and supportability.
  
  
**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related discipline.
* Experience delivering digital solutions across warehousing, logistics, transportation or distribution in a complex global organisation.
* Strong working knowledge of TMS and SAP logistics capabilities, including SAP WM/IM or EWM and the logistics-execution elements of SAP SD.
* Practical experience integrating SAP or TMS with warehouses, carriers, freight forwarders, third-party logistics providers or enterprise platforms.
* Hands-on experience leading or coordinating system integration testing and UAT support, including planning, script review, traceability, test data, defect management, retesting and evidence.
* Experience delivering and testing systems in a GxP or similarly regulated environment, with working knowledge of computer-system validation and change control.
* Experience defining solution designs, requirements, integrations, data flows and technical options.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and managing system integrators, software vendors or managed-service providers.
* Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, EDI, data governance, cybersecurity and system lifecycle management.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desirable Qualifications And Experience**

* Pharmaceutical or life-sciences experience, including GxP validation and audit readiness.
* Combined experience across TMS, SAP WM/IM or EWM, and SAP SD logistics execution.
* Experience in transportation planning and execution, carrier tendering, shipment visibility, freight settlement or logistics exception management.
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation, role and security testing, performance or volume testing, cutover rehearsal and post-go-live verification.
* Experience with Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, AI or intelligent automation in supply-chain operations.
* Relevant SAP, TMS, testing, validation, architecture, Agile, cloud, data or supply-chain certification.

**Working Environment**
Astellas recognises the importance of work-life balance and offers a hybrid working approach that combines time connecting with colleagues in the office with flexibility to work from home, in accordance with the Astellas Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.
  
  
Category

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Senior Technical Program Manager, Data ScienceSenior Technical Program Manager  
  
Overview:  
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights Data Science team, part of the Services organization, is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive the delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions at scale.  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on and collaborative execution leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, bring structure to ambiguous and complex initiatives, and drive predictable outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders. The Senior TPM will lead day-to-day program execution, manage cross-team dependencies, and partner closely with engineering, product, and stakeholder teams across Mastercard to ensure alignment and delivery.  
Our team builds high-performance analytics platforms that enable businesses around the world to unlock greater value from their data and make smarter decisions. This role will ensure work is clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritized, tracked, and delivered with consistency, transparency, and accountability across teams.  
This role requires the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels by translating priorities into executable plans, proactively identifying risks, solving problems, and continuously improving how teams plan, govern, and deliver work.  
This is a hybrid position based in Pune, requiring three days per week onsite.  
  
Role:  

* Own end-to-end execution of Data Science initiatives, ensuring work is clearly scoped, prioritized, planned, tracked, and delivered.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans that account for milestones, sequencing, dependencies, constraints, risks, and contingency planning.
* Drive accountability across engineering, product, stakeholder, and partner teams by ensuring owners, actions, decisions, blockers, and delivery commitments are clear and actively managed.
* Partner across Mastercard to align priorities, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward delivery outcomes.
* Bring sufficient technical depth to understand the program domain, participate in solution discussions, ask effective questions, and help engineering teams navigate blockers without being expected to write code.
* Secures resources, scopes efforts, outlines priorities and establishes delivery milestones
* Proactively manage the end-to-end delivery of data science work through the organization and all dependent organizations, reporting out progress, ensuring dependencies are covered, overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery. Accelerates progress by driving crisp, timely decisions
* Serve as the source of truth for program status, providing clear, concise, and data-driven updates to the right audiences at the right time.
* Proactively identify risks, issues, and execution gaps, escalate when appropriate, and drive timely decisions to protect delivery timelines.
* Define and track execution metrics that improve transparency, predictability, and accountability across the program.
* Lead effective operating mechanisms, including planning sessions, status reviews, dependency reviews, risk reviews, and retrospectives.
* Drive alignment across a portfolio of initiatives by evaluating business and technical trade-offs and partnering across teams to optimize execution approaches, technology adoption, and operating models.
* Continuously improve how teams plan, govern, measure, and deliver work by identifying process gaps and driving practical improvements.

  
All About You:  

* Proven experience delivering complex technology projects as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager, or similar role.
* Understanding of Agile and hybrid delivery models, the software development lifecycle, and how to drive execution across multiple engineering teams.
* Technical depth and judgment to navigate ambiguity, structure complex technical problems, and turn loosely defined priorities into executable plans.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Systems-level thinking with the ability to partner with engineering on architecture, APIs, and platform decisions.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics, dashboards, and delivery health indicators to improve transparency, predictability, and program outcomes.
* Passionate about continuous improvement and have experience improving team processes, operating mechanisms, delivery quality, and accountability.
* Strong servant leadership, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with a focus on enabling teams and fostering collaboration.
* Hands-on curiosity and willingness to dive deep into platform capabilities, underlying technologies, and evolving industry trends.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Power BI, EasyBI, MS Project, or similar project management and collaboration platforms.
* Experience driving organizational change, adoption, and continuous process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence.

aec3bc39.title: AI Program Manager
aec3bc39.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The AI Program Manager delivers a portfolio of AI products and programs from pilot through production and adoption. Working with Product Owners and leadership, the role turns priorities into coordinated action across engineering, data, governance, security, legal, sourcing and external partners, and keeps the safety and compliance posture of AI products current and audit-ready.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* PROGRAM DELIVERY: Turn priorities into delivery plans and track owners, milestones, dependencies and decisions from pilot to release.
* APPROVALS & COORDINATION: Drive governance, security, privacy, legal, sourcing and data-access reviews so programs move without stalls.
* PARTNER MANAGEMENT: Manage external AI partners and vendors, including roadmaps, commercial terms, renewals and value tracking.
* SAFETY & COMPLIANCE: Ensure product teams complete required AI assessments, guardrails and monitoring; maintain the compliance register and track incidents to closure.
* RELEASE & ADOPTION: Own release readiness, user onboarding and adoption reporting.
* SUPPORT OPERATIONS: Issue triage with users, engineering, and other teams. Ensure flagship Products are supported to ensure business continuity on teams dependent on these flagship products.
* REPORTING & ESCALATION: Communicate status, risks and recommendations to leadership, using GenAI tools while remaining accountable for accuracy.

**Qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years in technical program management, technology delivery or vendor management in a large enterprise.
* Track record of navigating governance, security, legal and procurement processes to deliver technology programs.
* Working fluency in AI concepts and enterprise AI governance.
* Ability to influence without authority and drive actions to completion across technical and business teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and concise written communication. Trading or commodities exposure is a plus.

7eafa44e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
7eafa44e.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
  
  
Senior Technical Program Manager
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights Data Science team, part of the Services organization, is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to help drive the delivery of innovative, data-driven solutions at scale.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on and collaborative execution leader who can operate with a high degree of autonomy, bring structure to ambiguous and complex initiatives, and drive predictable outcomes across multiple teams and stakeholders. The Senior TPM will lead day-to-day program execution, manage cross-team dependencies, and partner closely with engineering, product, and stakeholder teams across Mastercard to ensure alignment and delivery.
  
  
Our team builds high-performance analytics platforms that enable businesses around the world to unlock greater value from their data and make smarter decisions. This role will ensure work is clearly defined, appropriately sized, prioritized, tracked, and delivered with consistency, transparency, and accountability across teams.
  
  
This role requires the ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels by translating priorities into executable plans, proactively identifying risks, solving problems, and continuously improving how teams plan, govern, and deliver work.
  
  
This is a hybrid position based in Pune, requiring three days per week onsite.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end-to-end execution of Data Science initiatives, ensuring work is clearly scoped, prioritized, planned, tracked, and delivered.
* Build and maintain integrated program plans that account for milestones, sequencing, dependencies, constraints, risks, and contingency planning.
* Drive accountability across engineering, product, stakeholder, and partner teams by ensuring owners, actions, decisions, blockers, and delivery commitments are clear and actively managed.
* Partner across Mastercard to align priorities, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and ensure consistent progress toward delivery outcomes.
* Bring sufficient technical depth to understand the program domain, participate in solution discussions, ask effective questions, and help engineering teams navigate blockers without being expected to write code.
* Secures resources, scopes efforts, outlines priorities and establishes delivery milestones
* Proactively manage the end-to-end delivery of data science work through the organization and all dependent organizations, reporting out progress, ensuring dependencies are covered, overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery. Accelerates progress by driving crisp, timely decisions
* Serve as the source of truth for program status, providing clear, concise, and data-driven updates to the right audiences at the right time.
* Proactively identify risks, issues, and execution gaps, escalate when appropriate, and drive timely decisions to protect delivery timelines.
* Define and track execution metrics that improve transparency, predictability, and accountability across the program.
* Lead effective operating mechanisms, including planning sessions, status reviews, dependency reviews, risk reviews, and retrospectives.
* Drive alignment across a portfolio of initiatives by evaluating business and technical trade-offs and partnering across teams to optimize execution approaches, technology adoption, and operating models.
* Continuously improve how teams plan, govern, measure, and deliver work by identifying process gaps and driving practical improvements.

**All About You**

* Proven experience delivering complex technology projects as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager, or similar role.
* Understanding of Agile and hybrid delivery models, the software development lifecycle, and how to drive execution across multiple engineering teams.
* Technical depth and judgment to navigate ambiguity, structure complex technical problems, and turn loosely defined priorities into executable plans.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
* Systems-level thinking with the ability to partner with engineering on architecture, APIs, and platform decisions.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to use metrics, dashboards, and delivery health indicators to improve transparency, predictability, and program outcomes.
* Passionate about continuous improvement and have experience improving team processes, operating mechanisms, delivery quality, and accountability.
* Strong servant leadership, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with a focus on enabling teams and fostering collaboration.
* Hands-on curiosity and willingness to dive deep into platform capabilities, underlying technologies, and evolving industry trends.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Power BI, EasyBI, MS Project, or similar project management and collaboration platforms.
* Experience driving organizational change, adoption, and continuous process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
